words.enDefinition: to formally agree to receive financial assistance offered for study

examples.en: The portal explains how to accept financial aid for the upcoming academic year.
examples.zh: 平台介绍了怎样「接受助学资助」，用于下一学年的学习。

examples.en: I read the conditions before deciding whether to accept financial aid from that program.
examples.zh: 我读了条款后才决定是否「接受助学资助」。

collocations: decide whether to accept financial aid
be ready to accept financial aid

words.enDefinition: the kinds of identification a service recognizes as valid

examples.en: I read the accepted forms of ID before deciding what to take to the branch.
examples.zh: 我先看了「认可的身份证件类型」，再决定去网点要带什么。

examples.en: The bank displayed the accepted forms of ID next to the link for account applications.
examples.zh: 银行在开户申请链接旁列出了「认可的身份证件类型」。

collocations: check the accepted forms of ID
information on accepted forms of ID

words.enDefinition: forms of payment that a business agrees to take

examples.en: The sign at the café lists its accepted payment methods beside the opening hours.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆的牌子在营业时间旁列出了「支持的支付方式」。

examples.en: I checked the accepted payment methods before ordering a ticket for our class trip.
examples.zh: 我订班级出游的票之前，查了「支持的支付方式」。

words.enDefinition: To be able to use money one has saved

examples.en: How quickly could you access your savings when you needed a replacement phone?
examples.zh: 需要换手机时，你多久能「取用积蓄」？

examples.en: Can you access your savings through the app if you're away from campus?
examples.zh: 不在学校时，你能通过应用「取用储蓄」吗？

collocations: be able to access your savings

words.enDefinition: transactions and other recorded events on a bank account

examples.en: I reviewed recent account activity before asking why two entries had the same date.
examples.zh: 我先查看了近期的「账户活动」，再问为什么有两条记录日期相同。

examples.en: The bank app showed account activity in a separate section from my current settings.
examples.zh: 银行应用把「账户活动」和现有设置分别放在不同的栏目里。

words.enDefinition: a contract setting out the terms of an account

examples.en: I read the account agreement before asking the banker how to update my contact details.
examples.zh: 我先读了「账户协议」，再问银行工作人员怎么更新联系方式。

examples.en: The bank emailed the account agreement after confirming the type of account I had chosen.
examples.zh: 银行确认了我选的账户类型后，发来了「账户协议」。

collocations: a copy of the account agreement

words.enDefinition: messages triggered by certain events on a bank account

examples.en: I received account alerts by email while my phone was being repaired that week.
examples.zh: 那周手机在维修，我通过邮件接收「账户提醒」。

examples.en: The app listed which account alerts I could turn on for my new account.
examples.zh: 应用列出了我的新账户可以开启哪些「账户提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the bank's decision to accept a request for an account

examples.en: I received a message about account approval while I was on the bus to class.
examples.zh: 我坐公交去上课时，收到了一条关于「开户获批」的消息。

examples.en: The adviser explained who would contact me once account approval had been recorded in the system.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，系统登记「开户获批」后会由谁联系我。

words.enDefinition: A lender's accounting action recording a debt as unlikely to be collected

examples.en: I asked the lender why the account charge-off was dated after my last payment.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构，为什么「账户坏账核销」的日期在我上次还款之后。

examples.en: The report listed the account charge-off separately from the outstanding amount on the loan.
examples.zh: 报告把「账户坏账核销」与贷款尚欠金额分开列示。

words.enDefinition: the process of permanently ending a bank account

examples.en: I asked about account closure because I was leaving the university at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我学期结束后就要离开学校，所以咨询了「账户注销」。

examples.en: The bank sent information about account closure to the email address I had confirmed.
examples.zh: 银行把有关「账户注销」的信息发到了我确认过的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that an account has been closed

examples.en: The bank emailed my account closure confirmation the week after I left my student flat.
examples.zh: 搬出学生公寓一周后，银行发邮件给了我「销户确认」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the account closure confirmation with my other banking records.
examples.zh: 我保存了一份「销户确认」，和其他银行记录放在一起。

words.enDefinition: a form used to request the closing of an account

examples.en: I checked my signature on the account closure form before returning it to the teller.
examples.zh: 把「销户申请表」交回柜员前，我核对了自己的签名。

examples.en: The account closure form asked where the bank should send the final confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 「销户申请表」询问银行应把最终确认函寄到哪里。

words.enDefinition: a letter from a bank confirming account details

examples.en: The bank printed an account confirmation letter after checking the spelling of my name.
examples.zh: 银行核对我姓名的拼写后，打印了一份「账户确认函」。

examples.en: I attached the account confirmation letter to the form requested by the university office.
examples.zh: 我把「账户确认函」附在了学校办公室要求填写的表格后面。

words.enDefinition: the conditions someone must meet to obtain an account

examples.en: The bank changed the wording about account eligibility before the new semester started.
examples.zh: 开学前，银行修改了有关「账户申请资格」的表述。

examples.en: I asked which page described account eligibility for students arriving from another country.
examples.zh: 我问哪一页说明了留学生的「账户申请资格」。

words.enDefinition: the services and characteristics included with a particular account

examples.en: The adviser explained the account features I had circled in the product leaflet.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我在产品折页上圈出的几项「账户功能」。

examples.en: I copied the account features into my notes before discussing them with my roommate.
examples.zh: 和室友讨论之前，我把「账户功能」抄到了笔记上。

words.enDefinition: a block preventing some or all use of an account

examples.en: The branch told me whom to contact regarding the account freeze mentioned in the letter.
examples.zh: 网点告诉我，信上提到的「账户冻结」该联系谁。

examples.en: I asked which dates were covered by the account freeze shown on my dashboard.
examples.zh: 我问页面上显示的「账户冻结」涉及哪段日期。

words.enDefinition: someone in whose name a bank account is held

examples.en: The university form asked for the name of the account holder, not the bank.
examples.zh: 学校表格要求填「账户持有人」姓名，不是银行名称。

examples.en: The teller asked the account holder to check the spelling before sending the letter.
examples.zh: 柜员请「账户持有人」先核对姓名拼写，再发出信件。

words.enDefinition: An account whose unpaid debt is being pursued for collection

examples.en: The report showed an account in collections that I did not recognize from my own records.
examples.zh: 报告上有一个「移交催收的账户」，我自己的记录里找不到。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what an account in collections meant on the report's first page.
examples.zh: 我请顾问解释报告第一页的「移交催收的账户」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: written instructions identifying who may operate a bank account

examples.en: The bank gave me a copy of the account mandate after I checked the details.
examples.zh: 我核对完资料后，银行给了我一份「账户操作授权书」的副本。

examples.en: The adviser explained which changes would require a new account mandate from the holders.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了哪些变更需要账户持有人提交新的「账户操作授权书」。

collocations: a copy of the account mandate

words.enDefinition: a difference between a supplied name and the name on record

examples.en: The app displayed an account name mismatch, so I contacted the university for clarification.
examples.zh: 应用提示「账户名称不一致」，于是我联系学校核实。

examples.en: I asked which details had caused the account name mismatch on the payment screen.
examples.zh: 我问是哪项资料导致付款界面提示「账户名称不一致」。

words.enDefinition: a display name a customer chooses for an account

examples.en: I added an account nickname because both accounts looked identical on the screen.
examples.zh: 两个账户在屏幕上看起来一模一样，我就加了一个「账户自定义名称」。

examples.en: The account nickname changed on my dashboard after I saved the new settings.
examples.zh: 保存新设置后，界面上的「账户自定义名称」变了。

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies a specific bank account

examples.en: I checked the account number on the letter before entering it on the university form.
examples.zh: 我先核对了信上的「账号」，再把它填到学校表格上。

examples.en: The teller said the account number appeared below my name on the first page.
examples.zh: 柜员说，「账号」在第一页我的名字下方。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled meeting to go through the account opening process

examples.en: I moved my account opening appointment to Friday because it clashed with my first seminar.
examples.zh: 「开户预约」和第一节研讨课冲突，我就把它改到星期五。

examples.en: The bank sent a map showing where to go for my account opening appointment.
examples.zh: 银行发来一张地图，标出了「开户预约」当天该去哪里。

words.enDefinition: a notice stating that a new account has been opened

examples.en: I looked for the account opening confirmation after the adviser finished checking my details.
examples.zh: 顾问核对完我的资料后，我就查看有没有「开户确认」。

examples.en: The account opening confirmation listed my name and the date the bank registered the account.
examples.zh: 「开户确认」上列出了我的名字和银行登记该账户的日期。

words.enDefinition: the date on which an account was first opened

examples.en: I confirmed the account opening date before asking the branch for a signed letter.
examples.zh: 我先确认了「开户日期」，再向网点申请一份签字信函。

examples.en: The account opening date appeared under my name on the bank's confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 银行确认函上，我名字的下方写着「开户日期」。

collocations: proof of the account opening date

words.enDefinition: a document requesting details needed to open an account

examples.en: The teller noticed that I had left one line blank on the account opening form.
examples.zh: 柜员发现我的「开户表」上有一行没填。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name before submitting the account opening form online.
examples.zh: 我先核对了姓名的拼写，再在网上提交「开户表」。

words.enDefinition: the conditions and documents needed to open an account

examples.en: The local branch listed its account opening requirements in a leaflet for new customers.
examples.zh: 附近的网点在发给新客户的折页上列出了「开户要求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the account opening requirements had changed since the website was last updated.
examples.zh: 我问网站上次更新以来，「开户要求」有没有变。

words.enDefinition: a limit on what can be done with an account

examples.en: I asked whether the account restriction applied to viewing statements or only certain services.
examples.zh: 我问「账户操作限制」会影响查看对账单，还是只影响某些服务。

examples.en: The bank sent an email explaining why there was an account restriction on my profile.
examples.zh: 银行发邮件说明，我的账户资料上为什么有「账户操作限制」。

words.enDefinition: the recorded state of an account, such as active or closed

examples.en: The adviser checked the account status before trying to open the old statements.
examples.zh: 顾问先核对了「账户状态」，再试着打开旧对账单。

examples.en: I could see the account status next to the name on the banking dashboard.
examples.zh: 我能在银行页面上看到姓名旁边的「账户状态」。

words.enDefinition: a brief presentation of an account's key information

examples.en: I opened the account summary to check which branch the bank had listed.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户概览」，查看银行登记的是哪个网点。

examples.en: The account summary showed my name, the account type, and the last update date.
examples.zh: 「账户概览」显示了我的姓名、账户类型和最近更新日期。

words.enDefinition: a service helping move existing banking arrangements to another account

examples.en: I asked whether the bank's account switching service could handle the type of account I had.
examples.zh: 我问银行的「换户服务」能不能办理我这种账户。

examples.en: The branch gave me a leaflet explaining how its account switching service works.
examples.zh: 网点给我一张折页，介绍它的「换户服务」流程。

collocations: information about an account switching service

words.enDefinition: a payment sent directly between two financial accounts

examples.en: The portal labeled the tuition payment as an account-to-account transfer on my receipt.
examples.zh: 学费平台在我的收据上把这种付款标成了「账户间转账」。

examples.en: I asked whether an account-to-account transfer would show my name on the recipient's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「账户间转账」在收款人的账单上会不会显示我的姓名。

words.enDefinition: the category of account a customer holds or requests

examples.en: I selected the wrong account type and asked the adviser how to correct it.
examples.zh: 我选错了「账户类型」，便问顾问怎么改。

examples.en: I checked the account type at the top of the page before submitting my application.
examples.zh: 提交申请前，我核对了页面顶部的「账户类型」。

words.enDefinition: To build up interest over time

examples.en: My deposit began to accrue interest before the first payment appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 账单出现第一笔利息入账前，我的存款就开始「累积利息」了。

examples.en: Does the balance still accrue interest while the bank processes my withdrawal request?
examples.zh: 银行处理提款申请时，这笔余额是否仍会「累积利息」？

words.enDefinition: to enable a new payment card so it can be used

examples.en: The welcome letter explains how to activate your card before using it in stores.
examples.zh: 欢迎信说明了在商店用卡前怎么「激活银行卡」。

examples.en: I read the section called activate your card while waiting for the bus.
examples.zh: 等公交时，我读了标题为「激活银行卡」的那一节。

collocations: activate your card in the app

words.enDefinition: an account that is open and in use

examples.en: The help page said that an active account would appear in the main list.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说，「在用账户」会显示在主列表里。

examples.en: I asked whether the account listed in my records was still an active account.
examples.zh: 我问记录里列的那个账户是不是仍为「在用账户」。

words.enDefinition: the amount really spent rather than the amount planned

examples.en: Our actual spending on food exceeded the estimate during the second week of fieldwork.
examples.zh: 实地考察第二周，我们在伙食上的「实际支出」超过了预估。

examples.en: I put actual spending in a different column so I could quickly spot the gap.
examples.zh: 我把「实际支出」放在另一栏，这样一眼就能看出差额。

collocations: compare actual spending with the budget

words.enDefinition: save a new recipient in a bank's payment list

examples.en: I asked where the option to add a beneficiary appeared in my bank app.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用上哪里有「添加收款人」的选项。

examples.en: The help page explained how the form identifies a request to add a beneficiary.
examples.zh: 帮助页说明了表格会如何标识「添加收款人」的请求。

collocations: ask how to add a beneficiary
an option to add a beneficiary

words.enDefinition: charges added on top of a quoted price

examples.en: The added fees made the cheaper ticket more expensive than the one I saw first.
examples.zh: 算上「额外费用」，本来便宜的那张票比我最先看到的还贵。

examples.en: I checked for added fees before paying for a ticket to the student film festival.
examples.zh: 付学生电影节的票钱之前，我查了查有没有「额外费用」。

words.enDefinition: the address already stored in an organization's records

examples.en: The bank sent the letter to the address on file before I reported the move.
examples.zh: 我通知搬家之前，银行把信寄到了「登记在案的地址」。

examples.en: I asked whether the address on file was the same one I had written yesterday.
examples.zh: 我问「登记在案的地址」是不是我昨天填的那个。

words.enDefinition: the process of checking that a stated address is accurate

examples.en: The bank said address verification was still in progress after my documents arrived.
examples.zh: 银行说收到我的材料后，「地址核验」仍在进行。

examples.en: I phoned the branch about address verification because my application displayed the old flat number.
examples.zh: 申请页面显示的还是旧公寓门牌号，我就打电话问网点「地址核验」的情况。

words.enDefinition: in the US, gross income minus certain adjustments allowed before calculating taxable income

examples.en: The sample return lists adjusted gross income near the end of its first page.
examples.zh: 样本税表快到第一页末尾的地方列了「美国调整后总收入」。

examples.en: I saw adjusted gross income mentioned in several questions on the American form.
examples.zh: 我看到那张美国表格上的几个问题都提到了「美国调整后总收入」。

collocations: adjusted gross income for the previous year

words.enDefinition: A US notice explaining an unfavorable decision on a credit application

examples.en: The US lender sent an adverse action notice after turning down my application.
examples.zh: 美国的贷款机构拒绝我的申请后，发来一份「信贷不利决定通知」。

examples.en: I kept the adverse action notice because it named the company that supplied my report.
examples.zh: 我保留了这份「信贷不利决定通知」，因为上面写着哪家公司提供了我的报告。

collocations: reasons in an adverse action notice

words.enDefinition: the maximum total an eligible borrower can borrow under a loan program across multiple periods

examples.en: The federal aid guide explains how the aggregate loan limit differs from the annual limit.
examples.zh: 联邦资助指南解释了「学生贷款累计上限」和年度上限的区别。

examples.en: I asked how my previous borrowing counted toward the aggregate loan limit in the example.
examples.zh: 我问在这个例子里，我以前借的钱是怎么计入「学生贷款累计上限」的。

collocations: stay below the aggregate loan limit
count toward the aggregate loan limit

words.enDefinition: a change to the amount or mix of financial aid recorded for a student

examples.en: The office sent me a notice about an aid adjustment after I dropped a class.
examples.zh: 我退掉一门课之后，办公室发来了「资助金额调整」通知。

examples.en: The new statement explained which term the aid adjustment applied to and why.
examples.zh: 新的报表解释了「资助金额调整」适用于哪个学期，以及调整原因。

words.enDefinition: a person who receives financial assistance from an aid program

examples.en: Each aid recipient received a separate letter with the dates and payment amounts.
examples.zh: 每位「资助领取人」都收到了一封单独的信，上面写了发放日期和金额。

examples.en: The application asked whether I was an aid recipient in the previous year.
examples.zh: 申请表问我上一年是不是「资助领取人」。

words.enDefinition: a status in which student aid stops because the student no longer meets program requirements

examples.en: The message about aid suspension included the contact details for the appeal office.
examples.zh: 关于「暂停发放资助」的消息附上了受理申诉办公室的联系方式。

examples.en: The adviser explained how aid suspension would affect my next term's account.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「暂停发放资助」会怎样影响我下学期的账户。

words.enDefinition: a tax return submitted to correct information on an earlier return

examples.en: The software listed my original return and the amended return under different dates.
examples.zh: 软件把我的原申报表和「更正申报表」列在了不同日期下。

examples.en: I asked whether the confirmation email referred to my amended return for last year.
examples.zh: 我问确认邮件说的是不是我去年的「更正申报表」。

words.enDefinition: A timetable breaking payments into principal and interest over time

examples.en: The amortization schedule showed that my first payment went mostly toward interest.
examples.zh: 「本息分摊表」显示，我第一期还款大部分用于支付利息。

examples.en: I used the amortization schedule to find the remaining balance after my last payment.
examples.zh: 我根据「本息分摊表」查到上期还款后的剩余本金。

words.enDefinition: the sum taken from the account used for payment

examples.en: I checked whether the amount debited included the separate transfer fee.
examples.zh: 我核对了「账户扣款总额」是否包含单独列出的转账手续费。

examples.en: The bank showed the amount debited on the line below my reference.
examples.zh: 银行把「账户扣款总额」显示在我的编号下方那一行。

collocations: the amount debited from the account

words.enDefinition: charging for a service once a year

examples.en: I switched to annual billing because I knew I'd use the software throughout the course.
examples.zh: 我换成了「按年计费」，因为我知道整个课程都会用到这个软件。

examples.en: The advertised price assumes annual billing, so the amount due today is much higher.
examples.zh: 广告价是根据「按年计费」的方案折算的，所以今天实际要付的金额高多了。

words.enDefinition: A yearly charge for having a card account

examples.en: The annual card fee appeared in the month I first opened the account.
examples.zh: 「信用卡年费」出现在我开立账户当月的账单里。

examples.en: I called to ask whether the annual card fee changed after the first year.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问第一年过后「信用卡年费」会不会变化。

words.enDefinition: A UK annual savings rate reflecting compound interest

examples.en: The British bank included the annual equivalent rate in its comparison table for savers.
examples.zh: 这家英国银行在给储户看的对比表里列出了「年等效利率」。

examples.en: The account summary lists the annual equivalent rate beside the gross interest rate.
examples.zh: 账户概览把「年等效利率」列在税前利率旁边。

words.enDefinition: An interest rate quoted for a year

examples.en: The annual interest rate is printed next to the term on my deposit confirmation.
examples.zh: 我的存款确认单把「年利率」印在存期旁边。

examples.en: I couldn't find the annual interest rate on the first screen of the app.
examples.zh: 我在应用的第一个页面找不到「年利率」。

words.enDefinition: the most a person can borrow under a particular loan program in one year

examples.en: The annual loan limit in my offer was smaller than the total for my degree.
examples.zh: 资助通知中的「年度贷款上限」小于我整个学位的贷款总上限。

examples.en: I checked whether both semesters counted toward the annual loan limit in the funding guide.
examples.zh: 我查了资助指南，看看「年度贷款上限」是不是两个学期合计的。

collocations: count toward the annual loan limit

words.enDefinition: membership that lasts for one year

examples.en: An annual membership would cover both semesters and the summer research period on campus.
examples.zh: 「一年期会员资格」能覆盖两个学期，以及留校做研究的那段暑假。

examples.en: I got an annual membership at the museum because the course visits every month.
examples.zh: 我办了博物馆的「一年期会员资格」，因为课程每个月都安排去参观。

words.enDefinition: A U.S. annual deposit yield reflecting compound interest

examples.en: The U.S. bank advertised an annual percentage yield beside the headline interest rate.
examples.zh: 这家美国银行把「年收益率」标在宣传利率旁边。

examples.en: The comparison page showed the annual percentage yield for each account at that bank.
examples.zh: 这家银行各款账户的「年收益率」都列在对比页上。

words.enDefinition: financial aid expected to be credited to an account but not yet applied

examples.en: The bill shows anticipated aid below the total charges for my first term.
examples.zh: 账单在第一学期费用合计下面列出了「预计到账的资助」。

examples.en: My balance changed after the amount listed as anticipated aid was credited.
examples.zh: 「预计到账的资助」划入账户后，我的余额变了。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that an application has not been decided

examples.en: The portal showed application pending after the bank received the last document I sent.
examples.zh: 银行收到我最后提交的材料后，平台显示「申请待处理」。

examples.en: I asked the branch what application pending meant for the documents I had already provided.
examples.zh: 我问网点，材料都交了，显示「申请待处理」是什么意思。

collocations: a status message reading application pending

words.enDefinition: a temporary reservation of funds or credit for a card payment

examples.en: The hotel mentioned an authorization hold before I checked in for the conference.
examples.zh: 我去办会议住宿入住时，酒店提到了「预授权冻结」。

examples.en: I asked when the authorization hold would disappear from the list in my app.
examples.zh: 我问「预授权冻结」什么时候会从应用列表里消失。

words.enDefinition: someone permitted to sign or transact for an account holder

examples.en: The adviser explained what an authorized signer could do under the bank's written terms.
examples.zh: 顾问说明，按银行的书面条款，「授权签字人」可以办理哪些事项。

examples.en: I checked whether the authorized signer was listed separately from the account holder on the form.
examples.zh: 我确认了一下，表格上「授权签字人」和账户持有人是不是分开列的。

words.enDefinition: A payment made automatically according to previously selected instructions

examples.en: The app showed a scheduled automatic payment for the middle of next week.
examples.zh: 应用显示有一笔「自动还款」安排在下周中间几天。

examples.en: I checked the amount of my automatic payment after the new statement arrived.
examples.zh: 新账单出来后，我核对了「自动还款」的金额。

words.enDefinition: Renewal of a deposit without a new instruction

examples.en: The form showed whether automatic rollover was selected for the end of my deposit term.
examples.zh: 表格显示了我是否选择在存期结束时「自动转存」。

examples.en: The bank's letter said the automatic rollover would be shown in the next statement.
examples.zh: 银行的信说，下一份账单会显示这笔「自动转存」。

words.enDefinition: Money set aside automatically under a saved instruction

examples.en: The app offers automatic savings for users who want regular transfers to a separate balance.
examples.zh: 该应用为想定期把钱转到独立余额中的用户提供「自动储蓄」功能。

examples.en: I turned off automatic savings while I was waiting for my first paycheck.
examples.zh: 等第一笔工资到账时，我关闭了「自动储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: The amount someone can still borrow under an existing limit

examples.en: The app shows my available credit below the amount I already owe.
examples.zh: 应用在已欠金额下方显示我的「当前可用额度」。

examples.en: I asked why my available credit had changed before the latest purchase appeared online.
examples.zh: 我问信用卡最新一笔消费还没在网上显示，为什么「当前可用额度」就变了。

words.enDefinition: Able to be taken out now

examples.en: The app showed ninety pounds available for withdrawal when I checked my savings balance.
examples.zh: 我查储蓄余额时，应用显示有九十英镑「可供提取」。

examples.en: I asked when the full balance would be available for withdrawal after the deposit matured.
examples.zh: 我问这笔存款到期后，全部余额什么时候「可供提取」。

words.enDefinition: The mean of an account's balances across the days in a period

examples.en: The issuer used the average daily balance to calculate the interest on my purchases.
examples.zh: 发卡机构用「日均余额」来计算我的刷卡消费利息。

examples.en: The PDF showed the billing dates next to my average daily balance for the month.
examples.zh: PDF 在本月的「日均余额」旁列出了账单起止日期。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money granted to a person under a particular award

examples.en: The award amount on the letter differed from what appeared in the portal.
examples.zh: 信上的「获批资助金额」和平台上显示的不一样。

examples.en: I checked the award amount before signing the form to accept the scholarship.
examples.zh: 我先核对「获批资助金额」，才签署接受奖学金的表格。

collocations: a change in the award amount

words.enDefinition: the highest amount of funding allowed under a particular award

examples.en: The funding page lists an award cap for each type of summer project.
examples.zh: 资助页面列出了每类暑期项目的「资助金额上限」。

examples.en: Our revised budget stayed under the award cap printed in the application guide.
examples.zh: 调整后的预算没有超过申请指南所列的「资助金额上限」。

words.enDefinition: the academic year or other defined period for which a financial aid award is made

examples.en: The two letters listed the same grant amount for a different award year.
examples.zh: 两封信列出的助学金金额相同，但对应的「资助年度」不同。

examples.en: I selected the wrong award year and had to start a new application.
examples.zh: 我选错了「资助年度」，得重新填写一份申请。

collocations: aid for the next award year

words.enDefinition: wages owed for earlier work that were not paid when due

examples.en: The office confirmed that two missed shifts were included in my back pay.
examples.zh: 办公室确认，我的「补发的欠薪」包含之前漏算的两个班次。

examples.en: The letter listed each week covered by the back pay from my former employer.
examples.zh: 信里列出了前雇主那笔「补发的欠薪」对应的每一周。

words.enDefinition: a bank-issued document certifying the balance of an account

examples.en: I asked whether the balance certificate could show the amount on a specific date.
examples.zh: 我问「存款余额证明」能不能显示某个指定日期的余额。

examples.en: The bank supplied a balance certificate separately from my regular monthly statement that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午，银行在常规月度对账单之外，单独给了我一份「存款余额证明」。

words.enDefinition: An increase in the amount held in savings

examples.en: The chart shows balance growth since I opened the account in September.
examples.zh: 这张图显示了我九月开户以来的「储蓄余额增长」情况。

examples.en: I could see the biggest balance growth in the months when I worked full-time.
examples.zh: 我看得出，全职工作的那几个月里，「储蓄余额增长」最明显。

words.enDefinition: a balance level used to trigger a rule or alert

examples.en: I chose a balance threshold while changing when the app would send me alerts.
examples.zh: 我修改应用发送提醒的时间和条件时，选定了一个「余额阈值」。

examples.en: The bank explained how to tell which balance threshold was active on my account.
examples.zh: 银行说明了如何查看我的账户当前使用哪个「余额阈值」。

words.enDefinition: The movement of an existing card debt to another account

examples.en: The app showed the balance transfer as pending while both card balances still matched yesterday's figures.
examples.zh: 应用显示「信用卡欠款转移」还在处理中，两张卡的欠款余额仍和昨天一样。

examples.en: I called the issuer to ask when the balance transfer would appear on my statement.
examples.zh: 我打电话问发卡机构，「信用卡欠款转移」什么时候会出现在账单上。

words.enDefinition: A charge for moving card debt to another account

examples.en: The balance transfer fee appeared on the first statement from my new card.
examples.zh: 「欠款转移手续费」出现在我新信用卡的第一期账单里。

examples.en: I asked whether the quoted amount included the balance transfer fee shown in the offer.
examples.zh: 我问报价金额是否包含方案中列出的「欠款转移手续费」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement with a bank for holding and managing money

examples.en: I needed a local bank account before the university could record my payment details.
examples.zh: 学校要登记我的收款资料，我得先有一个当地的「银行账户」。

examples.en: My bank account still showed my old address after I moved closer to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的地方后，我的「银行账户」上仍显示旧地址。

words.enDefinition: a request asking a bank to open an account

examples.en: My bank account application was still being reviewed when the first semester started.
examples.zh: 第一学期开学时，我的「银行账户申请」还在审核。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the bank account application before closing the browser window.
examples.zh: 关闭浏览器窗口前，我保存了一份「银行账户申请」的副本。

words.enDefinition: delivery of transferred funds directly into the recipient's bank account

examples.en: I asked whether bank account payout was available for the recipient's particular bank.
examples.zh: 我问这笔钱能不能「直接发放到银行账户」，也就是汇到收款人用的那家银行。

examples.en: I selected bank account payout because my sister could not collect cash that afternoon.
examples.zh: 妹妹那天下午没法领现金，所以我选择「直接发放到银行账户」。

words.enDefinition: the location recorded for the bank identified in a transfer

examples.en: The clerk checked the bank address against the official details I had received.
examples.zh: 工作人员根据我收到的官方资料核对了「银行地址」。

examples.en: I asked why the bank address and the beneficiary's address were listed separately.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「银行地址」和收款人的地址要分开列。

words.enDefinition: A bank's closure after it becomes unable to operate

examples.en: The leaflet described how the scheme handles savings in the event of a bank failure.
examples.zh: 传单说明了发生「银行倒闭」时，该计划如何处理储蓄款。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what would happen to my deposit after a bank failure.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，如果「银行倒闭」，我的存款会怎么样。

collocations: in the event of a bank failure
the aftermath of a bank failure

words.enDefinition: a UK term for an officially designated public holiday

examples.en: The Bristol branch was closed for a bank holiday, so I went back the following morning.
examples.zh: 布里斯托尔的网点因「英国公众假日」没有营业，我第二天早上又去了一趟。

examples.en: The website showed revised opening times for the bank holiday at the start of May.
examples.zh: 网站上公布了五月初「英国公众假日」调整后的营业时间。

collocations: opening hours on a bank holiday

words.enDefinition: a bank letter describing a customer's banking relationship

examples.en: I asked for a bank reference letter after the housing office requested one from me.
examples.zh: 住房办公室要求出示一份，我就申请了「银行资信函」。

examples.en: The banker explained which details could appear in the bank reference letter that I needed.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员说明了我需要的「银行资信函」上可以写哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: a bank employee who assists customers at a counter

examples.en: The bank teller asked how to spell my surname before looking up my account.
examples.zh: 「银行柜员」先问我的姓怎么拼，再查我的账户。

examples.en: I showed the bank teller the email with the appointment time and branch address.
examples.zh: 我给「银行柜员」看了那封写着预约时间和网点地址的邮件。

words.enDefinition: an amount charged by a bank for moving money

examples.en: The bank listed a bank transfer fee separately from the money being sent.
examples.zh: 银行把「银行转账手续费」和汇出的款项分开列出。

examples.en: I asked how the bank transfer fee appeared on my monthly account statement.
examples.zh: 我问月度账户账单上会怎样显示「银行转账手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a day when a bank processes its ordinary business transactions

examples.en: The receipt said one banking day, so I asked whether Monday counted.
examples.zh: 收据上写着一个「银行工作日」，所以我问星期一算不算。

examples.en: I asked which banking day the provider meant in its arrival estimate.
examples.zh: 我问服务商的到账估计指的是哪个「银行工作日」。

words.enDefinition: A rate paid before any promotional additions

examples.en: The leaflet showed the base interest rate beside the rate with the monthly bonus.
examples.zh: 传单把「基础利率」和含月度奖励的利率并排列出。

examples.en: I called the bank to check whether the base interest rate had changed in June.
examples.zh: 我打电话问银行六月的「基础利率」有没有调整。

collocations: a change to the base interest rate

words.enDefinition: an account offering a limited set of banking services

examples.en: The adviser explained how a basic bank account differed from the bank's other accounts.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「基础银行账户」与这家银行其他账户有什么区别。

examples.en: I asked what documents the branch accepted for a basic bank account after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我问网点申请「基础银行账户」可以用哪些材料。

collocations: apply for a basic bank account
qualify for a basic bank account

words.enDefinition: the standard amount paid for a job before extras are added

examples.en: The payslip showed my basic pay on a separate line from the bonus.
examples.zh: 工资单把「基本工资」和奖金分成两行列出来。

examples.en: The contract lists basic pay before it explains weekend and evening rates.
examples.zh: 合同先列「基本工资」，再说明周末和晚班的工资标准。

words.enDefinition: the account designated to receive the transferred funds

examples.en: My bank asked which beneficiary account was listed on the official payment form.
examples.zh: 银行问正式付款单上指定的是哪个「收款账户」。

examples.en: I asked whether the beneficiary account could receive funds in the specified currency.
examples.zh: 我问这个「收款账户」能不能接收指定币种的款项。

words.enDefinition: the address listed for the person or entity receiving a payment

examples.en: I asked whether the beneficiary address meant the person's home or their office.
examples.zh: 我问「收款人地址」是填对方家里的地址，还是办公室地址。

examples.en: The university provided a beneficiary address on its overseas payment information sheet.
examples.zh: 学校在海外付款资料单上提供了一个「收款人地址」。

words.enDefinition: the bank holding the account designated to receive the money

examples.en: The form had a separate field for the beneficiary bank and its location.
examples.zh: 表格有一栏单独填写「汇款收款银行」和所在地。

examples.en: I asked which name on the notice referred to the beneficiary bank.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪个名称指的是「汇款收款银行」。

words.enDefinition: the name of the person or entity receiving the money

examples.en: The bank asked whether the beneficiary name matched the details on the invoice.
examples.zh: 银行问「受益人姓名」是否和发票上的资料相符。

examples.en: I checked the beneficiary name on the form against the university's payment notice.
examples.zh: 我把表格上的「受益人姓名」和学校付款通知上的名字核对了一遍。

words.enDefinition: transfer fees assigned to the person receiving the money

examples.en: I asked whether beneficiary-paid charges would affect the amount my roommate received.
examples.zh: 我问「收款人承担的费用」会不会影响室友实际收到的金额。

examples.en: The bank explained what beneficiary-paid charges meant in the fee options.
examples.zh: 银行解释了收费选项里的「收款人承担的费用」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a benefit provided by an employer in a form other than cash

examples.en: The guide listed a company car as an example of a benefit in kind.
examples.zh: 指南把公司配车列为「非现金福利」的一个例子。

examples.en: The payslip summary shows the estimated value of each benefit in kind.
examples.zh: 工资单摘要列出了每项「非现金福利」的估算价值。

collocations: the value of a benefit in kind

words.enDefinition: a purchase that costs much more than normal purchases

examples.en: The laptop was a big-ticket purchase, so I compared repair options before replacing it.
examples.zh: 换电脑算一笔「大额消费」，所以换之前我先比较了几种维修方案。

examples.en: I plan each big-ticket purchase around the weeks when I have extra shifts at work.
examples.zh: 每笔「大额消费」，我都会安排在打工班次比较多的那几周。

words.enDefinition: a difference between an entered billing address and the address on record

examples.en: A billing address mismatch stopped my train ticket order on the final screen.
examples.zh: 最后一步，「账单地址不匹配」让我的火车票订单没能提交。

examples.en: The error message said billing address mismatch after I entered my new address.
examples.zh: 输完新地址后，错误消息显示「账单地址不匹配」。

collocations: check for a billing address mismatch

words.enDefinition: The recurring period of activity covered by a single bill

examples.en: My card's first billing cycle began the week the account was opened.
examples.zh: 我的信用卡第一个「账单周期」从开户那周开始。

examples.en: The hotel refunded the charge near the end of the billing cycle.
examples.zh: 酒店在「账单周期」快结束时退回了那笔费用。

words.enDefinition: information used to identify a payer and issue a bill

examples.en: I checked my billing details before the student software renewal went through online.
examples.zh: 在线续订学生软件之前，我核对了自己的「账单信息」。

examples.en: The website asked whether my billing details were different from the delivery information.
examples.zh: 网站问我的「账单信息」是否和收货信息不同。

words.enDefinition: the postal code linked to a payment card's billing address

examples.en: The form rejected my billing postcode because I had entered the delivery address instead.
examples.zh: 我填成了收货地址，所以表单不接受我的「账单地址邮编」。

examples.en: I checked the billing postcode after moving to a flat closer to campus.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的公寓后，我核对了「账单地址邮编」。

words.enDefinition: signing in using a physical feature such as a fingerprint

examples.en: I found biometric sign-in under account settings after updating the bank's app.
examples.zh: 更新银行应用后，我在账户设置里找到了「生物识别登录」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the phrase biometric sign-in when I asked about the welcome leaflet.
examples.zh: 我问起欢迎折页时，顾问解释了「生物识别登录」这个词。

words.enDefinition: pay issued every two weeks in a regular schedule

examples.en: The department uses biweekly pay, so my deposits do not fall on fixed dates.
examples.zh: 部门实行「每两周发薪」，所以我的工资到账日并非每月固定日期。

examples.en: The new job switched me from monthly deposits to biweekly pay this fall.
examples.zh: 今年秋天换了工作后，我的工资从每月发一次变成了「每两周发薪」。

words.enDefinition: spend much more than the amount that was planned

examples.en: We didn't want to blow the budget on one dinner during the reading break.
examples.zh: 我们不想在阅读周吃一顿饭就「把预算花超一大截」。

examples.en: One last-minute train ticket could blow the budget for the entire weekend away.
examples.zh: 一张临时买的火车票就可能让整个周末的出行「严重超支」。

collocations: try not to blow the budget

words.enDefinition: Extra interest paid when specified conditions are met

examples.en: The statement shows the bonus interest separately from the usual interest for that month.
examples.zh: 这份账单把当月的「额外奖励利息」和普通利息分开列了。

examples.en: I asked why the bonus interest on my account was different in February.
examples.zh: 我问为什么二月账户中的「额外奖励利息」金额不一样。

words.enDefinition: A person who receives money with an obligation to repay it

examples.en: The first page of the contract gave the borrower a contact number.
examples.zh: 合同第一页为「借款人」提供了一个联系电话。

examples.en: The borrower asked for a copy of the agreement before leaving.
examples.zh: 「借款人」离开前要了一份协议副本。

words.enDefinition: the decision to stop operating at a bank branch

examples.en: The notice gave the date of the branch closure and listed the nearest remaining office.
examples.zh: 通知给出了「银行网点关闭」的日期，还列出了最近仍营业的网点。

examples.en: I had a question about old statements after reading the letter about the branch closure.
examples.zh: 看到关于「银行网点关闭」的信后，我有个关于旧对账单的问题。

words.enDefinition: an identifier for a specific branch of a financial institution

examples.en: I asked which part of the published details was the branch code.
examples.zh: 我问公布的资料里哪一部分是「银行分行代码」。

examples.en: The bank's help page explained the branch code field on the form.
examples.zh: 银行的帮助页解释了表格上的「银行分行代码」一栏。

words.enDefinition: the service counter inside a branch of a bank

examples.en: I went to the branch counter after the receptionist checked the time of my appointment.
examples.zh: 接待人员核对预约时间后，我去了「网点柜台」。

examples.en: The bank sent me back to the branch counter to pick up my original documents.
examples.zh: 银行让我回「网点柜台」取回证件原件。

collocations: present a document at the branch counter

words.enDefinition: the times when a bank branch is open

examples.en: I checked branch hours before walking to the bank after my afternoon lecture.
examples.zh: 下午上完课走去银行前，我先查了「网点营业时间」。

examples.en: The notice listed different branch hours during the university break in December.
examples.zh: 告示列出了十二月学校放假期间不同的「网点营业时间」。

words.enDefinition: goods sold under a widely recognized brand name

examples.en: I stopped buying brand-name products once I found a cheaper cereal I actually liked.
examples.zh: 找到一种更便宜又合口味的谷物早餐后，我就不买「知名品牌商品」了。

examples.en: The student shop carries a few brand-name products alongside cheaper versions of the same items.
examples.zh: 学生商店在卖一些「知名品牌商品」的同时，也卖同类的便宜款。

words.enDefinition: to take the actual documents rather than copies

examples.en: The appointment email asked me to bring original documents rather than photos on my phone.
examples.zh: 预约邮件让我「携带证件原件」，而不是用手机里的照片。

examples.en: I asked whether to bring original documents to the branch at my next visit.
examples.zh: 我问下次去网点时是否需要「携带证件原件」。

collocations: ask someone to bring original documents
be asked to bring original documents

words.enDefinition: an Australian identifier for a bank and its branch

examples.en: My Australian university listed a BSB number separately from its account number.
examples.zh: 我在澳大利亚就读的学校把「澳洲银行分行代码」和银行账号分开列。

examples.en: I asked the bank which field was intended for the BSB number.
examples.zh: 我问银行，哪个字段是用来填「澳洲银行分行代码」的。

words.enDefinition: a list showing how planned spending is divided

examples.en: The budget breakdown shows what we can spend on food, train tickets, and accommodation.
examples.zh: 「预算明细」列出了我们能在餐饮、火车票和住宿上各花多少钱。

examples.en: I shared the budget breakdown so my friends could see why we changed hotels.
examples.zh: 我把「预算明细」发给朋友，让他们明白我们为什么换了酒店。

words.enDefinition: extra room in a budget for unexpected costs

examples.en: I left a budget buffer in case the train tickets cost more than expected.
examples.zh: 我留了一点「预算余量」，以防火车票比预想的贵。

examples.en: The budget buffer covered a replacement charger without changing my plans for groceries.
examples.zh: 我用「预算余量」买了个新充电器，没影响买菜的安排。

words.enDefinition: inexpensive enough for someone with limited money

examples.en: The café has a budget-friendly lunch if you get there before two.
examples.zh: 两点前到的话，这家咖啡馆有「实惠的」午餐。

examples.en: Our adviser listed budget-friendly places to stay within walking distance of the conference venue.
examples.zh: 导师列出了一些「实惠的」住处，走路就能到会议地点。

words.enDefinition: spending that goes beyond the amount originally planned

examples.en: The higher train fares caused a budget overrun on our shared weekend trip.
examples.zh: 火车票涨价导致我们这次结伴周末出游「预算超支」。

examples.en: We each paid a little more to cover the budget overrun for the shared dinner.
examples.zh: 为了补上聚餐「预算超支」的部分，我们每个人都多付了一点。

words.enDefinition: a check of how well a spending plan is working

examples.en: A budget review showed that I was spending more at the café than on groceries.
examples.zh: 做了一次「预算复盘」，我才发现自己在咖啡馆花的钱比采购食品杂货还多。

examples.en: I'll do a budget review once I know how much the new commute actually costs.
examples.zh: 等我弄清新的通勤路线实际要花多少，就做一次「预算复盘」。

words.enDefinition: a document for listing income and planning expenses

examples.en: The campus advice office sent me a budget worksheet with separate spaces for weekly expenses.
examples.zh: 学校咨询处发给我一张「预算工作表」，上面有专门填写每周开销的栏目。

examples.en: I left the income box blank on my budget worksheet until I got my work schedule.
examples.zh: 我直到拿到排班表才填「预算工作表」里的收入栏。

words.enDefinition: a UK member-owned institution offering savings and home loans

examples.en: The building society had an office beside the bus stop I used for lectures.
examples.zh: 「英国住房互助协会」的营业点就在我平时坐车去上课的公交站旁。

examples.en: I read the leaflet from the building society while waiting to meet my flatmate.
examples.zh: 我等室友时看了「英国住房互助协会」的宣传折页。

words.enDefinition: a special price for products or services bought together

examples.en: We found a bundle deal that included a train ticket and entry to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 我们找到了一个「捆绑优惠」，里面包括火车票和展览门票。

examples.en: The bundle deal only saved money if I actually used both of the apps.
examples.zh: 只有两个应用我都用得上，这个「捆绑优惠」才省钱。

collocations: sign up for a bundle deal

words.enDefinition: money awarded to support a student's studies, often based on financial circumstances

examples.en: My bursary went towards the travel costs for my first clinical placement.
examples.zh: 我的「助学补助金」用来支付第一次临床实习的交通费。

examples.en: The college notified me about the bursary through my student email account.
examples.zh: 学院通过学生邮箱通知了我「助学补助金」的事。

words.enDefinition: the amount you pay for a bus ride

examples.en: The bus fare to campus went up just before I started my weekend job.
examples.zh: 我刚要开始做周末兼职，去学校的「公交车费」就涨了。

examples.en: I kept enough cash for the bus fare in case my phone ran out of battery.
examples.zh: 我留了够付「公交车费」的现金，以防手机没电。

words.enDefinition: purchase a large quantity at the same time

examples.en: We buy in bulk when rice is cheaper and split the bags between three flats.
examples.zh: 大米便宜的时候我们会「大量采购」，然后分给三个住处。

examples.en: It made sense to buy in bulk once I had somewhere to store everything.
examples.zh: 有地方存货之后，「大量采购」就划算了。

collocations: buy in bulk to save money

words.enDefinition: end the arrangement that gives you ongoing paid access

examples.en: I couldn't find where to cancel a subscription I had started during orientation week.
examples.zh: 迎新周开通的那项服务，我找不到哪里可以「取消订阅」。

examples.en: The help page explains how to cancel a subscription if you signed up through the app.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了如果是从应用里开通的，要如何「取消订阅」。

words.enDefinition: stop a pending or scheduled transfer when the provider allows it

examples.en: I asked whether it was still possible to cancel a transfer scheduled for Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「取消预约在周三执行的转账」。

examples.en: The provider's help page explained when customers could ask to cancel a transfer.
examples.zh: 服务商的帮助页解释了客户什么时候可以申请「取消转账」。

collocations: the option to cancel a transfer

words.enDefinition: accumulated interest that has been added to the principal of a loan

examples.en: My statement showed capitalized interest as a separate increase to the principal balance.
examples.zh: 对账单把「计入本金的利息」单列为一笔本金余额增量。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out where the worksheet recorded capitalized interest for the example loan.
examples.zh: 顾问指出了计算表在哪里记录案例贷款中「计入本金的利息」。

words.enDefinition: a check to confirm that a card or card user is genuine

examples.en: The checkout screen mentioned card authentication before my textbook order was approved.
examples.zh: 教材订单获批前，结账页面提到了「刷卡交易身份验证」。

examples.en: I asked the bank why card authentication was requested again for the purchase.
examples.zh: 我问银行，为什么这笔消费要再次做「刷卡交易身份验证」。

words.enDefinition: the issuer's approval for a particular card transaction

examples.en: The shop was still waiting for card authorization when the register stopped responding.
examples.zh: 收银台没反应时，商店还在等「银行卡交易授权」。

examples.en: My bank displayed the card authorization before the purchase appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 这笔消费出现在账单前，我的银行先显示了「银行卡交易授权」。

words.enDefinition: the process of picking up a card at a stated location

examples.en: I asked which documents were needed for card collection at the bank branch.
examples.zh: 我问「到指定地点领卡」时，要带哪些材料去银行网点。

examples.en: The email says card collection is available on weekdays before the branch closes.
examples.zh: 邮件说工作日网点关门前都可以「到指定地点领卡」。

words.enDefinition: shown when a payment card is not approved

examples.en: The screen said card declined after I tried to pay for my lunch.
examples.zh: 我试着付午饭的钱后，屏幕显示「银行卡付款被拒」。

examples.en: I asked the cashier what card declined meant on the small display.
examples.zh: 我问收银员，小屏幕上的「银行卡付款被拒」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the process of sending an issued payment card to a customer

examples.en: I checked the card delivery estimate because I was leaving for reading week.
examples.zh: 我复习周要离校，所以查了「银行卡配送」的预计时间。

examples.en: The app said card delivery had been delayed because of the public holiday.
examples.zh: 应用说，公共假日期间「银行卡配送」延误了。

words.enDefinition: the date after which a card is no longer valid

examples.en: The form asked for the card expiry date when I renewed my bus pass.
examples.zh: 我续办公交卡时，表格要求填「银行卡到期日」。

examples.en: I noticed the card expiry date was before the end of my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 我注意到「银行卡到期日」早于交换学期结束的日期。

words.enDefinition: an organisation that provides a payment card to a customer

examples.en: I contacted the card issuer after the replacement card went to my old address.
examples.zh: 补发的卡寄到了旧地址，我联系了「发卡机构」。

examples.en: The receipt gave me the shop's name but not the name of the card issuer.
examples.zh: 收据上有商店名称，但没有「发卡机构」的名称。

words.enDefinition: a card payment made without presenting the card at a terminal

examples.en: The online textbook order appeared as a card-not-present transaction in my bank app.
examples.zh: 在线教材订单在银行应用里显示为「无卡支付交易」。

examples.en: The adviser explained why an online order was marked as a card-not-present transaction.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么在线订单会标为「无卡支付交易」。

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies a particular payment card

examples.en: The cashier kept the receipt, which showed only part of my card number.
examples.zh: 收银员收走了收据，上面只显示了我的部分「银行卡号」。

examples.en: I checked the card number in the app after my new card arrived.
examples.zh: 新卡到了以后，我在应用里核对了「银行卡号」。

words.enDefinition: a card whose payment details are kept in a merchant's records

examples.en: The gym said it could use the card on file for my membership renewal.
examples.zh: 健身房说，会员续期可以用「已留存的银行卡」付款。

examples.en: The ticket app showed a card on file that I no longer used.
examples.zh: 购票应用显示有一张我已不用的「已留存的银行卡」。

words.enDefinition: a checkout that takes card payments without accepting cash

examples.en: I moved to a card-only checkout because I had left my wallet upstairs.
examples.zh: 钱包落在楼上，我就换到了「仅限刷卡的结账台」。

examples.en: The card-only checkout at our shop accepts both phone payments and physical cards.
examples.zh: 我们店的「仅限刷卡的结账台」既收手机支付也收实体卡。

words.enDefinition: a notification sent when a card payment is attempted or made

examples.en: I got a card payment alert while the shop was printing the receipt.
examples.zh: 商店还在打印收据，我就收到一条「银行卡付款提醒」。

examples.en: My bank lets me choose when I receive a card payment alert.
examples.zh: 我的银行允许我设置什么时候接收「银行卡付款提醒」。

words.enDefinition: the personal number used to verify someone using a card

examples.en: The terminal asked for my card PIN when I inserted the debit card.
examples.zh: 我插入借记卡时，终端提示输入「银行卡密码」。

examples.en: My bank showed where to find the card PIN in its secure app.
examples.zh: 银行说明了在安全应用里哪里能查看「银行卡密码」。

words.enDefinition: a payment where the card or contactless device is used at a terminal

examples.en: My bank labelled the campus bookshop payment as a card-present transaction in the app.
examples.zh: 银行在应用里把在校园书店付的钱标为「现场刷卡交易」。

examples.en: I asked about the phrase card-present transaction because it appeared on my statement.
examples.zh: 账单上出现了「现场刷卡交易」，我就问了这个说法。

words.enDefinition: a device that reads information from a payment card

examples.en: The card reader on the bus did not respond when I first tried.
examples.zh: 我第一次刷时，公交车上的「读卡器」没反应。

examples.en: The market stall had a small card reader connected to the seller's phone.
examples.zh: 集市摊位有个小「读卡器」，连着摊主的手机。

words.enDefinition: a record confirming a payment made by card at a merchant

examples.en: I kept the card receipt because my flatmate had paid for half the order.
examples.zh: 我留着「刷卡凭条」，因为订单有一半的钱是室友出的。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I needed a copy of the card receipt.
examples.zh: 收银员问我需不需要一份「刷卡凭条」副本。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount a cardholder may spend within a specified period

examples.en: I asked about the card spending limit before placing a large order for textbooks.
examples.zh: 一次性订很多教材之前，我询问了「银行卡消费限额」。

examples.en: The app shows the card spending limit next to my payment settings.
examples.zh: 应用在付款设置旁边显示了「银行卡消费限额」。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for paying with a card

examples.en: The ticket website showed a card surcharge before it asked me to pay.
examples.zh: 购票网站在要求付款前显示了「刷卡附加费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the card surcharge would apply if I used a debit card.
examples.zh: 我问用借记卡是否也要付「刷卡附加费」。

words.enDefinition: replacing card details with a substitute value for payment processing

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained card tokenization when I asked about using a digital wallet.
examples.zh: 我问电子钱包怎么用时，银行宣传页介绍了「卡片信息令牌化」。

examples.en: Our class discussed card tokenization in a lesson on common digital payment terms.
examples.zh: 我们在一节讲常见数字支付术语的课里讨论了「卡片信息令牌化」。

words.enDefinition: a list of past transactions made with a specific card

examples.en: I checked the card transaction history against the receipts from our group trip.
examples.zh: 我拿小组出游的收据和「银行卡交易记录」逐一核对。

examples.en: The app filters my card transaction history by date when I search for a purchase.
examples.zh: 我查找某笔消费时，应用会按日期筛选「银行卡交易记录」。

words.enDefinition: a short code used to verify a card payment

examples.en: The official checkout asked for the card verification code before confirming my order.
examples.zh: 正规结账页面在确认我的订单前，要求输入「卡片安全码」。

examples.en: The bank's guide explains where to find the card verification code on each card.
examples.zh: 银行指南说明了在不同卡片上哪里可以看到「卡片安全码」。

words.enDefinition: the person to whom a payment card is issued

examples.en: The form says the cardholder should check the total before signing the receipt.
examples.zh: 表格上说，「持卡人」签收据之前应先核对总金额。

examples.en: The shop asked the cardholder to contact the bank about the declined payment.
examples.zh: 商店请「持卡人」就付款被拒一事联系银行。

words.enDefinition: the contract setting the terms for using a payment card

examples.en: I read the cardholder agreement after the bank emailed it to my account.
examples.zh: 银行发邮件把「持卡人协议」寄给我后，我读了一遍。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where card fees were listed in the cardholder agreement.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我，「持卡人协议」里哪里列了银行卡收费。

words.enDefinition: the name printed on or associated with a payment card

examples.en: The checkout page says the cardholder name must match what is on the card.
examples.zh: 结账页面说，「持卡人姓名」应与卡片上的姓名一致。

examples.en: I checked the cardholder name before submitting the order for my course books.
examples.zh: 在提交教材订单前，我核对了「持卡人姓名」。

words.enDefinition: To leave part of an outstanding amount unpaid into another period

examples.en: I sometimes carry a balance when my pay arrives after the next billing cycle begins.
examples.zh: 工资在新账期开始后才到账时，我有时会「留有未还清欠款」。

examples.en: The guide explains what happens if you carry a balance from the previous month.
examples.zh: 指南解释了如果上个月「留有未还清欠款」会发生什么。

collocations: carry a balance from month to month
carry a balance on a card

words.enDefinition: The annualized interest rate applied when cash is borrowed on a card

examples.en: The disclosure showed the cash advance APR in a separate column from the purchase rate.
examples.zh: 披露文件把「预借现金年利率」与消费利率分列两栏。

examples.en: I asked whether the cash advance APR applied to the transaction listed as cash.
examples.zh: 我问「预借现金年利率」是否适用于那笔列为现金的交易。

words.enDefinition: A charge for getting cash using a credit account

examples.en: The cash withdrawal receipt did not show the card issuer's cash advance fee.
examples.zh: 现金取款凭条没显示发卡机构收取的「预借现金手续费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the cash advance fee and the ATM fee were separate charges.
examples.zh: 我问「预借现金手续费」和 ATM 手续费是不是两项费用。

words.enDefinition: Extra readily available money for covering shortfalls

examples.en: My cash buffer covered the bills while I waited for my first paycheck.
examples.zh: 等第一笔工资到账期间，我用「现金缓冲储备」付了账单。

examples.en: I was glad to have a cash buffer when the café closed for repairs.
examples.zh: 咖啡店停业维修时，我庆幸自己有「现金缓冲储备」。

words.enDefinition: money paid into an account in physical notes or coins

examples.en: I asked when the cash deposit would appear on my account after visiting the branch.
examples.zh: 我去过网点后，问「现金存款」什么时候会显示在账户上。

examples.en: The teller counted the cash deposit before recording it on my savings account.
examples.zh: 柜员先清点了「现金存款」，再登记进我的储蓄账户。

collocations: a cash deposit at a branch

words.enDefinition: A labeled envelope for cash set aside

examples.en: I found a cash envelope marked travel at the back of my drawer.
examples.zh: 我在抽屉深处找到一个标着“旅行”的「装专用现金的信封」。

examples.en: My grandmother kept a cash envelope for the bus fares we needed as children.
examples.zh: 我们小时候需要坐公交车，奶奶专门留了一个「装车费现金的信封」。

collocations: put money in a cash envelope

words.expression: cash in a certificate of deposit
words.lemma: cash in a certificate of deposit
words.enDefinition: To redeem a certificate of deposit for its funds
acceptedEnVariants: cash in a certificate of deposit

examples.en: I asked what documents I needed to cash in a certificate of deposit at the branch.
examples.zh: 我问去银行网点「兑现定期存单」需要哪些文件。

examples.en: Can I cash in a certificate of deposit online if it has already matured?
examples.zh: 如果已经到期，我可以在线「兑现定期存单」吗？

collocations: cash in a certificate of deposit early
cash in a certificate of deposit at maturity
choose to cash in a certificate of deposit

words.enDefinition: accepting cash as the only payment method

examples.en: The stall was cash only, so I couldn't use my card for lunch.
examples.zh: 那个摊位「仅收现金」，所以我没法刷卡买午饭。

examples.en: The sign at the door said cash only during the temporary network outage.
examples.zh: 临时网络中断时，门口的牌子写着「仅收现金」。

words.enDefinition: a plan that limits everyday purchases to physical cash

examples.en: I used a cash-only budget on holiday because it made my spending easier to see.
examples.zh: 我度假时用的是「只用现金的预算」，这样花了多少一目了然。

examples.en: A cash-only budget was awkward when the campus bookshop stopped accepting notes and coins.
examples.zh: 校内书店不再收纸币和硬币后，用「只用现金的预算」就不方便了。

words.enDefinition: a delivery option allowing a recipient to collect cash in person

examples.en: I asked the provider what cash pickup meant on the list of delivery options.
examples.zh: 我问服务商，到账方式清单里的「现金领取」是什么意思。

examples.en: The quote showed fees for cash pickup separately from deposits into an account.
examples.zh: 报价把「现金领取」和入账这两种方式的费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a place where a designated recipient can collect transferred funds

examples.en: The recipient asked whether the cash pickup location was near her bus route.
examples.zh: 收款人问「现金领取点」离她坐的公交路线近不近。

examples.en: I checked the cash pickup location address after the provider sent the confirmation.
examples.zh: 服务商发来确认通知后，我核对了「现金领取点」的地址。

words.enDefinition: A gap between available cash and amounts due

examples.en: A delay in my wages left me with a cash shortfall that Friday.
examples.zh: 那周五工资晚发，让我出现了「现金缺口」。

examples.en: We noticed a cash shortfall when the two refunds still hadn't arrived by Monday.
examples.zh: 到了周一，两笔退款依然没到账，我们发现出现了「现金缺口」。

words.enDefinition: money spent using notes and coins

examples.en: My cash spending looked low because I had forgotten to record purchases at the market.
examples.zh: 我忘了记下在市场买东西的钱，所以「现金支出」看起来很少。

examples.en: I record cash spending at the end of each day while I still remember it.
examples.zh: 我每天结束前趁还记得，把当天的「现金支出」记下来。

words.enDefinition: the maximum cash that can be taken out within a stated period

examples.en: I looked up the cash withdrawal limit before leaving for the class field trip.
examples.zh: 出发参加课程实地考察前，我查了「取现限额」。

examples.en: The bank confirmed that my cash withdrawal limit would stay the same after graduation.
examples.zh: 银行确认我毕业后「取现限额」仍保持不变。

words.enDefinition: assign something you bought to a spending group

examples.en: I don't know how to categorize a purchase that includes both food and stationery.
examples.zh: 一张小票上既有食品又有文具，我不知道怎么「给这笔消费分类」。

examples.en: The app can categorize a purchase automatically, but it sometimes gets campus cafés wrong.
examples.zh: 应用可以自动「给一笔消费分类」，只是有时会把校园咖啡馆的消费分错。

words.enDefinition: a US bank savings product for a fixed term

examples.en: I saw certificate of deposit listed among the savings products on the American bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在那家美国银行的网站上看到，「美国定期存单」被列为一种储蓄产品。

examples.en: The bank showed where my certificate of deposit would appear on the account dashboard.
examples.zh: 银行告诉我，我的「定期存单」会在账户界面的哪里显示。

collocations: the maturity date of a certificate of deposit

words.enDefinition: a document from a tax authority confirming tax residency for a specified period

examples.en: The international office explained who issued the certificate of tax residence in our example.
examples.zh: 国际学生办公室解释了例子中的「税收居民身份证明」由谁签发。

examples.en: I asked what period the certificate of tax residence on the screen covered.
examples.zh: 我问屏幕上的「税收居民身份证明」涵盖哪段时间。

collocations: request a certificate of tax residence
issue a certificate of tax residence
provide a certificate of tax residence

words.enDefinition: a statement the bank has formally confirmed as authentic

examples.en: I asked whether the office wanted a certified bank statement or would accept the online copy.
examples.zh: 我问办公室，需要的是「经银行认证的对账单」，还是网上下载的副本也行。

examples.en: The branch printed the certified bank statement after I confirmed which month I needed.
examples.zh: 我确认了要哪个月的之后，网点打印了「经银行认证的对账单」。

collocations: a copy of the certified bank statement

words.enDefinition: to confirm officially that a person is enrolled at a school or on a course

examples.en: The agency asked the university to certify enrollment before releasing the second payment.
examples.zh: 资助机构要求学校先「核证注册状态」，才发放第二笔款项。

examples.en: I asked which office could certify enrollment for the study period on my form.
examples.zh: 我问哪个办公室能为表格上那段就读期「核证注册状态」。

collocations: ask the school to certify enrollment

words.enDefinition: to move an existing account to a different account category

examples.en: The branch explained how to change the account type after my student status ended.
examples.zh: 网点解释了学生身份结束后怎样「变更账户类型」。

examples.en: I asked if I could change the account type without getting a new account number.
examples.zh: 我问是否能在保留原账号的情况下「变更账户类型」。

collocations: ask to change the account type
agree to change the account type
apply to change the account type

words.expression: change your name on the account
words.lemma: change your name on the account
words.enDefinition: to replace the name registered on your bank account
acceptedEnVariants: change your name on the account

examples.en: The form explains how to change your name on the account after a legal name change.
examples.zh: 表格说明，法定姓名变更后如何「变更账户登记姓名」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “You can ask to change your name on the account at the branch.”
examples.zh: 顾问说：“你可以到网点申请「变更账户登记姓名」。”

collocations: ask to change your name on the account
apply to change your name on the account
documents to change your name on the account

words.enDefinition: a reversal of a card payment through a formal issuer dispute

examples.en: The bank explained what a chargeback meant after my order never arrived.
examples.zh: 订单一直没送到后，银行解释了什么叫「银行卡交易拒付」。

examples.en: The merchant replied to the chargeback and supplied a copy of the shipping record.
examples.zh: 商户回应了「银行卡交易拒付」，并提供了一份发货记录副本。

words.enDefinition: the latest date allowed for requesting a chargeback

examples.en: I asked the issuer to confirm the chargeback deadline for this particular purchase.
examples.zh: 我请发卡机构确认这一笔消费的「拒付申请截止日」。

examples.en: The chargeback deadline was written at the top of the bank's message.
examples.zh: 「拒付申请截止日」写在银行消息的顶部。

words.enDefinition: an account used for everyday deposits and payments

examples.en: I linked my checking account to the university's payment portal after confirming my details.
examples.zh: 确认账户资料后，我把「日常结算账户」关联到了学校的付款平台。

examples.en: The branch gave me a checklist for opening a checking account near my college.
examples.zh: 学校附近的网点给了我一份开立「日常结算账户」的材料清单。

words.enDefinition: a webpage where customers review a purchase and enter payment details

examples.en: My address was shown on the checkout page next to the delivery option.
examples.zh: 「结账页面」在送货选项旁显示了我的地址。

examples.en: I checked the order total on the checkout page before buying my train ticket.
examples.zh: 买火车票前，我在「结账页面」核对了订单总额。

words.enDefinition: payment by reading a card chip and entering its PIN

examples.en: The café's terminal offered chip and PIN after my first attempt was declined.
examples.zh: 我第一次付款被拒后，咖啡馆的终端提示可用「芯片加密码付款」。

examples.en: My friend asked what chip and PIN meant on the sign at checkout.
examples.zh: 朋友问收银台标牌上的「芯片加密码付款」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a device that reads a card through its embedded chip

examples.en: The cashier said the chip reader was working at the next register.
examples.zh: 收银员说，另一台收银机的「芯片卡读取器」能用。

examples.en: I used the chip reader after the contactless option did not appear.
examples.zh: 没显示非接触选项，我便改用了「芯片卡读取器」。

words.enDefinition: to report an amount on a tax form to reduce the income or amount taxed

examples.en: The example shows where a student might claim a deduction on the form.
examples.zh: 例子说明学生可能会在表格的哪个位置「申报扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked what records the guide mentioned for people who claim a deduction.
examples.zh: 我问指南提到，「申报扣除额」的人需要哪些材料。

collocations: claim a deduction on a return

words.enDefinition: to request a reduction in tax owed by reporting an eligible credit

examples.en: The example shows where someone would claim a tax credit on the form.
examples.zh: 示例说明了可以在表格哪个位置「申报税额抵免」。

examples.en: I asked whether the guide explains how to claim a tax credit for tuition.
examples.zh: 我问指南有没有说明怎样「申报税额抵免」来抵扣符合条件的学费。

collocations: eligible to claim a tax credit
claim a tax credit on a return
claim a tax credit for tuition

words.enDefinition: to end a bank account so it cannot be used

examples.en: I asked whether I could close an account at the branch next to campus.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在校区旁边的网点「注销账户」。

examples.en: The help page explained how to close an account without visiting my original branch.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明了不去原网点也可以怎样「注销账户」。

words.enDefinition: An account that is no longer open for new activity

examples.en: The closed account still appeared on my report with its original opening date.
examples.zh: 「已关闭账户」仍在我的报告中，并显示原开户日期。

examples.en: I asked why the closed account was shown as active on one report.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有一份报告把这个「已关闭账户」标成了有效。

words.enDefinition: A person who signs a loan and shares responsibility for repayment

examples.en: The form included a separate signature line for each co-borrower.
examples.zh: 表格为每位「共同借款人」都单独留了一栏签名。

examples.en: The bank sent a copy of the statement to each co-borrower.
examples.zh: 银行给每位「共同借款人」都发了一份账单副本。

words.enDefinition: A written message about a debt being pursued for payment

examples.en: The collection notice showed a different balance from the one on my last statement.
examples.zh: 「催收通知」列出的欠款金额与我上一期账单不同。

examples.en: I put the collection notice in a folder with the loan agreement and receipts.
examples.zh: 我把「催收通知」与贷款协议和收据一起放进文件夹。

words.enDefinition: a bank principally serving a local geographic area

examples.en: I took my university letter to the community bank across from the station.
examples.zh: 我带着学校的信去了车站对面那家「社区银行」。

examples.en: The community bank posted its holiday hours on the door before the semester ended.
examples.zh: 学期结束前，「社区银行」把假期营业时间贴到了门上。

collocations: an account at a community bank

words.enDefinition: check what different sellers charge for the same thing

examples.en: I wanted to compare prices before buying the same winter coat my flatmate had.
examples.zh: 我想先「比较价格」，再买一件和室友一样的冬外套。

examples.en: We always compare prices across two supermarkets before doing a big shop together.
examples.zh: 我们一起大量采购之前，总会先「比一比两家超市的价格」。

words.enDefinition: An Australian annualized rate combining loan interest with most fees

examples.en: The Australian leaflet showed a comparison rate beside the advertised interest rate.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚这份宣传册把「含费比较利率」列在广告利率旁边。

examples.en: I asked which fees the comparison rate included in the lender's example.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构的例子里，「含费比较利率」包括哪些费用。

collocations: comparison rate for a personal loan

words.enDefinition: a transfer marked by the provider as having finished processing

examples.en: The app showed a completed transfer, so I asked what that status covered.
examples.zh: 应用显示「已完成的转账」，我就问这个状态具体指什么。

examples.en: The university asked me to send the receipt for the completed transfer.
examples.zh: 学校请我发去这笔「已完成的转账」的收据。

collocations: a receipt for a completed transfer

words.enDefinition: an award that is made subject to specified conditions being met

examples.en: The university explained what I still needed to do for the conditional award.
examples.zh: 大学说明了这项「附条件的资助」还有哪些要求需要我满足。

examples.en: My conditional award depended on finishing the required number of credits that term.
examples.zh: 我得修满那个学期要求的学分，才能获得这项「附条件的资助」。

collocations: the terms of a conditional award

words.enDefinition: a UK service that checks the name against account details

examples.en: The UK bank showed a Confirmation of Payee result before I reached the final screen.
examples.zh: 我进入最后一个页面之前，英国的银行显示了「英国收款人姓名核对」的结果。

examples.en: I asked what Confirmation of Payee meant on the bank's explanation page.
examples.zh: 我问银行说明页上的「英国收款人姓名核对」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a card that can pay without insertion into a reader

examples.en: My bank sent a contactless card when it replaced the one I lost.
examples.zh: 我的卡丢了，银行补寄来一张「非接触式银行卡」。

examples.en: I used a contactless card at the campus café before my morning lecture.
examples.zh: 我早课前在校园咖啡馆用「非接触式银行卡」付了款。

words.enDefinition: indicating that contactless use is turned off for a card

examples.en: The app showed contactless disabled after I checked the card settings at lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭时我查看了银行卡设置，应用显示「非接触支付已停用」。

examples.en: I asked why the new card was marked contactless disabled on the settings screen.
examples.zh: 我问新卡为什么在设置页面上标了「非接触支付已停用」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount allowed under specified contactless payment rules

examples.en: I asked whether our bank's contactless limit applied to phone payments as well.
examples.zh: 我问银行的「非接触支付限额」是否也适用于手机支付。

examples.en: The app has a page showing the contactless limit for each of my cards.
examples.zh: 应用有一页会显示我每张卡的「非接触支付限额」。

words.enDefinition: a curved-wave symbol showing a device or card supports contactless use

examples.en: I looked for the contactless symbol on the reader near the shop entrance.
examples.zh: 我在商店入口旁的读卡器上找「非接触支付标志」。

examples.en: The cashier pointed out the contactless symbol on the new terminal before I paid.
examples.zh: 我付钱前，收银员指出了新终端上的「非接触支付标志」。

words.enDefinition: The amount paid into savings on one occasion

examples.en: I changed the contribution amount after my weekly shifts went down from three to two.
examples.zh: 我每周上班的次数从三次减到两次后，就调整了「每次存入的金额」。

examples.en: Does the app show the contribution amount before I confirm the scheduled transfer?
examples.zh: 这个应用会在我确认定期转账前显示「每次存入的金额」吗？

words.enDefinition: A plan specifying when amounts are added

examples.en: The contribution schedule shows dates through the end of the summer holiday.
examples.zh: 「定期存入安排」列出了直到暑假结束的所有日期。

examples.en: Nico adjusted his contribution schedule so the transfer would follow his new payday.
examples.zh: 尼科调整了「定期存入安排」，让转账在他新的发薪日之后进行。

words.enDefinition: the amount stated after applying a currency exchange rate

examples.en: I checked the converted amount in the quote before reviewing the fees.
examples.zh: 我先核对报价上的「兑换后金额」，然后才看手续费用。

examples.en: The app displayed the converted amount beside the original transfer amount.
examples.zh: 应用在原转账金额的旁边显示了「兑换后金额」。

collocations: the converted amount on the quote

words.enDefinition: a new version of a payslip with one or more errors fixed

examples.en: A corrected payslip appeared in my account after payroll reviewed the missing shift.
examples.zh: 薪资部门核查漏算的班次后，我的账号里出现了一张「更正后的工资单」。

examples.en: I kept the corrected payslip and moved the old one into a separate folder.
examples.zh: 我留存了「更正后的工资单」，把原来的那张移到了另一个文件夹。

words.enDefinition: the address designated for official letters and notices

examples.en: My correspondence address stayed the same while I spent one semester in another city.
examples.zh: 我到另一个城市学习一学期期间，「通信地址」没有变。

examples.en: The clerk checked that the correspondence address matched the one on my application.
examples.zh: 工作人员核对了「通信地址」，确认它和申请表上的一致。

collocations: send mail to the correspondence address

words.enDefinition: a lender's agreement to remove a cosigner's responsibility for a loan

examples.en: The lender explained which section of the form was for a cosigner release.
examples.zh: 放贷机构说明了表格哪一栏用来申请「解除共同签署义务」。

examples.en: The letter confirmed approval of the cosigner release for the private student loan.
examples.zh: 这封信确认，私人机构学生贷款的「解除共同签署义务」申请获批。

words.enDefinition: a school's estimated total cost for attending during a period, including tuition and expected expenses

examples.en: The university included an estimate for transport in the cost of attendance for commuters.
examples.zh: 大学在通勤学生的「就读总费用估算」里列了交通费用预估。

examples.en: I compared the cost of attendance for living on campus and renting nearby.
examples.zh: 我比较了住校和在附近租房的「就读总费用估算」。

collocations: include expenses in the cost of attendance

words.enDefinition: the general cost of meeting everyday needs in a place

examples.en: I noticed the cost of living was higher near my placement than near campus.
examples.zh: 我发现实习地点附近的「生活成本」比学校附近高。

examples.en: The cost of living matters as much as the tuition when I compare universities.
examples.zh: 我比较学校时，「生活成本」和学费一样重要。

words.enDefinition: the purchase price divided by how often something is used

examples.en: My sister calculated the cost per use before buying a waterproof coat for her commute.
examples.zh: 姐姐买通勤防水外套前，先算了算「每次使用成本」。

examples.en: The secondhand textbook had a low cost per use because I needed it all year.
examples.zh: 那本二手教材我一整年都要用，所以「每次使用成本」很低。

words.enDefinition: A formal request to borrow money or obtain a credit account

examples.en: I saved my credit application as a draft while looking for a recent payslip.
examples.zh: 我在找最近的工资单时，把「信贷申请」存成了草稿。

examples.en: The lender sent an email asking about one field on my credit application.
examples.zh: 贷款机构发来邮件，询问我「信贷申请」中的一项信息。

words.enDefinition: money returned when payments and credits exceed the charges on a student's account

examples.en: The university sent my credit balance refund after the scholarship covered the outstanding fees.
examples.zh: 奖学金抵扣剩余费用后，学校发出了我的「账户结余退款」。

examples.en: I could see the credit balance refund as a separate transaction on my account.
examples.zh: 我能在账户里看到单列的一笔「账户结余退款」。

words.enDefinition: A loan designed primarily to help establish a repayment record

examples.en: The US credit union explained how its credit builder loan appeared on credit reports.
examples.zh: 这家美国信用合作社解释了它的「信用记录建立贷款」如何显示在信用报告中。

examples.en: I asked what would happen to the funds under the credit builder loan agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按「信用记录建立贷款」协议，这笔资金会怎么处理。

collocations: payments on a credit builder loan

words.enDefinition: An organization that collects and shares records about people's borrowing

examples.en: The credit bureau asked which account I was disputing before opening the case.
examples.zh: 「征信机构」立案前先问我对哪个账户有异议。

examples.en: I found the credit bureau listed at the bottom of the letter.
examples.zh: 我在信的末尾找到了列出的「征信机构」。

collocations: dispute information with a credit bureau

words.enDefinition: A periodic summary of card transactions, charges, payments, and amounts owed

examples.en: I downloaded my credit card statement to check when the refund had been posted.
examples.zh: 我下载了「信用卡账单」，查看退款哪天入账。

examples.en: The agent found the charge near the bottom of my credit card statement.
examples.zh: 客服在我的「信用卡账单」接近底部的位置找到了那笔扣款。

words.enDefinition: Guidance on credit, debt, and managing regular repayments

examples.en: The campus adviser gave me the number for a credit counseling service.
examples.zh: 学校顾问把一家「信用与债务咨询」服务的电话给了我。

examples.en: My credit counseling session covered the dates and balances on my statements.
examples.zh: 在「信用与债务咨询」时，顾问和我一起核对了账单上的日期和金额。

words.enDefinition: A restriction on access to credit information for new applications

examples.en: The US bureau confirmed the credit freeze after I noticed an unfamiliar application.
examples.zh: 我发现一份陌生的申请后，美国的征信机构确认了「信用报告冻结」。

examples.en: I asked whether the credit freeze affected how I viewed my own report online.
examples.zh: 我问「信用报告冻结」是否会影响我在网上查看自己的报告。

words.enDefinition: A record of how someone has borrowed and repaid money

examples.en: My credit history back home did not appear in the local lender's records.
examples.zh: 我在老家的「信用记录」没有出现在当地贷款机构的档案里。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I already had a credit history in this country.
examples.zh: 顾问问我在这个国家是否已有「信用记录」。

words.enDefinition: A request made to access someone's credit information

examples.en: I recognized the credit inquiry because I had applied for a card that morning.
examples.zh: 我认得这次「征信查询」，因为那天上午我申请过信用卡。

examples.en: Each credit inquiry on my report showed a company name and a date.
examples.zh: 我的报告中，每次「征信查询」都列有公司名称和日期。

words.enDefinition: A change that raises the maximum amount a person can borrow

examples.en: The notice about my credit limit increase came with a new card agreement.
examples.zh: 关于「信用额度上调」的通知和一份新信用卡协议一起寄来了。

examples.en: The representative asked whether I had requested the credit limit increase shown on my account.
examples.zh: 客服问账户里显示的「信用额度上调」是否是我申请的。

words.enDefinition: The variety of borrowing accounts in a person's credit record

examples.en: The chart grouped my loans and cards together under the heading credit mix.
examples.zh: 图表把我的贷款和信用卡都归在「信贷类型组合」这一栏。

examples.en: A credit card and an installment loan were both included in her credit mix.
examples.zh: 她的「信贷类型组合」既有信用卡，也有分期贷款。

words.enDefinition: Regular tracking of changes in someone's borrowing information or score

examples.en: The credit monitoring service notified me when a new account appeared on my report.
examples.zh: 报告上出现新账户时，「信用记录监测」服务通知了我。

examples.en: My bank's page described credit monitoring and showed what kinds of changes it tracks.
examples.zh: 银行的页面介绍了「信用记录监测」，并列出可监测哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: A document summarizing a person's borrowing and repayment record

examples.en: I checked my credit report for accounts I did not recognize after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我查看了自己的「信用报告」，看看有没有不认识的账户。

examples.en: Her credit report showed a loan she had paid off two years earlier.
examples.zh: 她的「信用报告」上显示了一笔她两年前就已还清的贷款。

words.enDefinition: A formal challenge to information listed in a borrowing record

examples.en: My credit report dispute concerned a late payment that the lender had recorded by mistake.
examples.zh: 我提交的「信用报告异议」涉及一笔被贷款机构误记的逾期还款。

examples.en: I saved the case number after submitting a credit report dispute through the bureau's website.
examples.zh: 我在征信机构网站提交「信用报告异议」后，保存了案件编号。

words.enDefinition: The lowest and highest values allowed by a scoring system

examples.en: The credit score range is printed near the explanation of what each number means.
examples.zh: 「信用评分范围」印在各个分数的含义说明旁边。

examples.en: We checked the credit score range because the two reports used different scoring systems.
examples.zh: 两份报告采用了不同的评分体系，所以我们核对了「信用评分范围」。

collocations: fall within the credit score range
the top of the credit score range

words.enDefinition: A method that turns borrowing information into a numerical score

examples.en: The lender explained which credit scoring model it used when assessing applications for small loans.
examples.zh: 贷款机构解释了审核小额贷款申请时使用哪种「信用评分模型」。

examples.en: The reports use the same data but each uses a different credit scoring model.
examples.zh: 两份报告采用相同的数据，但各自使用不同的「信用评分模型」。

words.enDefinition: a financial institution owned by its members

examples.en: The campus credit union sent me a link to its account opening form.
examples.zh: 校园的「信用合作社」发给我一个链接，指向它的开户表。

examples.en: I asked a friend whether the credit union had a branch near the new library.
examples.zh: 我问朋友，「信用合作社」在新图书馆附近有没有网点。

collocations: open an account with a credit union

words.enDefinition: The percentage of a revolving credit limit currently in use

examples.en: My report explained my credit utilization ratio beside the balances and limits of my cards.
examples.zh: 报告在信用卡余额和额度旁解释了我的「信用额度使用率」。

examples.en: I asked which balances had been used to calculate the credit utilization ratio shown online.
examples.zh: 我问网上显示的「信用额度使用率」是用哪些余额算出来的。

words.enDefinition: added to the amount recorded in your account by the bank

examples.en: The notification read “credited to your account,” so I checked the new statement.
examples.zh: 通知写着「已记入你的账户」，所以我查看了新的对账单。

examples.en: Once the amount is credited to your account, you can see it on your statement.
examples.zh: 款项「已记入你的账户」后，就可以在对账单上看到。

collocations: a payment credited to your account
check whether it was credited to your account

words.zhGloss: 高校非联邦资助申请表
