words.enDefinition: a College Board application used by some institutions to award their own financial aid
acceptedZhAnswers: 高校非联邦资助申请表

examples.en: The US college listed the CSS Profile separately from its federal aid form.
examples.zh: 美国那所学院把「高校非联邦资助申请表」和联邦助学表格分开列出。

examples.en: I asked the aid office whether the CSS Profile applied to my program.
examples.zh: 我问资助办公室，我选的项目是否使用「高校非联邦资助申请表」。

words.enDefinition: the exchange of an amount from one currency into another

examples.en: The receipt listed a separate line for the currency conversion.
examples.zh: 收据上单独列了一行「币种兑换」。

examples.en: I asked which provider would handle the currency conversion for my payment.
examples.zh: 我问哪家服务商会处理我的付款所需的「币种兑换」。

words.enDefinition: a charge for changing a payment amount from one currency to another

examples.en: The statement lists a currency conversion fee beside my bookstore purchase abroad.
examples.zh: 账单在我国外书店的消费旁列了一笔「货币兑换手续费」。

examples.en: I asked how the currency conversion fee was displayed in the app.
examples.zh: 我问「货币兑换手续费」在应用中是怎么显示的。

words.enDefinition: The amount currently owed based on activity posted to an account

examples.en: I compared the current balance in the app with last month's printed statement.
examples.zh: 我把应用里的「当前欠款余额」与上月的纸质账单做了比较。

examples.en: A refund appeared this morning and changed the current balance on my card.
examples.zh: 今天上午一笔退款入账，改变了信用卡的「当前欠款余额」。

words.enDefinition: a tip amount entered manually instead of choosing a preset

examples.en: The tablet let me leave a custom tip rather than choose a percentage.
examples.zh: 平板允许我填「自定小费金额」，不用选预设比例。

examples.en: I checked the custom tip amount before confirming the payment at the counter.
examples.zh: 在柜台确认付款前，我核对了「自定小费金额」。

words.enDefinition: a number a bank uses to identify a customer

examples.en: The bank said my customer number was different from the number on my account.
examples.zh: 银行说我的「客户编号」和账户上的号码不一样。

examples.en: I found the customer number on the welcome letter the branch had sent me.
examples.zh: 我在网点寄来的欢迎信上找到了「客户编号」。

words.enDefinition: reduce what you spend on things you do not need

examples.en: I tried to cut unnecessary spending by bringing coffee instead of buying it on campus.
examples.zh: 我试着自己带咖啡去学校，免得在学校买，以「削减不必要的开支」。

examples.en: We had to cut unnecessary spending to afford the train tickets for our field trip.
examples.zh: 我们得「削减不必要的开支」，才能买得起实地考察要用的火车票。

collocations: look for ways to cut unnecessary spending

words.enDefinition: Calculation of interest separately for each day

examples.en: The representative explained the daily interest calculation using the balance shown on my first statement.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员用我第一份账单上的余额，解释了「按日计息」的方式。

examples.en: I checked the daily interest calculation against the example in the savings account guide.
examples.zh: 我对照储蓄账户指南里的示例核对了「按日计息」的方法。

collocations: the basis for daily interest calculation

words.enDefinition: The rate applied to a balance when calculating daily interest

examples.en: The US card agreement listed the daily periodic rate under a section about interest.
examples.zh: 这份美国信用卡协议在利息一节列出了「日计息利率」。

examples.en: I asked what the daily periodic rate on the last page was used for.
examples.zh: 我问最后一页的「日计息利率」是用来做什么的。

words.enDefinition: the most that can be spent on purchases in one day

examples.en: The student account summary shows a daily purchase limit for my debit card.
examples.zh: 学生账户摘要列出了我的借记卡「单日消费上限」。

examples.en: We checked the daily purchase limit after the large stationery order was declined.
examples.zh: 大笔文具订单被拒之后，我们核对了「单日消费上限」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum sum or number of transfers permitted in a day

examples.en: I asked the bank whether the daily transfer limit shown applied to my account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，页面上显示的「每日转账限额」是否适用于我的账户。

examples.en: The website explained where to check a daily transfer limit for an overseas payment.
examples.zh: 网站说明了到哪里查询海外付款的「每日转账限额」。

collocations: ask about the daily transfer limit

words.enDefinition: The number of days since a payment became overdue

examples.en: The table showed the days past due in a column next to the unpaid amount.
examples.zh: 表格把「逾期天数」列在未付金额旁边。

examples.en: My statement listed the days past due from the last bill, which I had already paid.
examples.zh: 我的账单仍显示上一期的「逾期天数」，但那期我已经付过了。

words.enDefinition: a card that draws payments directly from a bank account

examples.en: I used my debit card to buy a notebook from the campus shop.
examples.zh: 我用「借记卡」在学校商店买了本笔记本。

examples.en: The bank sent me a debit card after I opened my student account.
examples.zh: 学生账户开好后，银行寄给我一张「借记卡」。

words.enDefinition: A company that contacts people to recover money owed

examples.en: The debt collection agency sent a letter with a balance and the original lender's name.
examples.zh: 「债务催收机构」寄来一封信，写着欠款金额和原贷款机构的名称。

examples.en: I asked the debt collection agency which of my accounts its letter referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「债务催收机构」，来信指的是我的哪个账户。

collocations: refer a debt to a debt collection agency
letter from a debt collection agency

words.enDefinition: Combining multiple debts into a single account or repayment arrangement

examples.en: The adviser explained debt consolidation using three balances from a sample statement.
examples.zh: 顾问用示例账单中的三笔欠款解释了「债务合并」。

examples.en: I asked which debts the debt consolidation offer would cover under its terms.
examples.zh: 我问按这份「债务合并」方案的条款，它能涵盖哪些债务。

words.enDefinition: The share of monthly gross income taken by debt payments

examples.en: The guide explained why each monthly debt payment counted toward the debt-to-income ratio.
examples.zh: 指南解释了为何每笔每月的还债款项都计入「债务收入比」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which income figures went into the debt-to-income ratio shown there.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了界面显示的「债务收入比」涉及哪些收入数据。

words.enDefinition: A US collection notice giving debt information and dispute rights

examples.en: The US collector's debt validation notice named the company it said I owed.
examples.zh: 美国催收机构的「债务核实通知」写明了它声称我欠款的公司。

examples.en: I read the instructions for disputing the balance in the debt validation notice.
examples.zh: 我看了「债务核实通知」里对余额提出异议的说明。

words.enDefinition: to decide against accepting a proposed loan as part of an offer

examples.en: The portal asked why I wanted to decline a loan from my aid offer.
examples.zh: 平台问我为什么要「拒绝接受贷款」，也就是资助通知里列的这笔借款。

examples.en: I checked whether I could decline a loan without losing the grant listed above it.
examples.zh: 我核实了能否「拒绝接受贷款」，同时保留上一行列出的助学金。

collocations: decline a loan in the portal

words.enDefinition: the explanation for why a payment did not go through

examples.en: The clerk said only the bank could tell me the decline reason for my payment.
examples.zh: 办事员说，只有银行能告诉我这笔「付款被拒原因」。

examples.en: The app showed the decline reason next to the attempted purchase at the bookshop.
examples.zh: 应用在书店消费尝试旁显示了「付款被拒原因」。

words.enDefinition: Money kept separately for a specified purpose

examples.en: Maya has dedicated savings for her language course and keeps them in a separate pot.
examples.zh: 玛雅把语言课程的费用作为「专项储蓄」，放在单独的储蓄分区里。

examples.en: I used a separate label in the app for my dedicated savings for language classes.
examples.zh: 我在应用里单独加了个标签，标明这笔是语言课的「专项储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: a cost that applicable rules allow a taxpayer to subtract in a tax calculation

examples.en: The tutor gave an example of a deductible expense on a practice form.
examples.zh: 导师在练习表上举了一个「可扣除支出」的例子。

examples.en: I asked whether the brochure defined deductible expense on another page of the guide.
examples.zh: 我问那本手册是不是在别的页面定义了「可扣除支出」。

words.enDefinition: a short identifier used to specify a kind of amount withheld from pay

examples.en: The deduction code on my payslip was explained in the staff handbook.
examples.zh: 员工手册对我工资单上的「扣款代码」作了解释。

examples.en: The clerk asked me to read out the deduction code beside that amount.
examples.zh: 办事员请我读出那笔金额旁边的「扣款代码」。

words.enDefinition: the card chosen automatically when several cards are available

examples.en: My phone used the default card when I paid at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我在校园咖啡馆付款时，手机用了「默认付款卡」。

examples.en: I checked the default card before leaving the campus shop with my books.
examples.zh: 带着刚买的教材离开校内商店前，我核对了「默认付款卡」。

words.enDefinition: the payment option selected automatically unless another is chosen

examples.en: The checkout used my default payment method when I booked the coach ticket.
examples.zh: 订长途客车票时，结账系统用了我的「默认付款方式」。

examples.en: I checked which card was my default payment method before renewing the subscription.
examples.zh: 续订之前，我核对了哪张卡是我的「默认付款方式」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer taking longer than originally expected to reach its destination

examples.en: The provider texted me an update about the delayed transfer during my tutorial.
examples.zh: 我上辅导课时，服务商发短信更新了「延迟到账的转账」的情况。

examples.en: I asked whether the delayed transfer had a revised arrival estimate yet.
examples.zh: 我问「延迟到账的转账」有没有更新预计到账时间。

collocations: a notice about a delayed transfer

words.enDefinition: a loan whose borrower has missed a scheduled payment and has not caught up

examples.en: The report marked a delinquent loan even though the latest payment had been sent.
examples.zh: 尽管最新一笔还款已发出，报告仍标记了一笔「拖欠还款的贷款」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what could bring the delinquent loan back into good standing.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了怎样才能使「拖欠还款的贷款」恢复到正常还款状态。

words.enDefinition: financial need established using information about costs and available resources

examples.en: The program assessed demonstrated financial need using the budget and supporting documents I submitted.
examples.zh: 项目根据我提交的预算和证明材料确定「经核定的资助需求」。

examples.en: The award criteria mention demonstrated financial need as well as academic progress.
examples.zh: 奖励标准既提到了「经核定的资助需求」，也提到了学业进展。

words.enDefinition: a grant to help a student with the cost of arranging care for a child or other dependent

examples.en: The dependent care grant covered part of the nursery fees during my evening classes.
examples.zh: 「受抚养人照护补助」支付了我上晚课期间一部分托儿费。

examples.en: I asked which documents to send with the application for a dependent care grant.
examples.zh: 我问申请「受抚养人照护补助」要附哪些材料。

collocations: apply for a dependent care grant
eligibility for a dependent care grant

words.enDefinition: a student classified as dependent under an aid program's rules, often requiring parental financial information

examples.en: The US worksheet used a dependent student to show where parental income was entered.
examples.zh: 美国的计算表用「受抚养学生」的案例展示了父母收入填在哪儿。

examples.en: The guide explains when someone counts as a dependent student for that aid program.
examples.zh: 指南解释了在该资助项目中，哪些情况下某人算「受抚养学生」。

collocations: classify someone as a dependent student

words.enDefinition: A record acknowledging the terms and amount deposited

examples.en: The deposit confirmation arrived by email after the bank received my initial payment.
examples.zh: 银行收到我最先存入的钱后，通过邮件发来了「存款确认单」。

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name on the deposit confirmation before saving the file.
examples.zh: 保存文件前，我核对了「存款确认单」上自己名字的拼写。

collocations: the reference on the deposit confirmation

words.enDefinition: Arrangements protecting eligible deposits if a bank fails

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained which accounts were covered by deposit protection in that country.
examples.zh: 银行的传单说明了哪些账户受当地「存款保障」制度保护。

examples.en: The eligibility notes mention deposit protection near the end of the product information sheet.
examples.zh: 产品资料末尾的资格说明提到了「存款保障」。

words.enDefinition: The maximum amount covered by a protection scheme

examples.en: The information sheet lists the deposit protection limit next to the scheme's contact details.
examples.zh: 资料页在保障计划的联系方式旁列出了「存款保障上限」。

examples.en: I checked which deposit protection limit the leaflet referred to after reading the account summary.
examples.zh: 读完账户概览后，我核实了传单里指的是哪项「存款保障上限」。

words.enDefinition: a form listing details of money paid into an account

examples.en: The teller handed back my deposit slip after correcting the date I had written.
examples.zh: 柜员改正我填的日期后，把「存款单」还给了我。

examples.en: I checked the account number on the deposit slip before giving it to the teller.
examples.zh: 把「存款单」交给柜员之前，我核对了上面的账号。

collocations: a copy of the deposit slip

words.enDefinition: The agreed length of time for a deposit

examples.en: The confirmation gives the deposit term in months and the final date in full.
examples.zh: 确认单注明了以月为单位的「存款期限」和完整的到期日期。

examples.en: The form let me select a deposit term from several options listed down the page.
examples.zh: 表格在页面上列出几个选项，让我选择「存款期限」。

collocations: the end of the deposit term

words.enDefinition: software that stores payment details for electronic use

examples.en: I added my new card to the digital wallet before travelling to class.
examples.zh: 去学校上课之前，我把新卡加进了「数字钱包」。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether our digital wallet supported payments at that particular terminal.
examples.zh: 收银员问我们用的「数字钱包」支持那台终端付款吗。

collocations: add a card to a digital wallet

words.enDefinition: To use some savings to cover a cost

examples.en: I had to dip into savings when my bike needed a new wheel.
examples.zh: 自行车得换轮子时，我不得不「动用少量储蓄」。

examples.en: Mina hoped she wouldn't need to dip into savings for the textbooks this term.
examples.zh: 米娜希望这学期买教材时不用「动用少量储蓄」。

collocations: avoid having to dip into savings

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦贴息学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan for eligible undergraduates on which the government pays interest during specified periods
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦贴息学生贷款

examples.en: My US aid offer listed the Direct Subsidized Loan under undergraduate funding options.
examples.zh: 我的美国资助通知把「美国联邦贴息学生贷款」列在本科资助选项下。

examples.en: The adviser explained why interest was not added to that Direct Subsidized Loan during enrolment.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了为什么在读期间，那笔「美国联邦贴息学生贷款」没有新增利息。

collocations: qualify for a Direct Subsidized Loan
interest on a Direct Subsidized Loan

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦非贴息学生贷款
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan on which the borrower is responsible for interest from disbursement
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦非贴息学生贷款

examples.en: I found the Direct Unsubsidized Loan listed separately on my American aid offer.
examples.zh: 我发现美国的资助通知把「美国联邦非贴息学生贷款」单独列出。

examples.en: The balance of my Direct Unsubsidized Loan included interest from while I was studying.
examples.zh: 我的「美国联邦非贴息学生贷款」余额包含在校期间的利息。

collocations: interest on a Direct Unsubsidized Loan

words.enDefinition: financial assistance for eligible students' costs connected with disability or access needs

examples.en: The disability-related grant helped me pay for accessible course materials this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期，「残障相关助学金」补贴了无障碍课程资料的费用。

examples.en: The office explained which expenses the disability-related grant could cover during my studies.
examples.zh: 办公室说明了我就读期间，「残障相关助学金」能覆盖哪些开支。

words.enDefinition: to release money that has been allocated for a payment or purpose

examples.en: The office said it would disburse funds after it had checked enrolment records.
examples.zh: 办公室说，核对注册记录后会「发放款项」。

examples.en: I asked whether the program would disburse funds in one or two payments.
examples.zh: 我问该项目会分一笔还是两笔「发放款项」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which loan or aid money is or will be released

examples.en: I checked the disbursement date before asking the office about the late payment.
examples.zh: 我先查了「款项发放日期」，再去问办公室款项为什么没按时到账。

examples.en: The email listed a new disbursement date for the winter term award.
examples.zh: 邮件里写了冬季学期资助新的「款项发放日期」。

words.enDefinition: a list of dates or intervals for releasing money to a recipient

examples.en: The disbursement schedule shows when each of the three payments will reach my account.
examples.zh: 「款项发放时间表」列出了三笔款项分别什么时候到我的账户。

examples.en: I saved the disbursement schedule alongside the email that confirmed my funding amount.
examples.zh: 我把「款项发放时间表」和确认资助金额的邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: spending on things you can choose to go without

examples.en: I reduced my discretionary spending by going to fewer concerts this term.
examples.zh: 我这学期少听了几场音乐会，以减少「可选消费支出」。

examples.en: The chart puts streaming and cinema tickets under discretionary spending for this month.
examples.zh: 这张图把流媒体订阅和电影票列在本月的「可选消费支出」里。

words.enDefinition: income left after taxes and mandatory contributions are paid

examples.en: My disposable income went up after I started taking weekend shifts at the café.
examples.zh: 开始在咖啡馆上周末班后，我的「可支配收入」增加了。

examples.en: The survey asks about disposable income before it asks how much students spend on rent.
examples.zh: 这份问卷先问学生的「可支配收入」，再问他们在房租上花多少钱。

words.enDefinition: to formally question a charge on a card account

examples.en: I asked the bank how to dispute a card charge I did not recognise.
examples.zh: 我问银行，怎么「对卡片扣款提出异议」，那笔交易我认不出来。

examples.en: The adviser explained which documents could help me dispute a card charge.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了哪些文件有助于我「对卡片扣款提出异议」。

collocations: decide to dispute a card charge
contact the bank to dispute a card charge
ask how to dispute a card charge

words.enDefinition: An item whose accuracy or validity someone has formally challenged

examples.en: My disputed entry remained visible while the company investigated its source and accuracy.
examples.zh: 在公司调查来源和准确性期间，我那条「有异议的记录」仍然可见。

examples.en: The bureau's email listed the disputed entry by account name and date.
examples.zh: 征信机构在邮件中列出了这条「有异议的记录」的账户名称和日期。

words.enDefinition: a review of documents for completeness or accuracy

examples.en: The document check took longer because my name was spelled differently on two forms.
examples.zh: 两张表上我的名字拼法不同，所以「材料查验」耗时更久。

examples.en: The employee returned my paperwork once the document check was complete that morning.
examples.zh: 当天上午「材料查验」结束后，工作人员把文件还给了我。

words.enDefinition: the process of sending a file to a website

examples.en: The website showed a document upload in progress and asked me to wait on that page.
examples.zh: 网站显示正在「上传材料」，让我先留在当前页面。

examples.en: I tried the document upload again after the bank sent me a fresh link.
examples.zh: 银行发来一个新链接后，我又尝试了「上传材料」。

words.enDefinition: a card payment processed within the same country as the card

examples.en: The statement listed a domestic card payment for the books I ordered locally.
examples.zh: 账单把我在本地订书的款项列为「境内银行卡付款」。

examples.en: I asked which currency was shown for a domestic card payment on my account.
examples.zh: 我问账户上的「境内银行卡付款」会显示哪种货币。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of funds within the same country

examples.en: I checked whether the form was for a domestic transfer before entering any details.
examples.zh: 我填写资料前，确认了这份表格是不是用于「境内转账」的。

examples.en: The bank showed the domestic transfer on a separate page from my overseas payments.
examples.zh: 银行把这笔「境内转账」和我的海外付款分开显示。

words.enDefinition: a message about an account becoming or being classed dormant

examples.en: I opened the dormancy notice and checked which account the bank was referring to.
examples.zh: 我打开「账户休眠通知」，看银行说的是哪个账户。

examples.en: The dormancy notice had been sent to the address I used as a student.
examples.zh: 「账户休眠通知」寄到了我上学时用的地址。

words.enDefinition: an account classified as unused for a sustained period

examples.en: The bank described my old account as a dormant account after years without activity.
examples.zh: 账户多年没有动过，银行把它归为「休眠账户」。

examples.en: I called the branch to ask what a dormant account meant in their notice.
examples.zh: 我打电话给网点，问通知里说的「休眠账户」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: taxation of the same income or underlying amount twice, often by different jurisdictions

examples.en: The lecturer drew two arrows to illustrate double taxation in the sample case.
examples.zh: 讲师画了两个箭头，说明案例中的「双重征税」。

examples.en: Our handout introduced double taxation before discussing tax treaties in the next section.
examples.zh: 讲义先介绍「双重征税」，下一节才讲税收协定。

words.enDefinition: switch to a cheaper service with fewer features

examples.en: The website showed how to downgrade a plan without losing access before the renewal date.
examples.zh: 网站上说明了怎样「换成低档套餐」，同时保留续订日期前的使用权限。

examples.en: I wanted to downgrade a plan I'd bought for a course that had already ended.
examples.zh: 我之前为了上课买了一个套餐，现在课结束了，想「换成低档套餐」。

words.enDefinition: To reduce savings by using them over time

examples.en: I had to draw down savings while I looked for another job near campus.
examples.zh: 在学校附近找下一份工作的那段时间，我不得不「逐步消耗储蓄」。

examples.en: We began to draw down savings as the break between placements grew longer.
examples.zh: 两段实习之间的空档越来越长，我们开始「逐步消耗储蓄」。

collocations: draw down savings over several months
draw down savings during a period without work

words.enDefinition: a second card charge for the same purchase

examples.en: I noticed a duplicate card charge after checking my receipts from the café.
examples.zh: 核对咖啡馆的收据后，我发现了一笔「重复扣款」。

examples.en: The shop asked for both order numbers to look into the duplicate card charge.
examples.zh: 商店要了两个订单号，来调查是不是发生了「重复扣款」。

words.enDefinition: a second payment that repeats the same intended transfer

examples.en: I called the bank because the two entries looked like a duplicate transfer.
examples.zh: 这两条记录看起来像「重复转账」，我就给银行打了电话。

examples.en: The support agent compared the references before identifying a duplicate transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 客服先对照了编号，然后确认账单上有一笔「重复转账」。

words.enDefinition: to submit a tax return through an approved electronic system

examples.en: The clinic showed us how the confirmation looks after people e-file a return.
examples.zh: 税务咨询点给我们看了「电子报税」后收到的确认信息是什么样的。

examples.en: I asked whether I could e-file using the software shown at the workshop.
examples.zh: 我问能不能用讲座演示的软件「电子报税」。

words.enDefinition: Paying back some or all borrowed money before scheduled dates

examples.en: The agreement had a short section about early repayment near the back.
examples.zh: 协议快到末尾的地方有一小节讲「提前还款」。

examples.en: I asked the lender whether early repayment changed the remaining payment schedule.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构，「提前还款」是否会改变剩余还款计划。

words.enDefinition: Taking money out before a specified date

examples.en: The bank's letter said that an early withdrawal was possible on this particular deposit.
examples.zh: 银行的信说，这一笔存款可以「提前支取」。

examples.en: Did the app show your early withdrawal separately from your scheduled interest payment?
examples.zh: 应用有把你的「提前支取」和定期支付的利息分开显示吗？

collocations: an early withdrawal from a term deposit

words.enDefinition: A charge for taking money out before the agreed date

examples.en: The statement showed an early withdrawal penalty beside the amount returned to my account.
examples.zh: 账单在退回我账户的金额旁标出了「提前支取罚款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the early withdrawal penalty shown in the example applied to my deposit.
examples.zh: 我问示例展示的「提前支取罚款」是否适用于我的存款。

words.enDefinition: To set aside money for a named purpose

examples.en: The student group agreed to earmark funds for travel before confirming its guest speakers.
examples.zh: 学生社团同意先「指定一笔资金用于差旅」，再确认受邀演讲嘉宾。

examples.en: I decided to earmark funds from my summer job for next year's language course.
examples.zh: 我决定把暑期打工的一笔收入「指定用于」明年的语言课程。

words.enDefinition: To gain interest on money held on deposit

examples.en: The representative showed me which deposits could earn interest at the advertised rate.
examples.zh: 银行人员给我看了哪些存款可以按宣传利率「获得利息收益」。

examples.en: I wondered whether my account would still earn interest after the promotional period ended.
examples.zh: 我想知道优惠期结束后，我的账户是否还能「获得利息收益」。

collocations: earn interest from the first day

words.enDefinition: a short label that identifies the kind of pay entered on a wage record

examples.en: The letter beside the amount was an earnings code for evening shifts.
examples.zh: 金额旁边的字母是晚班的「工资项目代码」。

examples.en: The portal included a short list of each earnings code and its meaning.
examples.zh: 平台上有一张简表，列着各个「工资项目代码」及其含义。

words.enDefinition: a savings account allowing withdrawals without a fixed waiting period

examples.en: The website explained the easy access savings account in a separate section for new customers.
examples.zh: 网站为新客户单列了一节，介绍「灵活支取储蓄账户」。

examples.en: I asked when I could view my easy access savings account in the mobile app.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候能在手机应用里看到我的「灵活支取储蓄账户」。

collocations: open an easy access savings account
offer an easy access savings account
an easy access savings account balance

words.enDefinition: the amount planned for meals bought away from home

examples.en: My eating-out budget was nearly gone after three group dinners in the same week.
examples.zh: 同一个星期参加三次聚餐后，我的「外出就餐预算」快花光了。

examples.en: I scaled back my eating-out budget once I found a kitchen I could use on campus.
examples.zh: 找到学校里能用的厨房后，我减少了「外出就餐预算」。

words.enDefinition: total tax as a share of the income or amount used in the calculation

examples.en: The article compared the effective tax rate paid by households in different income groups.
examples.zh: 文章比较了不同收入群体的家庭承担的「实际税率」。

examples.en: We asked which income figure was used to calculate the effective tax rate.
examples.zh: 我们问计算「实际税率」时用的是哪个收入数字。

words.enDefinition: a statement provided as a digital document

examples.en: I downloaded the electronic statement after finding the right month in my account dashboard.
examples.zh: 我在账户界面找到正确的月份后，下载了「电子对账单」。

examples.en: The bank sent a message when my electronic statement became available on its website.
examples.zh: 「电子对账单」可以在银行网站查看时，银行发来了消息。

words.enDefinition: Deposits that meet a protection scheme's requirements

examples.en: The protection leaflet lists eligible deposits in a table beside the main exclusions.
examples.zh: 保障传单在主要除外项目旁边用表格列出「符合保障条件的存款」。

examples.en: I asked the bank where I could find the official list of eligible deposits.
examples.zh: 我问银行在哪里能找到「符合保障条件的存款」的正式清单。

collocations: cover eligible deposits up to a limit

words.enDefinition: Physical cash kept available for urgent situations

examples.en: We took some emergency cash for the bus in case the card reader wasn't working.
examples.zh: 我们带了一点坐公交用的「应急现金」，以防刷卡机用不了。

examples.en: My aunt keeps emergency cash in the house for times when the power goes out.
examples.zh: 我姨妈在家留了点「应急现金」，以备停电时用。

words.enDefinition: A cost arising from an urgent situation

examples.en: The urgent flight home was the only emergency expense I had that term.
examples.zh: 紧急飞回家的机票，是我那学期唯一一笔「紧急开支」。

examples.en: I wrote down the emergency expense beside the amount I had left in savings.
examples.zh: 我在剩余存款金额旁记下了这笔「紧急开支」。

words.enDefinition: Money set aside for unexpected urgent needs

examples.en: I used my emergency fund when I had to replace a broken laptop during finals.
examples.zh: 期末考试期间不得不换掉坏掉的笔记本时，我动用了「应急储备金」。

examples.en: She added to her emergency fund once her work hours returned to normal.
examples.zh: 工作时长恢复正常后，她又往「应急储备金」里存了些钱。

words.enDefinition: short-term financial support awarded to a student facing an urgent expense or financial problem

examples.en: The university offered an emergency student grant after my temporary housing fell through.
examples.zh: 我的临时住处没着落后，学校提供了「学生紧急助学金」。

examples.en: The email explained which costs the emergency student grant was designed to cover.
examples.zh: 邮件解释了「学生紧急助学金」用来支付哪些费用。

collocations: apply for an emergency student grant

words.enDefinition: Costs of travel that must be arranged urgently

examples.en: There was enough in my travel pot to cover emergency travel expenses that weekend.
examples.zh: 那个周末，我的旅行储蓄分区里有足够的钱支付「紧急出行费用」。

examples.en: My family helped with emergency travel expenses after I had to fly home unexpectedly.
examples.zh: 我临时不得不飞回家，家里帮我承担了一部分「紧急出行费用」。

words.enDefinition: money and other compensation received from working as an employee

examples.en: The job at the bookstore was my only source of employment income that winter.
examples.zh: 那年冬天，书店的工作是我唯一的「受雇收入」来源。

examples.en: The annual slip shows my employment income from one of my campus jobs.
examples.zh: 年结单上有我一份校内工作的「受雇收入」。

words.enDefinition: to move into the period when payments on a loan become due

examples.en: The two loans will enter repayment on different dates according to the notices.
examples.zh: 根据通知，两笔贷款会在不同日期「进入还款阶段」。

examples.en: I asked when the account would enter repayment after the school updated my records.
examples.zh: 我问学校更新我的记录后，这个账户什么时候「进入还款阶段」。

words.enDefinition: an information session or module explaining loan terms and obligations before a student borrows

examples.en: The school showed me where to find entrance counseling in the student portal.
examples.zh: 学校指给我看了学生平台上「首次借款前贷款说明」的位置。

examples.en: The entrance counseling module included a section about keeping track of what I borrowed.
examples.zh: 「首次借款前贷款说明」里有一节讲怎样记下自己借了哪些款项。

words.enDefinition: dividing money into separate envelopes for different types of spending

examples.en: I tried envelope budgeting with labelled envelopes for groceries, transport, and evenings out.
examples.zh: 我试了试「信封预算法」，把买菜、交通和晚间聚会的钱分别装进贴好标签的信封。

examples.en: Digital envelope budgeting helped me see what was left for food after my weekly shop.
examples.zh: 用电子版「信封预算法」，我能看到每周采购后还能在吃的方面花多少钱。

words.enDefinition: a price expressed as a monthly amount for comparison

examples.en: The equivalent monthly cost was lower, but I would have to pay upfront for the year.
examples.zh: 「折合每月费用」更低，但我得先一次付清全年的钱。

examples.en: I calculated the equivalent monthly cost before choosing between two annual gym plans.
examples.zh: 选健身房的两个年度方案之前，我先算了「折合每月费用」。

words.enDefinition: spending on things you need for daily life

examples.en: My bursary covers essential spending such as groceries and bus trips to campus.
examples.zh: 我的助学金够付买菜、坐公交去学校等「必要支出」。

examples.en: We worked out how much essential spending we had before planning the weekend away.
examples.zh: 我们计划周末出游前，先算了算有多少「必要支出」。

words.enDefinition: the sum a provider expects the recipient to get

examples.en: The quote showed the estimated amount received after the listed deductions.
examples.zh: 报价显示了扣除列出的费用后的「预计实收金额」。

examples.en: I asked how the estimated amount received differed from the original transfer amount.
examples.zh: 我问「预计实收金额」和原转账金额有什么区别。

collocations: an estimated amount received in local currency

words.enDefinition: a payment made during a tax year based on the amount of tax expected to be due

examples.en: A worksheet in the US tax guide showed how an estimated tax payment was recorded.
examples.zh: 美国税务指南里的一张表展示了怎样记录一笔「预缴税款」。

examples.en: The illustration shows where to enter an estimated tax payment made in April.
examples.zh: 图示标明了四月的「预缴税款」应该记在哪里。

words.enDefinition: cash in the precise amount needed for a purchase

examples.en: The notice asks for exact change when paying for the campus shuttle.
examples.zh: 通知说坐校园班车时请用「正好的零钱」付款。

examples.en: I counted out the exact change before joining the queue for the market stall.
examples.zh: 排到集市摊位的队里之前，我数出了「正好的零钱」。

words.enDefinition: a pricing margin included in a rate relative to a benchmark

examples.en: The support page explained what the provider called an exchange rate markup.
examples.zh: 帮助页面解释了服务商所说的「汇率加价」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked where the transfer quote showed the exchange rate markup.
examples.zh: 我问转账报价上哪里显示了「汇率加价」。

collocations: an exchange rate markup on a quote

words.enDefinition: a statement giving an offered or estimated conversion rate

examples.en: I asked how long the exchange rate quote would stay on the screen.
examples.zh: 我问「汇率报价」会在那个页面显示多久。

examples.en: The bank sent me an exchange rate quote with the transfer estimate.
examples.zh: 银行连同转账预估，给我发来了一份「汇率报价」。

collocations: the expiry of an exchange rate quote

words.enDefinition: the difference between quoted buying and selling rates for currencies

examples.en: The provider's guide showed how it described an exchange rate spread.
examples.zh: 服务商指南展示了他们如何解释「买卖汇率价差」。

examples.en: I asked which two displayed rates made up the exchange rate spread.
examples.zh: 我问页面上显示的哪两个汇率构成「买卖汇率价差」。

collocations: the size of an exchange rate spread

words.enDefinition: an information session or module covering a student borrower's responsibilities and repayment when leaving school

examples.en: I completed exit counseling online after reading the message from the student aid office.
examples.zh: 读完资助办公室的消息后，我在网上完成了「离校前贷款说明」。

examples.en: The exit counseling page included links to my loan balances and repayment information.
examples.zh: 「离校前贷款说明」页面有查看贷款余额和还款信息的链接。

words.enDefinition: the day a transfer is estimated to reach the recipient

examples.en: I shared the expected arrival date with my university's accounts office by email.
examples.zh: 我通过邮件把「预计到账日期」告诉了学校财务办公室。

examples.en: The provider changed the expected arrival date after checking the receiving bank's schedule.
examples.zh: 服务商核实收款银行的安排后，更改了「预计到账日期」。

collocations: an expected arrival date for the transfer

words.enDefinition: a request for an employer or organization to repay money spent for its work

examples.en: I sent an expense claim for the train tickets used during the workshop.
examples.zh: 我提交了「费用报销申请」，报销参加工作坊时用的火车票。

examples.en: The finance assistant found a missing receipt attached to my expense claim.
examples.zh: 财务助理在我的「费用报销申请」附件里找到了那张遗漏的收据。

words.enDefinition: a payment card whose expiry date has passed

examples.en: I accidentally picked the expired card from my wallet when I bought lunch.
examples.zh: 买午饭时，我不小心从钱包里拿出了「已过期的银行卡」。

examples.en: The app marked my expired card separately from the one I use now.
examples.zh: 应用把「已过期的银行卡」和我现在用的卡分开标注了。

words.enDefinition: a repayment plan that gives the borrower a longer period to pay off a loan

examples.en: The extended repayment plan spread those payments over more years in the comparison.
examples.zh: 对比表中，「延长期限还款计划」把这些还款分摊到了更多年份。

examples.en: I asked how the extended repayment plan would appear on a monthly statement.
examples.zh: 我问「延长期限还款计划」会在月度对账单上怎样显示。

collocations: qualify for an extended repayment plan
payments under an extended repayment plan

words.enDefinition: an account held at a different financial institution

examples.en: The app asked which institution held the external account that I wanted to view.
examples.zh: 应用问我，想查看的那个「外部账户」开在哪家机构。

examples.en: I could see the external account separately from accounts held at my new bank.
examples.zh: 我看到「外部账户」和新银行里的账户是分开显示的。

collocations: an external account at another bank

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生资助申请表
words.enDefinition: the Free Application for Federal Student Aid used to apply for US federal student aid
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生资助申请表
acceptedEnVariants: Free Application for Federal Student Aid

examples.en: The US financial aid office confirmed that it had received my FAFSA data.
examples.zh: 美国助学资助办公室确认已收到我的「美国联邦学生资助申请表」数据。

examples.en: I checked which award year my FAFSA was for before making any changes.
examples.zh: 我在更改之前先核对了「美国联邦学生资助申请表」是哪个资助年度的。

collocations: make a correction to your FAFSA

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生资助申请摘要
words.enDefinition: a US record summarizing information and preliminary aid calculations after a FAFSA has been processed
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生资助申请摘要

examples.en: My FAFSA Submission Summary showed that one of my contact fields was incomplete.
examples.zh: 我的「美国联邦学生资助申请摘要」显示，有一项联系方式没有填完整。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to compare the FAFSA Submission Summary with the school's offer.
examples.zh: 顾问让我把「美国联邦学生资助申请摘要」与学校的资助通知核对。

words.enDefinition: a money transfer that did not go through as intended

examples.en: I kept the failed transfer notice when I contacted my bank for help.
examples.zh: 我向银行求助时，把「失败的转账」通知留了下来。

examples.en: The app showed a failed transfer without saying what had caused the problem.
examples.zh: 应用显示有一笔「失败的转账」，但没说是什么原因。

words.enDefinition: To save less than planned by a point in time

examples.en: I began to fall behind on saving when the café reduced its opening hours.
examples.zh: 咖啡店缩短营业时间后，我的「储蓄进度开始落后」了。

examples.en: Did you fall behind on saving for the course during the exam period?
examples.zh: 考试期间，你为课程存钱的「进度落后」了吗？

collocations: start to fall behind on saving
fall behind on saving for college
fall behind on saving during a break

words.enDefinition: a saving that seems sensible but costs more in the end

examples.en: Buying the cheapest shoes was a false economy because I had to replace them within two months.
examples.zh: 买最便宜的鞋是「省小钱花大钱」，不到两个月我就换了一双。

examples.en: Skipping the bike service turned out to be a false economy when the chain broke.
examples.zh: 自行车链条断了，我才发现不做保养是「省小钱花大钱」。

collocations: turn out to be a false economy

words.enDefinition: money sent to relatives, often across national borders

examples.en: The student accounts office asked how I had received the family remittance.
examples.zh: 学生财务办公室问我是怎样收到这笔「家庭汇款」的。

examples.en: I saved the receipt for the family remittance with the other term records.
examples.zh: 我把「家庭汇款」的收据和这个学期的其他账目放在一起留存。

words.enDefinition: money or help with costs provided by family members

examples.en: I listed family support separately because my parents only help with groceries and books.
examples.zh: 我把「家人经济支持」单独列出来，因为爸妈只帮我付买菜和买书的钱。

examples.en: It's harder to take an unpaid placement without family support for rent and food.
examples.zh: 如果「家里不帮忙负担」房租和伙食费，就更难去做无薪实习。

words.enDefinition: a UK system for sending electronic payments between participating accounts

examples.en: My UK bank listed Faster Payments as an option when I reviewed the payment.
examples.zh: 我核对付款时，英国的银行把「英国快速支付系统」列为可选方式之一。

examples.en: I asked how a transfer sent by Faster Payments would appear on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问通过「英国快速支付系统」转出的款会怎样显示在账单上。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by the federal government of a country

examples.en: The US payslip listed federal income tax on a line above state deductions.
examples.zh: 那张美国工资单在州级扣款上面一行列了「联邦所得税」。

examples.en: Our workshop used a Canadian example to show where federal income tax appeared.
examples.zh: 讲座用一个加拿大的例子展示「联邦所得税」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: a student loan provided through a federal government program

examples.en: The US workshop used a federal student loan to explain how the account works.
examples.zh: 美国讲座用一笔「联邦学生贷款」来解释这个账户怎样运作。

examples.en: I checked which organization manages the federal student loan shown in my account.
examples.zh: 我查了账号里显示的「联邦学生贷款」由哪个机构管理。

collocations: apply for a federal student loan
eligibility for a federal student loan

words.enDefinition: a Federal Reserve service for settling individual wire transfers

examples.en: The U.S. bank said the payment had gone through Fedwire that morning.
examples.zh: 美国的银行说，款项当天上午通过「美联储电汇系统」处理了。

examples.en: I asked which number on the bank notice was the Fedwire reference.
examples.zh: 我问银行通知上的哪个数字是「美联储电汇系统」的编号。

words.enDefinition: a listing showing the components of a total fee

examples.en: I downloaded the fee breakdown before filing the transfer receipt with my records.
examples.zh: 把转账收据归档前，我先下载了「手续费明细」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fee breakdown included fees from the receiving bank.
examples.zh: 我问「手续费明细」是否包含入账银行收的费用。

words.enDefinition: approval to move a fee payment to a later date without waiving the charge

examples.en: I requested a fee deferral because my aid would arrive after the deadline.
examples.zh: 助学资助要在截止日过后才到账，所以我申请了「费用缓缴」。

examples.en: The fee deferral notice showed when the remaining tuition payment would be due.
examples.zh: 「费用缓缴」通知写明了剩余学费要在什么时候缴清。

words.enDefinition: in this context, a bank account with no regular maintenance fee

examples.en: The branch listed a fee-free account next to its standard account options for students.
examples.zh: 网点在标准学生账户选项旁列出了一款「免管理费账户」。

examples.en: I asked which services were included in the fee-free account described in the booklet.
examples.zh: 我问小册子里的「免管理费账户」包含哪些服务。

collocations: compare a fee-free account with another option

words.enDefinition: to send a completed tax return to the relevant authority

examples.en: I asked whether students could file a tax return through the campus clinic.
examples.zh: 我问学生能不能通过学校的税务咨询点「提交纳税申报表」。

examples.en: The orientation guide listed places where students can get help to file a tax return.
examples.zh: 迎新指南列出了可帮助学生「提交纳税申报表」的地点。

collocations: file a tax return on time
prepare to file a tax return

words.enDefinition: an acknowledgment that a filing has been received or accepted at a processing stage

examples.en: I kept my filing confirmation with the final version of the tax return.
examples.zh: 我把「申报回执」和最终版纳税申报表保存在一起。

examples.en: The filing confirmation appeared on the screen shortly after I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我提交表格后没多久，屏幕就显示了「申报回执」。

words.enDefinition: extra time granted to submit a required filing, such as a tax return

examples.en: The leaflet explains how a filing extension changes the date the return is due.
examples.zh: 说明单介绍了「报税延期」会怎样改变税表的提交日期。

examples.en: I asked whether the filing extension applied to both forms in the case study.
examples.zh: 我问案例中的「报税延期」是否对两张表都适用。

collocations: a filing extension for a return

words.enDefinition: in the US, a category based largely on marital and family circumstances that affects tax filing

examples.en: The US tax workshop compared the filing status shown on two sample returns.
examples.zh: 美国税务讲座对比了两张税表样本上的「报税身份类别」。

examples.en: I asked which page of the handbook explained the available filing status categories.
examples.zh: 我问手册在哪一页介绍可用的「报税身份类别」。

words.enDefinition: the last wage payment a person receives from an employer after leaving a job

examples.en: My final paycheck from the summer job arrived after classes had started.
examples.zh: 开学后，我才收到暑期工作发的「最后一笔工资」。

examples.en: I kept the email showing when my final paycheck had been processed.
examples.zh: 我留着那封邮件，上面写了「最后一笔工资」的处理日期。

words.enDefinition: The cost of borrowing, including interest and certain other charges

examples.en: The disclosure listed a finance charge beside the amount I planned to borrow.
examples.zh: 披露文件在我计划借款的金额旁列出了「信贷费用」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which fees the finance charge included for this loan.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了这笔贷款的「信贷费用」包括哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: a person who helps students understand funding choices, eligibility and application records

examples.en: The financial aid adviser explained which documents were still missing from my file.
examples.zh: 「助学资助顾问」说明了我的档案还缺哪些材料。

examples.en: I booked an appointment with a financial aid adviser after receiving the revised bill.
examples.zh: 收到更新的账单后，我预约了「助学资助顾问」。

collocations: meet with a financial aid adviser
speak to a financial aid adviser

words.enDefinition: a formal request to reconsider a decision about a student's financial aid

examples.en: I attached the dates from my original decision letter to the financial aid appeal.
examples.zh: 我在「助学资助复核申请」里附上了原决定信上的日期。

examples.en: The school said a different panel would review my financial aid appeal next week.
examples.zh: 学校说，下周将由另一个小组审核我的「助学资助复核申请」。

collocations: a decision on a financial aid appeal

words.enDefinition: a request or form submitted to be considered for financial support as a student

examples.en: I saved my financial aid application because I still needed one income document.
examples.zh: 我先存了「助学资助申请」，因为还差一份收入材料。

examples.en: The portal showed when the financial aid application had been received by the office.
examples.zh: 平台显示了办公室收到「助学资助申请」的时间。

words.enDefinition: the status of meeting requirements to receive a particular kind of student aid

examples.en: The office reviewed my financial aid eligibility after I changed my course load.
examples.zh: 我调整了选课量之后，办公室复核了我的「助学资助资格」。

examples.en: The guide has a table showing how enrolment affects financial aid eligibility in this program.
examples.zh: 指南用一张表说明了注册情况怎样影响该项目的「助学资助资格」。

words.enDefinition: an administrative flag that delays processing or payment of a student's aid until an issue is resolved

examples.en: The portal listed a financial aid hold after the office requested a new document.
examples.zh: 办公室要求补交材料后，平台显示「助学资助暂缓处理」。

examples.en: I asked how long the financial aid hold would remain after I submitted the form.
examples.zh: 我问交表以后，「助学资助暂缓处理」的状态还会持续多久。

words.enDefinition: a notification listing the types and amounts of aid offered to a student

examples.en: The financial aid offer arrived in my portal a week after my admission letter.
examples.zh: 录取信到了一周后，我在平台上收到了「助学资助通知」。

examples.en: I asked which parts of the financial aid offer required a separate response.
examples.zh: 我问「助学资助通知」里的哪些项目需要单独回复。

collocations: respond to a financial aid offer

words.enDefinition: a school office that administers financial assistance for students

examples.en: The financial aid office checked why the grant was missing from my account.
examples.zh: 「助学资助办公室」核查了我的账户里为什么没有那笔助学金。

examples.en: I sent the requested document to the financial aid office before Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 我在周五下午前把要求的材料发给了「助学资助办公室」。

words.enDefinition: the combination of grants, scholarships, loans or work opportunities offered to a student

examples.en: My financial aid package included an institutional grant and an offer of student employment.
examples.zh: 我的「整套助学资助」包括学校助学金和一个学生工作机会。

examples.en: I compared the grants and loans in each university's financial aid package before deciding.
examples.zh: 作决定之前，我比较了各大学「整套助学资助」里有哪些助学金和贷款。

words.enDefinition: a status that allows certain students to receive aid temporarily while meeting a plan or conditions

examples.en: My approval letter explained the conditions of financial aid probation for the coming term.
examples.zh: 批准信说明了下学期「助学资助考察期」的条件。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to check the end date of my financial aid probation.
examples.zh: 顾问让我核对「助学资助考察期」的结束日期。

collocations: be placed on financial aid probation
receive aid during financial aid probation

words.enDefinition: a review that checks information on a student's aid application against supporting records

examples.en: My financial aid verification was pending because the school still needed one document.
examples.zh: 我的「助学资助资料核实」还没完成，因为学校还缺一份材料。

examples.en: I asked which figures the office was checking during financial aid verification this week.
examples.zh: 我问办公室这周做「助学资助资料核实」时在核对哪些数字。

words.enDefinition: An urgent situation requiring money immediately

examples.en: I kept the reserve for a financial emergency while we waited for work to resume.
examples.zh: 等工作恢复的那段时间，我把这笔储备留着应对「紧急财务状况」。

examples.en: A family financial emergency meant I had to change my travel plans over the summer.
examples.zh: 家里出现「紧急财务状况」，我只好改变暑假的出行计划。

words.enDefinition: an organization that provides banking or other financial services

examples.en: The application asked for the name of the financial institution where my account was held.
examples.zh: 申请表要求我填上开户的「金融机构」名称。

examples.en: I called the financial institution listed at the top of my account opening letter.
examples.zh: 我打电话给开户信函顶端列出的「金融机构」。

collocations: open an account with a financial institution

words.enDefinition: An event that puts someone's finances behind

examples.en: Losing the weekend job was a financial setback just before my first tuition payment.
examples.zh: 第一次缴学费前丢了周末的工作，是一次「财务挫折」。

examples.en: The repair bill was a financial setback, so I moved my savings deadline back a month.
examples.zh: 维修账单带来了一次「财务挫折」，于是我把存钱的期限推迟了一个月。

words.enDefinition: A sudden event that significantly disrupts one's finances

examples.en: Losing most of my shifts in November was a financial shock I hadn't expected.
examples.zh: 十一月大部分班次都没了，这成了我没料到的「突发的财务冲击」。

examples.en: The car breakdown was a financial shock because we had just paid for the move.
examples.zh: 我们刚付完搬家费，车就坏了，带来了「突发的财务冲击」。

words.enDefinition: a choice to give up one financial benefit for another

examples.en: There was a financial trade-off between paying higher rent and spending less on transport.
examples.zh: 付更高的房租还是少花交通费，要做个「金钱上的取舍」。

examples.en: I explained the financial trade-off to my brother before choosing a cheaper phone plan.
examples.zh: 我先跟弟弟讲了「金钱上的取舍」，才选了便宜点的手机套餐。

collocations: a financial trade-off between two options

words.enDefinition: regular expenses whose amounts stay roughly the same

examples.en: I listed my fixed expenses first because my phone plan costs the same every month.
examples.zh: 我先列了「固定支出」，因为手机套餐每月都是同一个价。

examples.en: Once I cover my fixed expenses, I know what is left for nights out.
examples.zh: 付完「固定支出」，我就知道晚上出去玩还能花多少钱。

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money on which the contracted rate remains the same

examples.en: With this fixed-rate loan, the stated interest rate stays the same throughout the term.
examples.zh: 这笔「固定利率贷款」的约定利率在整个期限内保持不变。

examples.en: The quote for a fixed-rate loan arrived with a table of scheduled payments.
examples.zh: 「固定利率贷款」的报价和一份定期还款表一同发来。

words.enDefinition: A savings interest rate that stays the same

examples.en: The letter confirmed a fixed savings rate for the full term of my deposit.
examples.zh: 信里确认，我这笔存款在整个存期内采用「固定储蓄利率」。

examples.en: The product page put the fixed savings rate below the name of the account.
examples.zh: 产品页面把「固定储蓄利率」放在账户名称下方。

collocations: a fixed savings rate for the full term

words.enDefinition: a deposit held for a period agreed in advance

examples.en: I checked the date on my fixed-term deposit before writing it into my calendar.
examples.zh: 我查了「固定期限存款」的日期，再把它记到日历里。

examples.en: The bank sent me a separate statement for the fixed-term deposit last month.
examples.zh: 银行上个月单独给我发了一份「固定期限存款」的账单。

words.enDefinition: a transfer charge stated as a set amount

examples.en: The provider listed a fixed transfer fee next to the delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 服务商在预计到账时间旁边列了「固定转账手续费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the fixed transfer fee changed for a different delivery option.
examples.zh: 我问换一种到账方式，「固定转账手续费」会不会变。

collocations: a fixed transfer fee per transaction

words.enDefinition: money provided specifically to cover the cost of food

examples.en: The course gives us a small food allowance on days we work off campus.
examples.zh: 课程安排我们到校外工作时，会给我们一点「伙食补助」。

examples.en: I asked whether the food allowance would cover dinner on the last fieldwork day.
examples.zh: 我问「伙食补助」包不包括实地考察最后一天的晚饭。

words.enDefinition: income received from sources outside the country or jurisdiction in question

examples.en: The example showed foreign income in a separate row from local wages.
examples.zh: 示例把「境外收入」和本地工资分行列出。

examples.en: I asked which currency the form used for the foreign income field.
examples.zh: 我问表格的「境外收入」一栏使用哪种货币。

words.enDefinition: a tax credit allowed for certain taxes paid to another jurisdiction

examples.en: The worksheet listed a foreign tax credit beside the income earned abroad.
examples.zh: 计算表在境外所得旁边列了一笔「境外税额抵免」。

examples.en: The lecturer explained the foreign tax credit in a case about two countries taxing wages.
examples.zh: 讲师用两国同时对工资征税的案例解释了「境外税额抵免」。

words.zhGloss: 美国非居民个人所得税申报表
words.enDefinition: the US federal income tax return used by certain taxpayers classified as nonresident aliens
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国非居民个人所得税申报表

examples.en: The US tax session used a blank Form 1040-NR to show the main sections.
examples.zh: 美国税务说明会用一张空白「美国非居民个人所得税申报表」展示了主要栏目。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer which year the sample Form 1040-NR was for.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，「美国非居民个人所得税申报表」样本是哪一年的。

words.zhGloss: 美国外国人收入与预扣税表
words.enDefinition: a US information form for certain US-source payments to foreign persons and any related tax withheld
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国外国人收入与预扣税表

examples.en: The university told me when Form 1042-S would be available in the student portal.
examples.zh: 学校告诉我什么时候能在学生平台上看到「美国外国人收入与预扣税表」。

examples.en: I asked which scholarship payment the university had reported on Form 1042-S.
examples.zh: 我问学校在「美国外国人收入与预扣税表」上申报的是哪一笔奖学金。

words.enDefinition: a US tuition statement issued by an eligible educational institution for tax reporting purposes

examples.en: The university added Form 1098-T to the account I use for tuition payments.
examples.zh: 学校把「美国学费税务记录表」发到了我用来缴学费的账号里。

examples.en: I asked about a charge that appeared on my bill but not on Form 1098-T.
examples.zh: 我问为什么有一笔费用出现在账单上，却没出现在「美国学费税务记录表」里。

words.enDefinition: a US employer's annual statement of a worker's wages and taxes withheld

examples.en: I downloaded Form W-2 from my former employer's portal after checking the year.
examples.zh: 我核对年份后，从前雇主的平台下载了「美国工资及预扣税表」。

examples.en: The clerk pointed to the box on Form W-2 that listed the wages.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，「美国工资及预扣税表」上哪一格列的是工资。

collocations: request a copy of Form W-2

words.enDefinition: the US form employees use to give employers information for calculating federal income tax withholding

examples.en: The new hire packet included Form W-4 and a note about federal withholding.
examples.zh: 入职资料包里有「美国雇员预扣税表」，附有一份联邦预扣税说明。

examples.en: The onboarding portal labelled Form W-4 separately from the direct deposit form.
examples.zh: 入职平台把「美国雇员预扣税表」和工资直存表分开标注。

words.enDefinition: A credit file notice requesting extra checks of an applicant's identity

examples.en: I asked the US credit bureau what a fraud alert would show to lenders.
examples.zh: 我问美国征信机构，贷款机构会在「欺诈警示」中看到什么。

examples.en: The bureau's message confirmed the fraud alert and gave its start date.
examples.zh: 征信机构的消息确认了「欺诈警示」，并写明开始日期。

words.enDefinition: the order value needed to qualify for no delivery charge

examples.en: I checked the free shipping threshold before adding a pack of paper to my order.
examples.zh: 我先查了「包邮门槛」，才在订单里加了一包纸。

examples.en: Our order reached the free shipping threshold once we both added the books we needed.
examples.zh: 我们各自把要用的书都加进订单后，金额就达到「包邮门槛」了。

words.enDefinition: a limited period of using a service without paying

examples.en: I used the free trial to see whether the app could read my lecture slides.
examples.zh: 我用「免费试用」体验了一下，看这个应用能不能读取我的课件。

examples.en: The free trial ends on Friday, so I've put a reminder in my calendar.
examples.zh: 「免费试用」周五结束，我就在日历里设了个提醒。

collocations: sign up for a free trial

words.enDefinition: to temporarily stop new transactions from being made with a card

examples.en: The bank's app shows where to freeze your card if you cannot find it.
examples.zh: 如果卡找不到了，银行应用会显示在哪里「暂时冻结银行卡」。

examples.en: The guide explains what happens to pending payments when you freeze your card.
examples.zh: 指南说明了「暂时冻结银行卡」后，待处理的付款会怎样。

collocations: use the app to freeze your card

words.enDefinition: a scholarship covering tuition and most or all major costs of attending college, such as room and board

examples.en: The college's full-ride scholarship covered my tuition, residence fees and campus meal plan.
examples.zh: 该学院的「全额就读奖学金」支付了我的学费、宿舍费和校餐计划费用。

examples.en: She asked whether the full-ride scholarship also covered books for the required courses.
examples.zh: 她问「全额就读奖学金」还包不包含必修课的课本费。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that covers all tuition charges while leaving other costs to be paid separately

examples.en: The full-tuition scholarship covered classes, but I still needed funding for rent and meals.
examples.zh: 「全额学费奖学金」付了上课的费用，但房租和餐费还需要另外筹措。

examples.en: I checked whether the full-tuition scholarship applied to the summer courses I planned to take.
examples.zh: 我核实了「全额学费奖学金」是否适用于我打算选的暑期课程。

words.enDefinition: the difference between expected costs and money already available to cover them

examples.en: The revised travel estimate left a small funding gap for my placement abroad.
examples.zh: 新的交通费估算给我的海外实习留下了一小笔「资金缺口」。

examples.en: I calculated the funding gap after the university confirmed my grant for next year.
examples.zh: 学校确认了我下一年的助学金后，我算出了「资金缺口」。

words.enDefinition: the way a sender provides money to pay for a transfer

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm the funding method before reviewing my receipt.
examples.zh: 应用让我先确认「汇款扣款方式」，再查看收据。

examples.en: I asked if a different funding method would change the processing time.
examples.zh: 我问换一种「汇款扣款方式」会不会影响处理时间。

words.enDefinition: the span of time for which funding is provided

examples.en: The funding period for my research award ended before the new semester began.
examples.zh: 我的研究项目的「资助期限」在新学期开学前就结束了。

examples.en: The notice explains which expenses need to fall within the approved funding period.
examples.zh: 通知说明了哪些开支必须发生在获批的「资助期限」内。

words.enDefinition: money in an account is ready to use or withdraw

examples.en: The receipt gave a funds available date separate from the day I paid.
examples.zh: 收据注明了「资金可用」日期，和我付款的日子不一样。

examples.en: I asked the bank what funds available meant on that screen in the app.
examples.zh: 我问银行应用那个页面上的「资金可用」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: money sent but not yet recorded as received at its destination

examples.en: The bank's notice described the amount as funds in transit until processing finished.
examples.zh: 银行通知说，处理结束前这笔钱属于「在途资金」。

examples.en: I asked the university whether it could see the funds in transit on its side.
examples.zh: 我问学校，他们那边能不能看到这笔「在途资金」。

words.enDefinition: manage to live with a limited amount of money

examples.en: I could get by on one shift a week when I lived with family.
examples.zh: 跟家人住的时候，「靠每周上一个班挣的钱就能过日子」。

examples.en: How do students get by on so little when groceries cost this much here?
examples.zh: 这里买菜这么贵，学生怎么「靠这么点钱过日子」？

collocations: get by on a small income

words.enDefinition: benefit enough from something to justify what you paid

examples.en: You get your money's worth from the pass if you take the bus every day.
examples.zh: 如果你每天都坐公交，这张通票就「买得值」。

examples.en: It's hard to get your money's worth from that gym during the exam period.
examples.zh: 考试期间很难把那家健身房的费用「花得值」。

collocations: make sure you get your money's worth
feel like you get your money's worth

words.enDefinition: worth the price because of the quality or quantity

examples.en: The fixed lunch menu is good value for money if you're already near the library.
examples.zh: 如果你就在图书馆附近，这个午餐套餐挺「物有所值」的。

examples.en: A used bike was good value for money compared with paying for buses all year.
examples.zh: 和一整年坐公交的花销比起来，买辆二手自行车「物有所值」。

words.enDefinition: an official identification document containing the holder's photograph

examples.en: The bank employee asked which government-issued photo ID I had brought to the appointment.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员问我赴约时带了哪一种「政府签发的带照证件」。

examples.en: I checked whether the branch accepted my government-issued photo ID before booking a visit.
examples.zh: 约去网点前，我确认了那里是否接受我的「政府签发的带照证件」。

words.enDefinition: a bank account designed for people who recently graduated

examples.en: My bank wrote to me about a graduate account near the end of my final semester.
examples.zh: 最后一个学期快结束时，银行写信给我介绍「毕业生账户」。

examples.en: I asked when the graduate account would appear after the bank changed my status.
examples.zh: 银行改了我的身份状态后，我问「毕业生账户」什么时候会显示。

collocations: the terms of a graduate account

words.zhGloss: 逐步提高金额的还款计划
words.enDefinition: a repayment plan with payments that begin at a lower amount and rise over time
acceptedZhAnswers: 逐步提高金额的还款计划

examples.en: The graduated repayment plan showed higher payments after each step in the schedule.
examples.zh: 「逐步提高金额的还款计划」每调整到下一档，当期还款就会增加。

examples.en: I compared the second year under a graduated repayment plan with the fixed option.
examples.zh: 我把「逐步提高金额的还款计划」第二年的情况与固定金额的方案进行了比较。

collocations: payments on a graduated repayment plan

words.enDefinition: the amount set aside for food and everyday groceries

examples.en: My grocery budget stretches further when I plan meals around what I already have.
examples.zh: 我用家里现有的食材安排三餐，「食品杂货预算」就更经花。

examples.en: We raised our grocery budget after discovering how often we cooked for friends.
examples.zh: 发现我们经常做饭招待朋友后，我们提高了「食品杂货预算」。

words.enDefinition: income from relevant sources before applicable deductions are subtracted

examples.en: The worksheet starts with gross income and lists the adjustments underneath it.
examples.zh: 计算表先列「总收入」，下面再列各项调整。

examples.en: I checked whether the form asked for household gross income or my own.
examples.zh: 我核实了一下，表格问的是家庭「总收入」，还是我个人的。

words.enDefinition: Interest before any tax is deducted

examples.en: My statement showed the gross interest separately from the amount that reached my account.
examples.zh: 账单把「税前利息」和实际到账金额分开列了。

examples.en: I located the gross interest for the year in the bank's annual summary.
examples.zh: 我在银行的年度摘要里找到了这一年的「税前利息」。

words.enDefinition: total employee pay before tax or other amounts are deducted

examples.en: I compared my gross pay with the hours and rates listed above it.
examples.zh: 我把「工资总额」和上面列的工时、工资标准核对了一下。

examples.en: The weekend shift increased my gross pay on this month's statement.
examples.zh: 周末的班次让这月工资单上的「工资总额」多了一些。

words.enDefinition: enrolment at a study load that meets a school's or aid program's threshold for half-time status

examples.en: The aid office explained which courses counted toward half-time enrollment in my program.
examples.zh: 资助办公室说明了我这个项目中哪些课程计入「半时注册」的课业量。

examples.en: My account showed half-time enrollment after the registrar updated my course load for spring.
examples.zh: 教务部门更新春季选课量后，我的账户显示为「半时注册」。

words.enDefinition: A credit check associated with an application that may affect scores

examples.en: I asked if the full application would involve a hard inquiry on my report.
examples.zh: 我问正式申请会不会在我的报告中留下「硬性征信查询」记录。

examples.en: The hard inquiry appeared next to the name of the lender I had contacted.
examples.zh: 这条「硬性征信查询」就列在我联系过的贷款机构名称旁。

collocations: a hard inquiry on your report

words.enDefinition: Adjusted repayment terms agreed because someone cannot meet regular obligations

examples.en: The Australian lender asked how long I needed the hardship arrangement to last.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的贷款机构问我需要这项「财务困难还款安排」持续多久。

examples.en: The letter set out my monthly payments under the hardship arrangement we discussed.
examples.zh: 信里列出了我们讨论过的「财务困难还款安排」下我每月要还的金额。

words.enDefinition: a savings account offering a comparatively high interest rate

examples.en: I asked about the high-yield savings account after seeing it listed on the student portal.
examples.zh: 我在学生平台上看到「高息储蓄账户」后，咨询了相关情况。

examples.en: The account guide listed a high-yield savings account alongside two of the bank's other products.
examples.zh: 账户指南把「高息储蓄账户」和银行另外两款产品列在一起。

collocations: terms of a high-yield savings account

words.enDefinition: the amount set aside on an account before a transaction finishes

examples.en: The hold amount was higher than the final bill for the room.
examples.zh: 房间的「暂时冻结金额」比最终账单还高。

examples.en: I checked the hold amount on my card after returning the hired bike.
examples.zh: 把租来的自行车还回去后，我查看了卡上的「暂时冻结金额」。

words.enDefinition: in the UK payroll sense, pay an employee receives while taking annual leave

examples.en: The holiday pay line on my payslip was for days of paid leave.
examples.zh: 工资单上的「休假工资」一栏对应带薪休假。

examples.en: The UK handbook explains how holiday pay appears on the final payslip.
examples.zh: 英国员工手册解释了「休假工资」在最后一张工资单上的显示方式。

words.enDefinition: the bank branch officially associated with a customer's account

examples.en: I asked whether the home branch would change when I moved for my placement.
examples.zh: 我问搬去实习地以后，「账户归属网点」会不会变。

examples.en: The statement listed my home branch even though I usually used the university branch.
examples.zh: 虽然我平常去大学附近的网点，账单上仍列出了「账户归属网点」。

words.enDefinition: the number of hours someone actually spends working

examples.en: The hours worked on my payslip matched what I entered on Monday.
examples.zh: 工资单上的「实际工作时数」和我周一填写的一致。

examples.en: Our supervisor confirmed the hours worked before sending the records to payroll.
examples.zh: 主管先确认了「实际工作时数」，再把记录发给薪资部门。

words.enDefinition: asks what amount someone can comfortably contribute

examples.en: Before we book the hostel, how much can you spare for the whole weekend?
examples.zh: 订青旅前，先说说整个周末「你能腾出多少钱」？

examples.en: How much can you spare this week if we need to replace the frying pan?
examples.zh: 这周要是得换个平底锅，「你能腾出多少钱」？

collocations: how much can you spare this week?
how much can you spare right now?
how much can you spare for the trip?

words.enDefinition: a standardized identifier for bank accounts in participating countries

examples.en: The university sent an IBAN together with the account holder's name.
examples.zh: 学校同时发来了「国际银行账户号码」和账户持有人姓名。

examples.en: I asked whether the IBAN on my invoice matched the bank's records.
examples.zh: 我问发票上的「国际银行账户号码」是否和银行的记录相符。

words.enDefinition: A document recording that someone used another person's identity unlawfully

examples.en: The bureau asked for the identity theft report when I disputed the unfamiliar loan.
examples.zh: 我对那笔陌生贷款提出异议时，征信机构要求提供「身份盗用报告」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the identity theft report next to the letters from the lender.
examples.zh: 我把「身份盗用报告」的副本和贷款机构的来信放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: checking that someone is who they claim to be

examples.en: The bank sent me to a separate page for identity verification during my application.
examples.zh: 申请时，银行把我引导到一个独立页面做「身份核验」。

examples.en: I asked whether identity verification had finished after the branch received my new documents.
examples.zh: 网点收到了我新交的材料，我就问「身份核验」是否已经完成。

words.enDefinition: something bought suddenly without planning or thinking it through

examples.en: The mug was an impulse buy that I regretted by the time I got home.
examples.zh: 这个马克杯是我「一时冲动买的」，还没到家就后悔了。

examples.en: I kept the receipt because the jacket was an impulse buy after my last exam.
examples.zh: 那件夹克是考完最后一门「一时冲动买的」，所以我留了小票。

words.enDefinition: a payment completed from inside a mobile application

examples.en: I made an in-app payment to book my seat on the airport shuttle.
examples.zh: 我用「应用内付款」预订了去机场的班车座位。

examples.en: The transit service sent a receipt after the in-app payment went through.
examples.zh: 「应用内付款」成功后，公交运营方发来一张收据。

words.enDefinition: verification carried out in person at a bank branch

examples.en: The adviser told me which documents to bring for in-branch verification the following afternoon.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我第二天下午去做「网点现场核验」要带哪些材料。

examples.en: My appointment was for in-branch verification rather than a discussion about different account types.
examples.zh: 我约的是「网点现场核验」，不是咨询不同的账户类型。

words.enDefinition: deferment of payments on an existing student loan specifically because the borrower remains enrolled

examples.en: I asked which existing loans were included in the notice of in-school deferment.
examples.zh: 我问「在读期间延期还款」通知包含哪些旧贷款。

examples.en: The lender sent a confirmation after my request for in-school deferment was approved.
examples.zh: 「在读期间延期还款」申请获批后，放贷机构发来了一份确认信息。

words.enDefinition: a student loan status showing that the borrower is recorded as studying under the program's rules

examples.en: The loan portal still showed in-school status after I had finished my course.
examples.zh: 我读完课程后，贷款平台还是显示「贷款账户在读状态」。

examples.en: The school reported my new study dates so my in-school status could be corrected.
examples.zh: 学校申报了新的就读日期，以便更正我的「贷款账户在读状态」。

words.enDefinition: a payment made at a merchant's physical location

examples.en: The online offer still required an in-store payment when I picked up the books.
examples.zh: 虽然优惠是在网上领的，但取书时仍要「店内付款」。

examples.en: My bank marked the food purchase as an in-store payment because I bought it at the café.
examples.zh: 食物是在咖啡馆买的，我的银行把这笔标成了「店内付款」。

words.enDefinition: small extra costs connected with a main activity

examples.en: I kept ten dollars for incidental expenses like luggage storage at the train station.
examples.zh: 我留了十美元，用来付车站行李寄存之类的「附带杂费」。

examples.en: The field trip handout lists incidental expenses separately from transport and accommodation.
examples.zh: 实地考察手册把「附带杂费」和交通、住宿分开列了。

words.enDefinition: a repayment system in which the amounts due depend on the borrower's income

examples.en: The briefing covered income-contingent repayment alongside a plan with fixed monthly payments.
examples.zh: 说明会同时介绍了「按收入水平还款」和固定月供的方案。

examples.en: The guide illustrates income-contingent repayment using two graduates with different earnings for the year.
examples.zh: 指南以两名年收入不同的毕业生为例介绍了「按收入水平还款」。

words.enDefinition: a group of US federal student loan repayment plans that base payments on income and other factors such as family size

examples.en: The US adviser explained where income-driven repayment appeared in the comparison table.
examples.zh: 美国顾问指明了「美国收入挂钩还款」在对比表里的位置。

examples.en: I saw income-driven repayment listed as a separate heading in the federal loan guide.
examples.zh: 我看到联邦贷款指南把「美国收入挂钩还款」单列为一个标题。

words.enDefinition: A period when regular earnings stop

examples.en: The income interruption lasted until the library reopened and I could take shifts again.
examples.zh: 这次「收入中断」持续到图书馆重新开放，我能再次排班为止。

examples.en: My notes show how much I drew from savings during the income interruption.
examples.zh: 记录显示了我在「收入中断」期间动用了多少存款。

words.enDefinition: a tax on income earned or received by a person or organization

examples.en: The guide explains why income tax and pension contributions appear separately on this payslip.
examples.zh: 指南解释了为什么「所得税」和养老金缴费在这张工资单上是分开列的。

examples.en: I attended an information session about income tax for students with part-time jobs.
examples.zh: 我参加了一场介绍打工学生「所得税」的说明会。

words.enDefinition: Checking documents or records to confirm how much someone earns

examples.en: The lender requested two months of payslips for income verification during my application.
examples.zh: 我申请贷款时，贷款机构要求提交两个月的工资单，用于「收入核实」。

examples.en: The application showed income verification as complete but still listed one missing document.
examples.zh: 申请页面显示「收入核实」已完成，但仍有一份材料没有提交。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent into a specified account from elsewhere

examples.en: My bank sent a message about an incoming transfer while I was at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆的时候，银行发来消息说有一笔「转入款项」。

examples.en: I asked which reference matched the incoming transfer on my statement that morning.
examples.zh: 我问那天早上账单上的「转入款项」对应哪个编号。

words.enDefinition: a bank charge for receiving a wire payment

examples.en: The recipient asked her bank whether it charged an incoming wire fee.
examples.zh: 收款人问她的银行会不会收「电汇入账费」。

examples.en: I asked why the notice included a separate line for the incoming wire fee.
examples.zh: 我问通知为什么单独列了一行「电汇入账费」。

collocations: an incoming wire fee on the statement

words.enDefinition: a student treated as independent for an aid application under the program's eligibility rules

examples.en: The form asked different questions when I selected independent student in the example.
examples.zh: 我在样表上选择「独立学生」后，显示的问题变了。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the program decides whether someone is an independent student.
examples.zh: 顾问说明该项目怎样判定一个人是否属于「独立学生」。

words.enDefinition: an estimated rate shown for guidance without a guaranteed quote

examples.en: The app showed an indicative exchange rate before I asked for the final quote.
examples.zh: 我申请最终报价之前，应用先显示了一个「参考汇率」。

examples.en: I asked what made the indicative exchange rate different from the confirmed rate.
examples.zh: 我问「参考汇率」和已确认的汇率有什么区别。

collocations: an indicative exchange rate on screen

words.enDefinition: a US federal tax processing number for people who need a US taxpayer number and cannot get a Social Security number

examples.en: The volunteer explained why the sample form listed an individual taxpayer identification number.
examples.zh: 志愿者解释了样表为什么列着一个「美国个人纳税识别号」。

examples.en: I heard the term individual taxpayer identification number during a workshop on US forms.
examples.zh: 我在美国税表讲座上听到了「美国个人纳税识别号」这个术语。

collocations: apply for an individual taxpayer identification number
an individual taxpayer identification number application
renew an individual taxpayer identification number

words.enDefinition: to put a payment card into the reader's slot

examples.en: The machine says insert your card when it is ready to take payment.
examples.zh: 机器准备收款时，屏幕会显示「将银行卡插入读卡器」。

examples.en: I did not expect to see "insert your card" on the screen at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时没想到屏幕提示「将银行卡插入读卡器」。

collocations: insert your card into the reader

words.enDefinition: Borrowing repaid in scheduled parts over a set period

examples.en: My car loan appears under installment credit in the summary of my accounts.
examples.zh: 我的汽车贷款列在账户汇总的「分期信贷」一栏。

examples.en: The class compared installment credit with the credit available on a card.
examples.zh: 课堂上比较了「分期信贷」和信用卡提供的额度。

words.enDefinition: a transfer designed to make funds available almost immediately

examples.en: I asked whether the instant transfer option appeared for both of my bank accounts.
examples.zh: 我问我的两个银行账户都会不会显示「即时转账」选项。

examples.en: The app called it an instant transfer, but my roommate checked her account first.
examples.zh: 应用把它叫作「即时转账」，不过我室友还是先查了自己的账户。

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a Canadian financial institution in payment details

examples.en: The guide explained how to find the institution number that identified the bank.
examples.zh: 指南解释了哪个数字是用于识别银行的「加拿大金融机构编号」。

examples.en: I checked the institution number on the details provided by my Canadian university.
examples.zh: 我核对了我在加拿大读的学校给出的资料上的「加拿大金融机构编号」。

words.enDefinition: financial support funded or awarded by the university or college itself

examples.en: The university listed institutional aid separately from government grants on the same page.
examples.zh: 大学在同一个页面上把「学校提供的助学资助」与政府助学金分开列出。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my funding estimate already included institutional aid for the year.
examples.zh: 顾问问，当年资助金额的估算有没有把「学校提供的助学资助」算进去。

words.enDefinition: A deposit covered by a deposit insurance scheme

examples.en: The brochure gives an example showing how an insured deposit appears in the summary.
examples.zh: 宣传册用一个例子展示了「受保险保障的存款」在摘要里是怎么显示的。

examples.en: The student adviser explained why the two brochures used different wording for an insured deposit.
examples.zh: 学生顾问解释了两份宣传册为何对「受保险保障的存款」使用不同表述。

collocations: the balance of an insured deposit

words.enDefinition: a movement of money from one bank to another

examples.en: I asked whether an interbank transfer would have a different reference on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问「跨行转账」在账单上的编号会不会不一样。

examples.en: The app showed that this payment had been sent as an interbank transfer.
examples.zh: 应用显示，这笔付款是通过「跨行转账」发出的。

words.enDefinition: The buildup of interest over time

examples.en: I asked whether interest accrual began on the day the deposit was funded.
examples.zh: 我问「利息累积」是不是从存款到账那天开始。

examples.en: The change didn't affect interest accrual for the period shown on this statement.
examples.zh: 这次变动没有影响账单所列期间的「利息累积」。

words.enDefinition: An amount added to an account for borrowing money

examples.en: The interest charge on this statement was higher than the one last month.
examples.zh: 这期账单的「利息费用」比上个月高。

examples.en: I called to ask why the interest charge was split across two lines.
examples.zh: 我打电话问为什么「利息费用」分成了两行。

collocations: an interest charge on your statement

words.enDefinition: An amount added to an account as interest

examples.en: The interest credit was listed just below my regular transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 账单把「利息入账款项」列在我的定期转账记录下方。

examples.en: I noticed a small interest credit after checking the balance on my phone.
examples.zh: 用手机查余额时，我注意到一笔金额很小的「利息入账款项」。

words.enDefinition: Money a deposit has generated as interest

examples.en: The statement lists the interest earned since I opened the account in March.
examples.zh: 账单列出了我三月开户以来「已赚取的利息」。

examples.en: Can I see the interest earned so far without downloading the monthly statement?
examples.zh: 我能不下载月结单就看到目前「已赚取的利息」吗？

words.enDefinition: A span of time when an eligible balance does not accrue interest

examples.en: The brochure used a calendar to show when the interest-free period ended.
examples.zh: 宣传册用日历标明了「免息期」什么时候结束。

examples.en: I asked whether the card's interest-free period applied to this kind of transaction.
examples.zh: 我问信用卡的「免息期」是否适用于这种交易。

words.enDefinition: How often a deposit's interest is paid

examples.en: The form showed the interest payment frequency next to the interest rate for each product.
examples.zh: 表格在每款产品的利率旁边注明了「利息支付频率」。

examples.en: I asked whether the interest payment frequency could be changed after the account opened.
examples.zh: 我问开立账户以后能否更改「利息支付频率」。

words.enDefinition: a payment of interest to the depositor, which may be paid out separately from the deposit

examples.en: I chose to have the interest payout sent to my current account in May.
examples.zh: 我选择让五月「支付的利息」转入我的活期账户。

examples.en: The bank's email showed the interest payout for the three months before I closed the account.
examples.zh: 银行邮件列出了我销户前三个月「支付的利息」。

words.enDefinition: The highest interest rate allowed by an agreement or rule

examples.en: The agreement described an interest rate cap in the section about future changes.
examples.zh: 协议在介绍未来可能调整的条款中说明了「利率上限」。

examples.en: I asked what the interest rate cap meant for the rate shown on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问「利率上限」对账单上显示的利率意味着什么。

words.enDefinition: A document detailing interest paid or earned

examples.en: I downloaded an interest statement so I could see the total for the year.
examples.zh: 我下载了「利息明细单」，想查看全年的利息总额。

examples.en: The date on the interest statement matched the end of the previous calendar year.
examples.zh: 「利息明细单」上的日期是上一年的年末。

words.enDefinition: a bank that passes the payment onward between institutions

examples.en: The bank explained why an intermediary bank appeared in the transfer record.
examples.zh: 银行解释了转账记录上为什么有一家「中转银行」。

examples.en: I asked which intermediary bank had handled the payment before it reached the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问这笔款项到收款人手里之前由哪家「中转银行」处理过。

words.enDefinition: a charge by a bank forwarding a payment along its route

examples.en: I asked which charge on the receipt was an intermediary bank fee.
examples.zh: 我问收据上哪笔收费是「中转银行手续费」。

examples.en: The support agent explained why there was a separate intermediary bank fee.
examples.zh: 客服解释了为什么会有一笔单独的「中转银行手续费」。

words.enDefinition: money moved between accounts held with the same bank

examples.en: The bank described moving money between my two accounts as an internal transfer.
examples.zh: 银行把在我两个账户之间转钱称为「行内转账」。

examples.en: I checked whether the confirmation referred to the internal transfer I made this morning.
examples.zh: 我确认了通知里说的是不是我今天早上做的那笔「行内转账」。

words.enDefinition: a card payment processed across national borders

examples.en: The app notified me about an international card payment from the exam website.
examples.zh: 应用通知我，考试网站有一笔「跨境银行卡付款」。

examples.en: I checked which exchange rate appeared next to the international card payment on my statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了账单上「跨境银行卡付款」旁显示的是哪个汇率。

words.enDefinition: an account designed for students studying outside their home country

examples.en: The bank sent me a document about its international student account before I arrived.
examples.zh: 我还没到学校，银行就发来了介绍「国际学生账户」的资料。

examples.en: I checked the eligibility information for an international student account on the bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在银行网站查了「国际学生账户」的申请条件。

collocations: ask about an international student account
apply for an international student account
requirements for an international student account

words.enDefinition: a transfer of funds between accounts or people in different countries

examples.en: I asked when my international transfer would appear in the recipient's bank account.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「国际转账」什么时候会显示在收款人的银行账户里。

examples.en: The international transfer confirmation appeared in my mailbox while I was in class.
examples.zh: 我上课的时候，「国际转账」的确认通知进了邮箱。

words.enDefinition: A temporary annualized rate offered when a credit account begins

examples.en: The offer gave an introductory APR and showed when the regular rate would begin.
examples.zh: 报价列出了「首期优惠年利率」，并写明何时开始按常规利率计息。

examples.en: I could see the last day of my introductory APR in the app.
examples.zh: 我能在应用里看到「首期优惠年利率」的最后一天。

words.enDefinition: a special starting price offered to new customers

examples.en: The introductory price looked affordable until I saw what the plan would cost after September.
examples.zh: 「首期优惠价」看着挺便宜，直到我看到九月后套餐要多少钱。
