examples.en: I wrote down the date when the introductory price for the study app would end.
examples.zh: 我记下了学习应用的「首期优惠价」什么时候结束。

words.enDefinition: A promotional rate offered for an initial period

examples.en: My bank showed the end date of the introductory rate in the welcome email.
examples.zh: 银行在欢迎邮件里写明了「新户限期优惠利率」的截止日期。

examples.en: Does the introductory rate last until the end of the calendar month in this offer?
examples.zh: 这项优惠的「新户限期优惠利率」会持续到当月月底吗？

words.enDefinition: an identifier linking a payment to a particular invoice

examples.en: The university asked me to report the invoice reference when I queried the payment.
examples.zh: 我查询付款时，学校让我报一下「发票关联编号」。

examples.en: I found the invoice reference printed beside the total on the new invoice.
examples.zh: 我在新发票总额的旁边找到了印好的「发票关联编号」。

words.enDefinition: income that varies in amount or arrives inconsistently

examples.en: It's hard to plan around irregular income when the café posts shifts every Sunday.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆每周日才公布班次，想按「不稳定收入」做计划挺难。

examples.en: I have irregular income from tutoring because some weeks nobody books a lesson.
examples.zh: 我做家教的「收入不稳定」，因为有些星期根本没人预约。

words.enDefinition: specific expenses listed individually as deductions on a US tax return

examples.en: The example includes a separate schedule showing how itemized deductions are recorded.
examples.zh: 示例附有一张单独的表，说明如何记录「逐项列举的扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked why the worksheet compared itemized deductions with one fixed amount.
examples.zh: 我问为什么计算表要把「逐项列举的扣除额」与一个固定金额比较。

words.enDefinition: a receipt showing the purchased items and amounts separately

examples.en: I asked for an itemized receipt because three of us had shared the order.
examples.zh: 因为这份订单是我们三个人一起买的，我要了张「分项收据」。

examples.en: The itemized receipt helped me check which books I had actually been charged for.
examples.zh: 「分项收据」帮我核对了实际付费的是哪些书。

words.enDefinition: a bill showing individual education charges separately instead of only a total

examples.en: My sponsor requested an itemized tuition bill before approving the payment to the university.
examples.zh: 资助方在批准向学校付款前，要求我提供「逐项列明的学费账单」。

examples.en: The itemized tuition bill separates the lab fees from the basic course charge.
examples.zh: 「逐项列明的学费账单」把实验费和基本课程费分开。

words.enDefinition: a bank account held by two or more people

examples.en: My sister and I discussed opening a joint account for the bills we share.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐讨论过开个「联名账户」，用来处理我们共同承担的账单。

examples.en: I asked the bank which names would appear on a statement for a joint account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，「联名账户」的账单上会显示哪些人的姓名。

words.enDefinition: To hold money back for later needs

examples.en: I prefer to keep money in reserve because my summer work hours are unpredictable.
examples.zh: 暑期工作时长不确定，所以我更愿意「留钱备用」。

examples.en: We agreed to keep money in reserve until the final moving bill arrived.
examples.zh: 我们说好先「留钱备用」，等搬家的最后一张账单寄来。

collocations: choose to keep money in reserve
keep money in reserve for repairs
keep money in reserve just in case

words.enDefinition: regularly check what you spend and how much

examples.en: It's easier to keep track of your spending when most receipts are in one place.
examples.zh: 把大多数收据放在一起，更容易「留意自己的开支」。

examples.en: Do you keep track of your spending on the weeks you pay mostly in cash?
examples.zh: 你大部分时候用现金的那几周，也会「留意自己的开支」吗？

collocations: find a way to keep track of your spending
help you keep track of your spending
easily keep track of your spending

words.enDefinition: a penalty charged for missing the deadline to submit a required return

examples.en: The notice listed a late filing penalty below the original amount due.
examples.zh: 通知在原有应缴金额下面列了一笔「逾期申报罚款」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser which date was used to determine the late filing penalty.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，计算「逾期申报罚款」时用的是哪个日期。

collocations: the amount of a late filing penalty

words.enDefinition: interest charged on an amount that remains unpaid after its due date

examples.en: The balance changed because the latest notice included late payment interest for two weeks.
examples.zh: 最新通知加上了两周的「逾期付款利息」，所以余额变了。

examples.en: I asked which amount on the notice was late payment interest from last month.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪笔金额是上个月的「逾期付款利息」。

words.enDefinition: money spent on washing and drying clothes

examples.en: I hadn't included laundry costs before I found out how much each dryer cycle was.
examples.zh: 知道烘干机用一次多少钱之前，我都没把「洗衣开销」算进去。

examples.en: We cut our laundry costs by hanging things outside when it was warm enough.
examples.zh: 天气暖和的时候我们把衣服晾在外面，省下了些「洗衣开销」。

words.enDefinition: To keep saved money without spending any of it

examples.en: I managed to leave savings untouched while waiting for the money from my last shift.
examples.zh: 等上一个班次的工资时，我设法「没动用储蓄」。

examples.en: We could leave savings untouched once the landlord agreed to cover the repair bill.
examples.zh: 房东同意承担维修费后，我们就可以「不动用储蓄」了。

collocations: leave savings untouched for another month

words.enDefinition: the balance reflecting transactions already officially recorded

examples.en: I asked why the ledger balance differed from what I could use that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问「账面余额」为什么和当天下午能用的钱不一样。

examples.en: The adviser showed me the ledger balance separately from the amount available to withdraw.
examples.zh: 顾问把「账面余额」和可提取金额分别指给我看。

words.enDefinition: The period during which someone has had recorded credit accounts

examples.en: The guide explained how the length of credit history differed from a person's actual age.
examples.zh: 指南解释了一个人的「信用记录年限」与实际年龄有何区别。

examples.en: I saw the length of credit history listed among the factors on my score report.
examples.zh: 我看到评分报告把「信用记录年限」列在影响因素里。

collocations: calculate the length of credit history
a minimum length of credit history
factor in the length of credit history

words.enDefinition: an account connected to another account or service

examples.en: The clerk asked me which linked account had the address I wanted to update.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我，想更新的地址在哪个「关联账户」上。

examples.en: I checked the last digits of the linked account before removing it from the app.
examples.zh: 把「关联账户」从应用中移除之前，我核对了它的尾号。

words.enDefinition: Savings that can be accessed readily

examples.en: My spreadsheet lists liquid savings separately from money I have committed for a year.
examples.zh: 我的电子表格把「易于动用的储蓄」和锁定一年的资金分开列了。

examples.en: I used part of my liquid savings when I needed to pay for a repair quickly.
examples.zh: 需要马上支付维修费时，我动用了一部分「易于动用的储蓄」。

words.enDefinition: keep your spending within what you can afford

examples.en: It takes planning to live within your means when your hours change every week.
examples.zh: 每周工时都在变，想「量入为出」就得提前盘算。

examples.en: Living near campus makes it easier to live within your means if you rarely need transport.
examples.zh: 如果基本不用坐车，住在学校附近就比较容易做到「量入为出」。

collocations: learn to live within your means
try to live within your means
manage to live within your means

words.enDefinition: a grant that helps pay for everyday living expenses during study

examples.en: The living-cost grant helped cover my bus fares and groceries during the placement.
examples.zh: 「生活费助学金」补贴了我实习期间的公交费和食品杂货开销。

examples.en: The funding page lists a living-cost grant separately from support with course fees.
examples.zh: 资助页面把「生活费助学金」和课程费补助分开列出。

words.enDefinition: the money you spend on basic daily needs

examples.en: My part-time job covers most of my living expenses during the summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假期间，我的兼职收入能支付大部分「生活开支」。

examples.en: We compared our living expenses after moving from residence to a shared flat.
examples.zh: 从学生宿舍搬到合租公寓后，我们比了一下彼此的「生活开支」。

words.enDefinition: A contract setting out the conditions of a loan

examples.en: I searched the loan agreement for the section about changing my payment date.
examples.zh: 我在「贷款协议」里找更改还款日期的条款。

examples.en: The office sent a copy of the loan agreement after our appointment.
examples.zh: 预约办完后，办事处发来一份「贷款协议」副本。

words.enDefinition: The sum of money borrowed under a lending agreement

examples.en: The form showed my loan amount above the estimate for each monthly payment.
examples.zh: 表格把我的「贷款金额」列在每月预计还款额上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan amount included the fee shown on the next line.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款金额」是否包括下一行显示的费用。

words.enDefinition: Loan payments that remain unpaid after their agreed deadlines

examples.en: The letter showed the loan arrears separately from this month's scheduled payment.
examples.zh: 信里把「贷款逾期欠款」与本月应还款项分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which two missed payments were included in the loan arrears.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款逾期欠款」包括哪两笔漏缴的还款。

collocations: the amount of the loan arrears

words.enDefinition: combining several outstanding loans into one new loan, such as combining eligible student loans

examples.en: The guide used a worked example to show how loan consolidation changes the statement.
examples.zh: 指南用一个带计算的示例演示「贷款合并」会怎样改变对账单。

examples.en: The office confirmed which loans were included in my request for loan consolidation.
examples.zh: 办公室确认了我的「贷款合并」申请包含哪些贷款。

words.enDefinition: Failure to fulfill a major repayment obligation under a loan agreement

examples.en: The adviser explained how the agreement defined a loan default for this account.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了协议如何界定这个账户上的「贷款违约」。

examples.en: I found the loan default section in the copy of my contract.
examples.zh: 我在合同副本里找到了关于「贷款违约」的章节。

words.enDefinition: a temporary postponement of required loan payments while the borrower meets a qualifying condition

examples.en: The loan deferment letter gave a date for when regular payments would resume.
examples.zh: 「延期偿还贷款」通知写了恢复按期还款的日期。

examples.en: I called to check whether the loan deferment had been recorded on my account.
examples.zh: 我打电话核实账户上有没有记录「延期偿还贷款」。

words.enDefinition: The release of borrowed funds by the lender

examples.en: The message gave the date of the loan disbursement and the amount transferred.
examples.zh: 消息写明了「贷款发放」的日期和转入金额。

examples.en: I asked where the confirmation of loan disbursement would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问账户的什么位置会显示「贷款发放」的确认信息。

words.enDefinition: release from all or part of a loan obligation because a recognized event or condition applies

examples.en: The notice explained why a loan discharge was granted in the sample case.
examples.zh: 通知解释了为什么示例案例获批「解除贷款偿还义务」。

examples.en: My adviser showed me where the letter stated the effective date of the loan discharge.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看，信里哪儿写着「解除贷款偿还义务」的生效日期。

words.enDefinition: The conditions someone must meet to qualify for a loan

examples.en: The bank listed its loan eligibility requirements on the same page as the application.
examples.zh: 银行在申请表所在的页面列出了「贷款申请资格」要求。

examples.en: I asked how the lender assessed loan eligibility for people with irregular income.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构如何评估收入不固定人士的「贷款申请资格」。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement allowing a borrower to stop or reduce scheduled payments temporarily, often with interest still accruing

examples.en: The lender's letter explained what would happen to interest during loan forbearance.
examples.zh: 放贷机构的信说明了「暂缓或减少贷款还款」期间利息会怎样处理。

examples.en: I asked which monthly payment would be affected by the approved loan forbearance.
examples.zh: 我问获批的「暂缓或减少贷款还款」会影响哪一期月供。

words.enDefinition: A person who agrees to repay if the borrower does not

examples.en: The loan guarantor asked which part of the agreement described their obligations.
examples.zh: 「贷款担保人」问协议的哪一部分写明了其义务。

examples.en: I asked the adviser why the form required a loan guarantor for this offer.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，为什么这份方案的表格要求填写一位「贷款担保人」。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization that owns the right to collect a particular loan debt

examples.en: The letter listed the loan holder separately from the company collecting my payments.
examples.zh: 信上把「贷款债权持有人」与收取我还款的公司分开列出。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan holder had changed when the account was moved.
examples.zh: 我问账户转移时，「贷款债权持有人」有没有变。

collocations: a notice from the loan holder

words.enDefinition: One scheduled payment that repays part of a loan

examples.en: The loan installment appeared on my statement alongside the remaining loan balance.
examples.zh: 账单上列出了这「一期贷款还款」的金额及剩余贷款余额。

examples.en: I asked when the final loan installment was due under the original agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按原协议，最后「一期贷款还款」何时到期。

words.enDefinition: The date by which the loan is scheduled to be fully repaid

examples.en: The loan maturity date was listed next to the number of payments left.
examples.zh: 「贷款到期日」列在剩余还款次数旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan maturity date changed when they updated the schedule.
examples.zh: 我问他们更新还款计划后，「贷款到期日」是否变了。

words.enDefinition: A lender's proposal stating the terms on which it would lend

examples.en: The loan offer listed the repayment amount and the date it would expire.
examples.zh: 「贷款要约」列出了应还金额和要约失效日期。

examples.en: She asked which conditions in the loan offer still needed to be met.
examples.zh: 她问「贷款要约」里还有哪些条件需要满足。

words.enDefinition: A charge for processing and issuing a new loan

examples.en: The loan origination fee was shown on a separate line in the quote.
examples.zh: 「贷款发放手续费」在报价单上单独列了一行。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan origination fee would be deducted from the funds I received.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款发放手续费」是否会从我实际收到的款项里扣除。

words.enDefinition: The original money borrowed, excluding the associated interest and charges

examples.en: The disclosure listed the loan principal separately from the total amount to repay.
examples.zh: 披露文件把「贷款本金」与还款总额分开列出。

examples.en: Part of each installment went toward the loan principal according to the schedule.
examples.zh: 按还款表，每期有一部分款项用于偿还「贷款本金」。

words.enDefinition: The money a borrower receives from an approved loan

examples.en: The loan proceeds appeared in my account the day after the letter arrived.
examples.zh: 通知信送到后的第二天，「贷款所得款项」入了我的账户。

examples.en: The receipt listed the loan proceeds and a separate line for the fee.
examples.zh: 收据列出了「贷款所得款项」，另有一行列出了费用。

words.enDefinition: Replacing an existing loan with another under different terms

examples.en: The brochure explained the fees associated with loan refinancing for a vehicle.
examples.zh: 宣传册解释了汽车「贷款再融资」涉及的费用。

examples.en: I asked whether the loan refinancing quote included a charge for closing the old loan.
examples.zh: 我问「贷款再融资」报价是否包括结清原贷款的费用。

words.zhGloss: 美国违约学生贷款恢复计划
words.enDefinition: a process for bringing a defaulted US federal student loan out of default by meeting specified payment requirements
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国违约学生贷款恢复计划

examples.en: The US loan servicer listed loan rehabilitation separately from consolidation in the guide.
examples.zh: 美国的贷款服务机构在指南里把「美国违约学生贷款恢复计划」与贷款合并分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked who could explain the sample agreement for loan rehabilitation in the handbook.
examples.zh: 我问谁能讲解手册中「美国违约学生贷款恢复计划」的协议样本。

words.enDefinition: A company that manages repayments and records for a lender

examples.en: My loan servicer sent a letter explaining where future statements would appear.
examples.zh: 我的「贷款服务机构」发来一封信，说明今后在哪儿能看到账单。

examples.en: I asked the loan servicer for a receipt showing the payment date.
examples.zh: 我向「贷款服务机构」索取了一张显示还款日期的收据。

words.enDefinition: a record showing a loan's balance and activity such as charges, interest and payments

examples.en: I downloaded my loan statement just before changing the email address on file.
examples.zh: 我在修改登记邮箱前下载了「贷款对账单」。

examples.en: The newest loan statement showed that my last payment had cleared on Thursday.
examples.zh: 最新的「贷款对账单」显示，我上一笔还款在周四已经入账。

words.enDefinition: The agreed period over which borrowed money is to be repaid

examples.en: The letter showed the loan term in months beside the final repayment date.
examples.zh: 信上把以月计的「贷款期限」列在最后还款日旁边。

examples.en: I asked whether changing the loan term would affect the quoted monthly payment.
examples.zh: 我问更改「贷款期限」是否会影响报价上的每月还款额。

words.enDefinition: an office of a bank serving the surrounding area

examples.en: My local branch moved across town during my first semester at the university.
examples.zh: 在我读大学的第一学期，「附近的银行网点」搬到了城另一头。

examples.en: I stopped by the local branch to ask about the statement I had received.
examples.zh: 我顺路去了「附近的银行网点」，问收到的那份账单是什么情况。

words.enDefinition: a tax on income charged by a local government, such as a city

examples.en: The example from that city listed local income tax alongside other payroll deductions.
examples.zh: 那个城市的样本在其他工资扣款旁边列了「地方所得税」。

examples.en: I asked if local income tax was the name of the line on my statement.
examples.zh: 我问工资单上那一行的名称是不是「地方所得税」。

words.enDefinition: Money that cannot normally be accessed before a date

examples.en: The app showed my locked-in funds in a separate section of the account summary.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「锁定资金」单独列在账户概览的一个栏目里。

examples.en: I asked which day the locked-in funds would become accessible under the deposit agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按照存款协议，这笔「锁定资金」哪天可以动用。

words.enDefinition: an exchange rate reserved for a transaction under specified conditions

examples.en: The confirmation said when the locked-in rate for my transfer would expire.
examples.zh: 确认通知说了我这笔转账的「锁定汇率」什么时候失效。

examples.en: I asked which line on the receipt showed the locked-in rate.
examples.zh: 我问收据上的哪一行显示「锁定汇率」。

words.enDefinition: enter the details of a payment in a record

examples.en: I forgot to log an expense when I paid cash at the train station.
examples.zh: 我在火车站用现金付款时，忘了「记下那笔开支」。

examples.en: You can log an expense before the receipt fades or gets lost in your bag.
examples.zh: 你可以趁收据还没褪色、也没在包里弄丢时，「把那笔开支记下来」。

collocations: log an expense in an app

words.enDefinition: try to find something offered at a good price

examples.en: I'll look for a deal on train tickets when I know which weekend works.
examples.zh: 确定好哪个周末有空后，我会「找找划算的」火车票。

examples.en: We decided to look for a deal before paying to replace our microwave.
examples.zh: 花钱换微波炉之前，我们决定先「找找划算的优惠」。

collocations: look for a deal on tickets
help someone look for a deal

words.enDefinition: a notification that funds have fallen below a level

examples.en: I received a low balance alert while looking up the dates of my next payments.
examples.zh: 我查询接下来几笔款项的日期时，收到了「余额过低提醒」。

examples.en: The bank explained what would trigger a low balance alert on this account.
examples.zh: 银行说明了这个账户在什么情况下会触发「余额过低提醒」。

collocations: turn off a low balance alert

words.enDefinition: the strip on a card that stores information a reader can detect

examples.en: The magnetic stripe was scratched after my card spent months loose in my bag.
examples.zh: 卡在包里散放了几个月，「银行卡磁条」刮花了。

examples.en: The cashier could not read the magnetic stripe on my worn student debit card.
examples.zh: 我学生借记卡磨损了，收银员读不出「银行卡磁条」。

words.enDefinition: an account setting about which documents arrive by mail

examples.en: I checked my mailing preference after the first statement went to my old address.
examples.zh: 第一份对账单寄到旧地址后，我查看了自己的「邮寄偏好设置」。

examples.en: The bank asked us to confirm our mailing preference before the new account opened.
examples.zh: 新账户开通前，银行请我们确认「邮寄偏好设置」。

words.enDefinition: a student loan in the UK designed to help with living expenses while studying

examples.en: The funding letter showed the maintenance loan as three separate payments for the year.
examples.zh: 资助信把「英国学生生活费贷款」列为当年分三笔发放。

examples.en: She compared her maintenance loan with the cost of rent and food near campus.
examples.zh: 她把「英国学生生活费贷款」和校园附近的房租、餐费对比了一下。

words.enDefinition: To add money beyond the planned amount

examples.en: I was able to make an extra contribution after I sold my old textbooks.
examples.zh: 我卖掉旧课本后，得以「额外存入一笔钱」。

examples.en: Does this account let me make an extra contribution separately from the monthly transfer?
examples.zh: 这个账户能让我在每月转账之外再「额外存入一笔钱」吗？

collocations: decide to make an extra contribution
make an extra contribution to savings
be able to make an extra contribution

words.enDefinition: To pay an additional amount beyond what is scheduled

examples.en: The agent explained what the receipt would show if I chose to make an extra payment.
examples.zh: 客服解释了如果我选择「额外还一笔款」，收据上会显示什么。

examples.en: I asked whether I could make an extra payment through the same page as usual.
examples.zh: 我问能不能在平常用的页面上「额外还一笔款」。

collocations: make an extra payment toward principal
make an extra payment this month

words.enDefinition: have just enough money to cover your needs

examples.en: I'm picking up one extra shift this month to make ends meet until payday.
examples.zh: 这月我多上一个班，好「勉强维持生计」撑到发薪日。

examples.en: It got harder to make ends meet after the cheapest supermarket near campus closed.
examples.zh: 学校附近最便宜的超市关门后，想「勉强维持生计」就更难了。

words.enDefinition: the rate that applies to an additional unit of taxable income at a given income level

examples.en: A tutor used a small pay increase to illustrate the marginal tax rate.
examples.zh: 导师用一小笔加薪说明了什么是「边际税率」。

examples.en: The diagram compares a person's marginal tax rate at two different income levels.
examples.zh: 图表对比了同一个人在两种收入水平下的「边际税率」。

collocations: a marginal tax rate of twenty percent

words.zhGloss: 美国联邦学生贷款主借据
words.enDefinition: a US federal student loan document in which the borrower promises repayment and agrees to the terms
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国联邦学生贷款主借据

examples.en: The portal marked my master promissory note as signed but still under review.
examples.zh: 平台显示我的「美国联邦学生贷款主借据」已签署，仍在审核中。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the master promissory note with my loan records.
examples.zh: 我把「美国联邦学生贷款主借据」的副本和贷款记录一起保存。

collocations: terms of a master promissory note

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学生资助总协议
words.enDefinition: a Canadian agreement that sets the terms for receiving and repaying government student loans
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学生资助总协议

examples.en: The Canadian student funding portal showed my Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement as complete.
examples.zh: 加拿大学生资助平台显示我的「加拿大学生资助总协议」已填写完毕。

examples.en: I asked which version of the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement applied to my funding.
examples.zh: 我问我的资助适用哪个版本的「加拿大学生资助总协议」。

collocations: sign the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement
complete the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement
review the Master Student Financial Assistance Agreement

words.enDefinition: To contribute a corresponding amount toward your savings

examples.en: Will the student scheme match your savings if you put in money this term?
examples.zh: 如果你这学期存了钱，学生项目会「按比例补贴你的储蓄」吗？

examples.en: Tara asked whether the new programme would still match your savings after graduation.
examples.zh: 塔拉问，新项目在学生毕业后是否还会「按比例补贴储蓄」。

collocations: match your savings up to a limit
match your savings dollar for dollar

words.enDefinition: Instructions for handling a deposit when its term ends

examples.en: I entered my maturity instructions after confirming where the money would be sent.
examples.zh: 确认钱将转到哪里后，我填写了「存款到期处理指示」。

examples.en: The bank asked me to review the maturity instructions one week before the term ended.
examples.zh: 银行让我在存期结束前一周核对「存款到期处理指示」。

words.enDefinition: A message stating that a deposit is nearing maturity

examples.en: The maturity notice reached my inbox two weeks before the end of the term.
examples.zh: 距离存期结束还有两周时，我的邮箱收到了「存款到期通知」。

examples.en: I checked the maturity notice again to find the bank's number before calling.
examples.zh: 打电话前，我重新看了「存款到期通知」，找到了银行的号码。

words.enDefinition: The money payable when a deposit matures

examples.en: The letter said the maturity proceeds would go into the account I'd specified.
examples.zh: 信上说，「存款到期所得款项」会转入我指定的账户。

examples.en: The maturity proceeds on my statement matched the figure in the bank's letter.
examples.zh: 账单上的「存款到期所得款项」和银行信中列出的数字一致。

words.zhGloss: 按经济状况核定的助学金
words.enDefinition: a bursary whose eligibility or amount depends on an assessment of available income or resources
acceptedZhAnswers: 按经济状况核定的助学金

examples.en: The application for a means-tested bursary asked about household income and dependants.
examples.zh: 「按经济状况核定的助学金」申请表问了家庭收入和受抚养人情况。

examples.en: The funding page explains why the means-tested bursary varies from student to student.
examples.zh: 资助页面说明了为什么不同学生领到的「按经济状况核定的助学金」金额不同。

collocations: an application for a means-tested bursary

words.enDefinition: money members regularly pay to belong to a group

examples.en: Our climbing club collects membership dues before the first outdoor trip of the year.
examples.zh: 我们攀岩社在本年度第一次户外出行前收「会员会费」。

examples.en: I checked whether membership dues included the cost of hiring equipment at practice.
examples.zh: 我查了「会员会费」包不包括训练时租用装备的钱。

words.enDefinition: the classification used to describe a merchant's line of business

examples.en: The card statement listed a merchant category for each payment I made abroad.
examples.zh: 银行卡账单给我在国外的每笔付款都列了「商户类别」。

examples.en: I asked what the merchant category meant for a purchase from the campus store.
examples.zh: 我问在校园商店买东西时，显示的「商户类别」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: the text that identifies a merchant on a card statement

examples.en: I searched for the merchant descriptor because I did not recognise the name.
examples.zh: 我不认得这个名字，就搜了一下「账单商户显示名」。

examples.en: The bank explained why the merchant descriptor differed from the name on the shop sign.
examples.zh: 银行解释了为什么「账单商户显示名」和店门招牌上的名称不同。

words.enDefinition: a disagreement between a customer and a seller concerning a purchase

examples.en: I saved the email about the merchant dispute with the other order documents.
examples.zh: 我把有关「与商户的付款争议」的邮件和别的订单文件存放在一起。

examples.en: The bank asked what had happened so far in the merchant dispute.
examples.zh: 银行问这起「与商户的付款争议」目前已经发生了什么。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship based on achievement or ability, such as in academics, arts or athletics

examples.en: She received a merit-based scholarship after submitting her grades and a portfolio.
examples.zh: 提交成绩和作品集后，她获得了一项「按表现评定的奖学金」。

examples.en: The university described how it selects students for its new merit-based scholarship.
examples.zh: 大学介绍了它怎样选拔获得新设「按表现评定的奖学金」的学生。

words.enDefinition: the midpoint between market rates for buying and selling currencies

examples.en: The provider's guide explained what the mid-market exchange rate represented on its page.
examples.zh: 服务商指南解释了网站上的「市场中间汇率」代表什么。

examples.en: I asked whether the quote used the mid-market exchange rate in its calculation.
examples.zh: 我问这份报价计算时是否用了「市场中间汇率」。

collocations: compare with the mid-market exchange rate

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount a particular account requires or specifies

examples.en: The bank booklet listed a minimum balance for the account I asked about.
examples.zh: 银行小册子列出了我询问的那个账户的「最低余额」。

examples.en: I checked whether the minimum balance was described on the same page as the fees.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，「最低余额」和费用是不是在同一页上说明的。

words.enDefinition: the smallest purchase amount a merchant accepts by card

examples.en: The café sign listed a minimum card spend just below the drinks menu.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆牌子在饮品菜单下写了「刷卡最低消费」。

examples.en: I asked how much the minimum card spend was before ordering one coffee.
examples.zh: 只点一杯咖啡之前，我问了「刷卡最低消费」是多少。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount of coursework or number of credits required for a particular status

examples.en: I checked whether my new timetable still met the minimum course load for funding.
examples.zh: 我核对了新课表是否还符合领取资助所需的「最低选课量」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how the minimum course load was measured for summer study.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了暑期学习的「最低选课量」怎么算。

collocations: fall below the minimum course load

words.enDefinition: the smallest initial amount required to fund an account

examples.en: I asked what minimum opening deposit the bank listed for its basic account.
examples.zh: 我问银行的基础账户规定的「最低开户存款金额」是多少。

examples.en: The brochure showed the minimum opening deposit separately from monthly account fees.
examples.zh: 宣传册把「最低开户存款金额」和每月账户费用分开列出。

words.enDefinition: The smallest amount due for a particular billing period

examples.en: The minimum payment was printed beside the date my payment was due.
examples.zh: 「最低还款额」印在我的还款到期日旁边。

examples.en: I asked why the minimum payment changed when the balance barely moved.
examples.zh: 我问欠款余额几乎没变，为什么「最低还款额」变了。

words.enDefinition: the smallest amount you must spend to qualify for something

examples.en: The voucher had a minimum spend of thirty dollars, so I left it unused.
examples.zh: 那张券要求「最低消费金额」三十美元，所以我没用。

examples.en: I asked whether the minimum spend applied when our table used separate checks.
examples.zh: 我问我们这桌分开结账时，是否也有「最低消费金额」的要求。

words.enDefinition: the smallest sum a provider accepts for a transfer

examples.en: The quote page listed a minimum transfer amount before showing the conversion rate.
examples.zh: 报价页面先列出「最低转账金额」，再显示兑换汇率。

examples.en: I asked whether the minimum transfer amount changed for different ways of receiving money.
examples.zh: 我问换一种收款方式，「最低转账金额」会不会变。

collocations: a minimum transfer amount required by the provider

words.enDefinition: A scheduled payment that was not made on time

examples.en: The agent and I went through my statement to find the missed payment.
examples.zh: 工作人员和我一起查看账单，找那笔「漏缴款项」。

examples.en: A missed payment from March appeared on the report even after I updated my address.
examples.zh: 我更新地址后，报告上仍有三月那笔「漏缴款项」。

collocations: follow up on a missed payment

words.enDefinition: a wage payment that has not arrived when expected

examples.en: The clerk asked for my last pay date when I reported a missing paycheck.
examples.zh: 我报告「未收到的工资」时，办事员问我上次发薪是哪天。

examples.en: I found my payslip online but still had to ask about the missing paycheck.
examples.zh: 我在网上找到了工资单，但还是得问一下那笔「未收到的工资」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer not found where the sender or recipient expected it

examples.en: I gave the bank the date when asking about the missing transfer.
examples.zh: 我询问「未能查到的转账」时，把日期也提供给了银行。

examples.en: The university requested the payment reference for the missing transfer that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，学校向我要了这笔「未能查到的转账」的付款编号。

collocations: an inquiry about a missing transfer

words.enDefinition: an application for using banking services on a phone

examples.en: I could see my new account in the mobile banking app the following day.
examples.zh: 第二天，我就在「手机银行应用」里看到了新账户。

examples.en: The teller explained where the account settings appeared in the mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 柜员解释了账户设置在「手机银行应用」里的哪个位置。

collocations: sign in to the mobile banking app
an alert from the mobile banking app

words.enDefinition: a payment sent to or from a mobile wallet

examples.en: The provider listed mobile wallet transfer as a delivery option on the quote.
examples.zh: 服务商在报价里把「手机钱包转账」列为一种到账方式。

examples.en: I asked whether a mobile wallet transfer receipt would appear directly in the app.
examples.zh: 我问「手机钱包转账」的收据会不会直接显示在应用里。

words.enDefinition: there is very little money available to spend

examples.en: Money is tight this week because I had to replace my bike lock.
examples.zh: 我这周不得不换了把自行车锁，所以「手头比较拮据」。

examples.en: If money is tight, we can meet at my place instead of the café.
examples.zh: 要是「手头拮据」，我们可以在我家碰面，不用去咖啡馆。

words.enDefinition: a US deposit account that generally earns interest

examples.en: The bank listed a money market account separately from the fund with a similar name.
examples.zh: 银行把「货币市场存款账户」和名字相近的基金分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what a money market account was when I saw it on the bank's website.
examples.zh: 我在银行网站看到「货币市场存款账户」时，问了它是什么意思。

collocations: terms of a money market account

words.enDefinition: Money available to spend immediately

examples.en: The extra money on hand meant we could book a different train after ours was cancelled.
examples.zh: 原先的列车取消后，靠「手头多出来的资金」，我们可以改订另一趟车。

examples.en: There was enough money on hand to pay the plumber before my wages arrived.
examples.zh: 工资到账之前，我「手头有足够的钱」付水管工的费用。

words.enDefinition: the sum of amounts at the end of the month

examples.en: I waited for the last grocery receipt before calculating our month-end total for food.
examples.zh: 我等最后一张买菜小票到了，才算我们伙食费的「月底合计金额」。

examples.en: The month-end total included two bus passes because I bought one early for June.
examples.zh: 「月底合计金额」里有两张公交月票，因为我提前买了六月份那张。

words.enDefinition: a plan for income and spending over one month

examples.en: My monthly budget is tighter in June because I work fewer hours during exams.
examples.zh: 六月考试期间我打工时间少了，所以这个月的「月度预算」更紧。

examples.en: I left haircuts out of my monthly budget and had to revise it.
examples.zh: 我做「月度预算」的时候忘了把理发的钱算进去，只好改了一下。

words.enDefinition: Interest paid once a month

examples.en: I noticed the monthly interest payment had arrived before my regular savings transfer.
examples.zh: 我看到「每月利息款项」在我那笔定期储蓄转账前就到账了。

examples.en: The statement lists the monthly interest payment on the last day of each month.
examples.zh: 账单把「每月利息款项」列在每个月的最后一天。

words.enDefinition: The percentage rate used to express borrowing interest per month

examples.en: The leaflet gave a monthly interest rate alongside a figure for the entire year.
examples.zh: 宣传册在全年利率旁边也列出了「月利率」。

examples.en: I asked whether the monthly interest rate in the example was fixed or variable.
examples.zh: 我问例子里的「月利率」是固定的还是浮动的。

words.enDefinition: a charge billed each month for maintaining an account

examples.en: I asked where the monthly maintenance fee would appear on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我问「月账户管理费」会出现在银行对账单的哪里。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the monthly maintenance fee listed under this account type.
examples.zh: 顾问给我指了该账户类型下列出的「月账户管理费」。

collocations: a monthly maintenance fee on an account

words.enDefinition: the total amount of money you spend each month

examples.en: I added up my monthly outgoings to see whether I could afford another language class.
examples.zh: 我算了一下「每月总支出」，看看还能不能再报一门语言课。

examples.en: My monthly outgoings increased when I started commuting to my placement twice a week.
examples.zh: 我开始每周去实习地点两次以后，「每月总支出」就涨了。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that charges you each month for ongoing access

examples.en: I started a monthly subscription to the software while I was finishing my final project.
examples.zh: 做毕业项目的收尾工作时，我开通了这款软件的「月度订阅」。

examples.en: The monthly subscription ended just after I handed in the last assignment for that module.
examples.zh: 我交完那门课的最后一次作业没多久，「月度订阅」就到期了。

collocations: sign up for a monthly subscription

words.enDefinition: An amount measured by how many months of expenses it covers

examples.en: Their savings covered two months of expenses during the break between university jobs.
examples.zh: 两份校内工作交替的空档里，他们的存款够付「两个月的开支」。

examples.en: I wrote down how many months of expenses my current savings could cover.
examples.zh: 我记下现有的储蓄够付「几个月的开支」。

collocations: enough for three months of expenses

words.enDefinition: an account that can hold more than one currency

examples.en: The website listed which currencies the multi-currency account could hold at that branch.
examples.zh: 网站列出了该网点的「多币种账户」支持哪些币种。

examples.en: I checked whether the multi-currency account showed a separate balance for each supported currency.
examples.zh: 我确认了一下，「多币种账户」是否分别显示每种支持币种的余额。

words.enDefinition: a package containing several units of a product

examples.en: I bought a multipack of crisps for our study group's end-of-term picnic.
examples.zh: 我给学习小组的期末野餐买了包「多件组合装」的薯片。

examples.en: The multipack contained six small boxes, so we each took one for the trip.
examples.zh: 「多件组合装」里有六个小盒，我们每人拿了一盒带着出门。

words.enDefinition: the name that the bank has recorded for an account

examples.en: I checked the name on the account before sending the confirmation letter to the university.
examples.zh: 把确认函发给学校前，我核对了「账户登记姓名」。

examples.en: The clerk asked whether the name on the account matched the document I had brought.
examples.zh: 工作人员问「账户登记姓名」是否与我带来的证件一致。

collocations: check the name on the account
change the name on the account
confirm the name on the account

words.enDefinition: payments into the UK's National Insurance system that help build eligibility for certain benefits

examples.en: The sample payslip lists National Insurance contributions separately from the amount of income tax.
examples.zh: 工资单样本把「英国国民保险缴费」和所得税金额分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what the National Insurance contributions line meant on my UK statement.
examples.zh: 我问英国工资单上「英国国民保险缴费」那一栏是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a grant awarded according to assessed financial need

examples.en: The school offered a need-based grant after reviewing the documents in my aid file.
examples.zh: 学校看过我的资助材料后，提供了一笔「经济困难助学金」。

examples.en: The funding table shows whether each need-based grant can be renewed next year.
examples.zh: 资助表标明了每项「经济困难助学金」下一年能否续领。

words.enDefinition: the distinction between what you need and what you want

examples.en: We discussed needs versus wants before deciding which items to put in the shared budget.
examples.zh: 决定哪些东西列进共同预算之前，我们聊了聊「必需与想要的区别」。

examples.en: The workshop used real receipts to show how students think about needs versus wants.
examples.zh: 讲座用了真实小票，展示学生怎样区分「必需品与想买的东西」。

collocations: sort purchases into needs versus wants
a discussion of needs versus wants

words.enDefinition: An item showing unfavorable information on a person's credit report

examples.en: I found a negative entry on the report for a loan I never took out.
examples.zh: 我发现报告里有一条「负面记录」，涉及我从没借过的贷款。

examples.en: The negative entry included the name of a company we did not recognize.
examples.zh: 那条「负面记录」里有一家我们不认识的公司。

words.enDefinition: the amount that reaches the recipient after relevant deductions

examples.en: The university reported the net amount received after checking its account statement.
examples.zh: 学校核对账户账单后，告诉了我「实际到账净额」。

examples.en: I asked which figure on the notice was the net amount received.
examples.zh: 我问通知上的哪个金额是「实际到账净额」。

words.enDefinition: Interest remaining after tax is deducted

examples.en: I compared the net interest on my statement with the amount I actually received.
examples.zh: 我比较了账单上的「税后利息」和实际收到的金额。

examples.en: The report listed net interest in the column next to the amount withheld.
examples.zh: 报告把「税后利息」列在预扣金额的旁边一栏。

words.enDefinition: a correction that changes the amount an employee actually receives

examples.en: The new statement included a net pay adjustment for the previous month.
examples.zh: 新的工资单包含一项针对上月的「实发工资调整」。

examples.en: I asked how the net pay adjustment was shown on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「实发工资调整」在银行流水上是怎么显示的。

words.enDefinition: the amount of pay left after taxes and other deductions

examples.en: My net pay matched the amount that appeared in my bank account.
examples.zh: 我的「实发工资」与银行账户里显示的到账金额一致。

examples.en: The sample statement puts net pay in bold at the bottom right.
examples.zh: 工资单样本把「实发工资」用粗体标在右下角。

words.enDefinition: a tool that estimates the amount a student may pay after applicable grants and scholarships

examples.en: I tried the university's net price calculator before comparing the two offers.
examples.zh: 在比较两份录取通知之前，我试用了大学的「就读净费用计算器」。

examples.en: The net price calculator asked whether I planned to live with my family.
examples.zh: 「就读净费用计算器」问我是否打算和家人一起住。

collocations: an estimate from the net price calculator

words.enDefinition: the next date a charge is due to be billed

examples.en: I checked the next billing date because the cheaper rate was supposed to start in June.
examples.zh: 我查了「下次计费日期」，因为较便宜的价格按说六月才开始。

examples.en: The next billing date falls two days before I get paid for my campus job.
examples.zh: 「下次计费日期」在我的校内兼职发工资前两天。

words.enDefinition: a transfer scheduled to reach the recipient the following day

examples.en: The provider listed a next-day transfer option in the quote I received online.
examples.zh: 我收到的网上报价里，服务商列了一个「次日转账」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the next-day transfer was expected on the next banking day.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「次日转账」预计是不是在下一个银行工作日到账。

words.enDefinition: Having no recorded history of borrowing or repaying credit

examples.en: I had no credit history in Canada when I first arrived for university.
examples.zh: 我刚到加拿大上大学时，在当地「没有信用记录」。

examples.en: The lender's form has a separate option for applicants with no credit history.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的表格给「没有信用记录」的申请人单列了一个选项。

words.enDefinition: a response indicating that the customer does not want a receipt

examples.en: I selected no receipt needed after paying for lunch at the campus café.
examples.zh: 我在校园咖啡馆付完午饭钱后选了「不需要收据」。

examples.en: The kiosk offered no receipt needed on the screen before closing the payment.
examples.zh: 结束付款前，自助机在屏幕上给出了「不需要收据」这个选项。

words.enDefinition: a day when you deliberately avoid spending money

examples.en: I packed a sandwich before class so I could stick to my no-spend day.
examples.zh: 上课前我带了个三明治，好完成那天的「零消费日」。

examples.en: We had a no-spend day and played football instead of going to the cinema.
examples.zh: 我们过了个「零消费日」，没有去看电影，改去踢球了。

words.enDefinition: an account for someone not resident in a jurisdiction

examples.en: I asked whether my bank offered a non-resident account after I moved back home.
examples.zh: 我搬回自己的国家后，问银行有没有「非居民账户」。

examples.en: The non-resident account information occupied a separate section of the bank's new customer guide.
examples.zh: 银行的新客户指南单独拿出一节介绍「非居民账户」。

words.enDefinition: a tax credit that reduces tax owed and does not pay out any unused amount

examples.en: The guide explains how a nonrefundable tax credit changes the total in this example.
examples.zh: 指南说明，这个例子里的「不可退还的税额抵免」怎样改变应纳税额。

examples.en: I highlighted nonrefundable tax credit in the margin beside the worked example.
examples.zh: 我在示例旁边把页边的「不可退还的税额抵免」标了出来。

collocations: qualify for a nonrefundable tax credit

words.enDefinition: a person who does not meet the applicable tax rules for being treated as a resident

examples.en: The workshop described the person in this example as a nonresident for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 讲座把这个例子里的人归为「税务非居民」。

examples.en: I wrote down the phrase nonresident for tax purposes from the handout.
examples.zh: 我把讲义上的「税务非居民」这个短语记了下来。

collocations: be a nonresident for tax purposes
classified as a nonresident for tax purposes
treated as a nonresident for tax purposes

words.enDefinition: a notice from a tax authority summarizing its assessment of a taxpayer's return or liability

examples.en: The Canadian workshop used a sample notice of assessment to explain the revised figures.
examples.zh: 加拿大税务讲座用「税务评估通知」样本解释了更正后的数字。

examples.en: I found the notice of assessment in the agency's message centre after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，我在税务部门的消息中心找到了「税务评估通知」。

words.enDefinition: A written notice saying that obligations under an agreement were breached

examples.en: The notice of default referred to a missed payment under the original agreement.
examples.zh: 「违约通知」提到一笔按原协议应付却漏缴的还款。

examples.en: I compared the account number on the notice of default with my contract.
examples.zh: 我核对了「违约通知」和合同上的账户号是否一致。

collocations: respond to a notice of default

words.enDefinition: a savings account requiring advance notice before a withdrawal

examples.en: I looked up notice savings account after seeing that phrase in the bank's brochure.
examples.zh: 我在银行宣传册上看到「通知支取储蓄账户」这个词，就查了一下。

examples.en: The notice savings account had a separate document explaining when withdrawals could be made.
examples.zh: 「通知支取储蓄账户」有一份独立文件，说明什么时候可以支取。

collocations: terms of a notice savings account

words.enDefinition: with very little money available to spend

examples.en: We managed to spend a weekend in Edinburgh on a shoestring by taking the overnight bus.
examples.zh: 我们坐夜班大巴去爱丁堡过了个周末，「没花多少钱」。

examples.en: Maya ran the student film night on a shoestring by borrowing a projector.
examples.zh: 玛雅借到了一台投影仪，「花很少的钱」就办成了学生电影之夜。

words.enDefinition: being sold for less than the usual price

examples.en: The cereal I like is on sale this week at the shop by the station.
examples.zh: 车站旁那家店本周在「打折出售」我喜欢的谷物早餐。

examples.en: I waited until the kettle was on sale before getting one for the flat.
examples.zh: 我一直等到电水壶「打折出售」，才给公寓买了一个。

words.enDefinition: A payment received by its agreed or scheduled date

examples.en: The bank sent me a receipt to confirm my on-time payment in August.
examples.zh: 银行给我发来一张收据，确认我八月份「按时付款」。

examples.en: I showed the date of my on-time payment when I called about the fee.
examples.zh: 我打电话询问费用时，出示了「按时付款」的日期。

words.enDefinition: Money added to a savings goal once

examples.en: I made a one-off contribution to my travel fund with the money from tutoring.
examples.zh: 我把辅导课赚的钱「一次性存进」了旅行基金。

examples.en: The one-off contribution showed up separately from my usual monthly transfer on the statement.
examples.zh: 这笔「一次性存款」在账单上和我平常的月度转账分开显示。

collocations: a one-off contribution of fifty dollars

words.enDefinition: a code valid for a single use or short session

examples.en: The bank's secure app asked me for a one-time passcode to confirm the purchase.
examples.zh: 银行的安全应用要求输入「一次性验证码」确认交易。

examples.en: I waited for the one-time passcode that the payment page told me to expect.
examples.zh: 付款页面提示会发「一次性验证码」，我就等着接收。

words.enDefinition: a single purchase with no recurring payments

examples.en: The software is available as a one-time purchase if you only need the basic version.
examples.zh: 只需要基础版的话，这款软件可以「一次性购买」。

examples.en: I made a one-time purchase because I needed the app for just one assignment.
examples.zh: 我只需要用那个应用完成一次作业，所以选了「一次性购买」。

words.enDefinition: a scholarship awarded for a single period or payment without automatic continuation

examples.en: I used my one-time scholarship to help pay for textbooks and course materials.
examples.zh: 我用「一次性奖学金」补贴了课本和课程资料的费用。

examples.en: The faculty offered a one-time scholarship for students participating in the summer program.
examples.zh: 院系向参加暑期项目的学生提供了「一次性奖学金」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer intended to be made on one occasion only

examples.en: I chose a one-time transfer for the deposit when I moved into student housing.
examples.zh: 我搬进学生公寓时，给押金选了「一次性转账」。

examples.en: The confirmation said that I had scheduled a one-time transfer for the following day.
examples.zh: 确认通知说，我设了一笔次日执行的「一次性转账」。

words.enDefinition: the identifier used to sign into online banking

examples.en: The representative asked whether I could still remember my online banking ID after the move.
examples.zh: 工作人员问我，搬家后是否还记得自己的「网银用户识别号」。

examples.en: I checked the welcome letter for my online banking ID while waiting at the branch.
examples.zh: 我在网点等候时，翻查了欢迎信里的「网银用户识别号」。

words.enDefinition: a payment made with card details on a website or app

examples.en: I made an online card payment for my textbook rental before class.
examples.zh: 上课前，我为租教材做了一笔「网上银行卡付款」。

examples.en: The university portal sent an email after my online card payment was approved.
examples.zh: 我的「网上银行卡付款」获批后，学校系统发了一封邮件。

words.enDefinition: the process of completing a purchase on a website or app

examples.en: The shop gave me an option to choose delivery during online checkout.
examples.zh: 商店让我在「网上结账」时选择送货方式。

examples.en: I paused at online checkout to check my delivery details and discount code.
examples.zh: 我在「网上结账」时停了一下，核对收货信息和优惠码。

words.enDefinition: a bank serving customers online without regular branches

examples.en: The online-only bank sent a message explaining how to check my application status.
examples.zh: 「纯线上银行」发消息说明了怎么查我的申请进度。

examples.en: I asked the online-only bank which department could correct a mistake in my profile.
examples.zh: 我问「纯线上银行」哪个部门可以更正我账户资料里的错误。

collocations: open an account with an online-only bank
an account from an online-only bank

words.enDefinition: indicating that a card is not enabled for online purchases

examples.en: The message online payments disabled appeared when I tried to renew my software.
examples.zh: 尝试续订软件时，页面显示「在线付款已停用」。

examples.en: I checked the help page after seeing online payments disabled under my card.
examples.zh: 我看到卡片下方有「在线付款已停用」，就去查了帮助页。

collocations: online payments disabled in the app

words.enDefinition: to set up a new account with a bank

examples.en: I asked which documents I needed to open a bank account after moving to town.
examples.zh: 我刚搬到这座城市，就问「开立银行账户」要出示哪些材料。

examples.en: My flatmate waited while I went into the branch to open a bank account.
examples.zh: 我进网点「开立银行账户」时，室友在外面等我。

collocations: apply to open a bank account
open a bank account in person

words.enDefinition: the first transaction to which a later refund or correction refers

examples.en: The refund notice listed the original transaction under the new receipt number.
examples.zh: 退款通知在新收据号下列出了「原始交易」。

examples.en: The adviser asked which original transaction the second charge was linked to.
examples.zh: 顾问问这笔额外收费对应的是哪笔「原始交易」。

words.enDefinition: a payment sent from an account to another account or recipient

examples.en: The app showed the outgoing transfer under payments made from my current account.
examples.zh: 应用把「转出款项」列在我活期账户的付款记录下。

examples.en: I kept the reference from the outgoing transfer with my other exchange documents.
examples.zh: 我把这笔「转出款项」的编号和其他交换项目文件放在了一起。

words.enDefinition: a bank charge for sending a wire payment

examples.en: I noticed an outgoing wire fee on my bank statement after the payment.
examples.zh: 付款后，我注意到账单上有个「电汇汇出费」。

examples.en: The branch explained where the outgoing wire fee would be shown on the receipt.
examples.zh: 分行说明了收据上哪里会列出「电汇汇出费」。

collocations: an outgoing wire fee on the statement

words.enDefinition: A charge for exceeding a card account's permitted borrowing limit

examples.en: The statement showed an over-limit fee next to the card's new balance.
examples.zh: 账单在信用卡的新余额旁列了一笔「超额费用」。

examples.en: The agreement explains when an over-limit fee might appear on a statement.
examples.zh: 协议解释了何时账单上可能出现「超额费用」。

words.enDefinition: a payment greater than the amount that should have been paid

examples.en: The payroll office emailed me about the overpayment on my first wage statement.
examples.zh: 薪资部门发邮件，提到我第一张工资单上「多付的款项」。

examples.en: The second statement explained the overpayment and listed the amount involved separately.
examples.zh: 第二张工资单说明了「多付的款项」，并单列了相关金额。

words.enDefinition: pay for working beyond the usual or specified working hours

examples.en: The extra hours appeared as overtime pay on my next weekly statement.
examples.zh: 多上班的那几个小时在我下一周的工资单上列为「加班工资」。

examples.en: We asked payroll when the overtime pay from Saturday would be processed.
examples.zh: 我们问薪资部门，周六那笔「加班工资」什么时候处理。

words.enDefinition: goods sold under the retailer's own brand name

examples.en: I buy own-brand products when the ingredients look similar and the price is lower.
examples.zh: 配料差不多、价格又更低时，我会买「自有品牌商品」。

examples.en: This supermarket sells own-brand products in plain boxes near the bottom of the shelf.
examples.zh: 这家超市把包装简朴的「自有品牌商品」放在货架靠下的位置。

words.enDefinition: a UK document from an employer that records pay and tax information when an employee leaves

examples.en: My former employer sent the P45 after my last shift at the café.
examples.zh: 我在咖啡店上完最后一班后，原雇主寄来了「英国离职薪税表」。

examples.en: I asked which leaving date was recorded on the P45 in my folder.
examples.zh: 我问文件夹里的「英国离职薪税表」登记的离职日期是哪天。

collocations: give your new employer a P45

words.enDefinition: a UK statement summarizing an employee's pay and tax deductions for a completed tax year

examples.en: My UK employer put the P60 in the same folder as my payslips.
examples.zh: 我的英国雇主把「英国年度薪税表」放在工资单所在的文件夹里。

examples.en: I looked at the P60 when checking my pay records for the year.
examples.zh: 我核对全年工资记录时看了「英国年度薪税表」。

collocations: keep a copy of your P60

words.enDefinition: a tax return submitted as printed documents instead of through an electronic system

examples.en: The example compares the confirmation for a paper return with an electronic receipt.
examples.zh: 这个例子把「纸质纳税申报表」的回执和电子回执做了对比。

examples.en: I asked which address was printed on the sample paper return at the clinic.
examples.zh: 我问税务咨询点的「纸质纳税申报表」样本上印了哪个地址。

words.enDefinition: a printed statement showing activity and balances on an account

examples.en: The paper statement arrived at my student flat a week after I requested it.
examples.zh: 申请一周后，「纸质对账单」寄到了我的学生公寓。

examples.en: I asked the teller whether a paper statement could be printed at the branch.
examples.zh: 我问柜员，能不能在网点打印一份「纸质对账单」。

words.enDefinition: Account summaries delivered electronically instead of as paper copies

examples.en: I selected paperless statements so the monthly card bills would appear online.
examples.zh: 我选择了「电子账单」，这样每月的信用卡账单就会在网上显示。

examples.en: I saved the email confirming my switch to paperless statements last week.
examples.zh: 我保存了上周那封确认改用「电子账单」的邮件。

words.enDefinition: a US federal loan offered to eligible parents of dependent undergraduate students

examples.en: My father asked whether the Parent PLUS Loan would appear in his own account.
examples.zh: 我爸问，「美国父母PLUS贷款」会不会显示在他自己的账号里。

examples.en: The university put the Parent PLUS Loan in a section for family borrowing.
examples.zh: 学校把「美国父母PLUS贷款」放在了面向家庭的借款栏目。

collocations: apply for a Parent PLUS Loan

words.enDefinition: return of part of a card payment rather than the whole amount

examples.en: The seller sent a partial card refund for the missing item in my order.
examples.zh: 卖家把订单里漏掉的商品办了「部分退款到卡」。

examples.en: The receipt confirmed the partial card refund before it appeared in my app.
examples.zh: 「部分退款到卡」还没出现在应用里时，收据上已经确认了。

words.enDefinition: Repaying some of a loan before that amount is due

examples.en: The updated statement showed my partial prepayment next to the new principal balance.
examples.zh: 更新后的账单把我的「部分提前还款」列在新的剩余本金旁。

examples.en: I asked whether a partial prepayment would change the dates on my remaining payments.
examples.zh: 我问「部分提前还款」是否会改变余下各期的还款日期。

collocations: apply a partial prepayment to principal

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that covers only part of the costs of a person's studies

examples.en: The partial scholarship left a tuition balance that my family agreed to cover.
examples.zh: 「部分奖学金」没有付清学费，家里同意承担剩下的部分。

examples.en: I asked which housing expenses were included in the partial scholarship on offer.
examples.zh: 我问可以获发的「部分奖学金」包含哪些住宿费用。

words.enDefinition: Taking out some of a balance, leaving the rest

examples.en: I requested a partial withdrawal and left the rest of the money on deposit.
examples.zh: 我申请了「部分支取」，把剩余的钱继续存着。

examples.en: The letter showed how much would remain after the partial withdrawal was processed.
examples.zh: 信上写明了「部分支取」办妥后还会剩下多少。

words.enDefinition: a booklet recording deposits and withdrawals for a savings account

examples.en: My family still uses a passbook for a savings account at their local branch.
examples.zh: 我家还在用「存折」记录当地网点的一个储蓄账户。

examples.en: I asked the teller whether the passbook needed to be brought in for updating.
examples.zh: 我问柜员，更新记录时是不是需要把「存折」带到网点。

words.enDefinition: An account with a payment owed after its deadline

examples.en: The letter showed the past-due account number beside the current amount owed.
examples.zh: 信里把「逾期账户」的编号列在当前欠款金额旁。

examples.en: I asked the bank which month the past-due account first fell behind.
examples.zh: 我问银行这个「逾期账户」最早是从哪个月开始欠款的。

words.enDefinition: The portion of a bill that remains unpaid after its deadline

examples.en: The letter listed the past due amount above the payment for the current month.
examples.zh: 信中把「逾期未付金额」列在本月应付款上方。

examples.en: I asked whether the past due amount already included the fee listed below it.
examples.zh: 我问「逾期未付金额」是否已经包括下方列出的那笔费用。

words.enDefinition: A message saying a required payment remains unpaid after its deadline

examples.en: I received a past-due notice and checked it against my payment receipt.
examples.zh: 我收到了「逾期付款通知」，便拿出付款凭据核对。

examples.en: The past-due notice listed a balance from before the lender recorded my payment.
examples.zh: 「逾期付款通知」列出的是贷款机构给我那笔还款入账前的欠款余额。

words.enDefinition: temporarily stop a subscription without ending it permanently

examples.en: I can pause a subscription to the meal service while I'm away for spring break.
examples.zh: 春假外出期间，我可以「暂停订阅」这项配餐服务。

examples.en: The gym lets you pause a subscription during the summer if you're leaving town.
examples.zh: 暑假要离开这座城市的话，健身房允许「暂停订阅」。

collocations: pause a subscription for a month
an option to pause a subscription

words.enDefinition: To stop putting money away for a period

examples.en: I had to pause saving for the laptop when my shifts were cut.
examples.zh: 我的班次减少后，只好「暂时停止为买笔记本电脑存钱」。

examples.en: Did you pause saving for the trip while you were between part-time jobs?
examples.zh: 你换兼职的那段时间有「暂时停止为旅行存钱」吗？

words.enDefinition: pay for a service as you use it instead of committing in advance

examples.en: I prefer to pay as you go at the gym because I rarely go during exams.
examples.zh: 我更愿意去健身房「按使用付费」，因为备考时基本不去。

examples.en: You can pay as you go for bike rentals if you don't want a membership.
examples.zh: 租自行车不想办会员的话，可以「按使用付费」。

collocations: choose to pay as you go
pay as you go for gym visits

words.enDefinition: to make a payment using a debit card

examples.en: I asked if I could pay by debit for the books and stationery.
examples.zh: 我问书和文具能不能「用借记卡付款」。

examples.en: At the campus market, I chose to pay by debit instead of cash.
examples.zh: 在校园集市，我选择「用借记卡付款」，没有用现金。

collocations: allow customers to pay by debit

words.enDefinition: To reduce the amount owed through one or more payments

examples.en: The example showed how two small payments can pay down a balance over several weeks.
examples.zh: 例子展示了怎样通过两笔小额还款，在几周内「逐步偿还欠款」。

examples.en: I watched the total fall as I used spare cash to pay down a balance.
examples.zh: 我用手头的闲钱「逐步偿还欠款」，看着总欠款慢慢下降。

collocations: pay down a balance on a card

words.enDefinition: how often someone receives scheduled pay

examples.en: The student job handbook lists pay frequency alongside the expected working hours.
examples.zh: 学生工作手册在预计工作时间旁边注明了「发薪频率」。

examples.en: The two campus employers use different pay frequency settings in their systems.
examples.zh: 这两家校内雇主在各自系统里设置的「发薪频率」不同。

words.enDefinition: pay the regular price without a discount

examples.en: I had to pay full price because I left my student card at home.
examples.zh: 我把学生证落在家里了，只好「付原价」。

examples.en: We didn't want to pay full price with student discounts starting the next morning.
examples.zh: 学生优惠第二天一早就开始，我们「不想付原价」。

collocations: pay full price for a ticket

words.enDefinition: To pay the entire amount owed on a bill

examples.en: The app asks whether I want to pay in full or choose another amount.
examples.zh: 应用问我是想「全额还款」，还是想选择其他金额。

examples.en: Will the confirmation say I chose to pay in full for this month's bill?
examples.zh: 确认信息会写明我选择对本月账单「全额还款」吗？

collocations: pay in full by the due date

words.enDefinition: make a payment for something each month

examples.en: I chose to pay monthly for the sports pass because I'm leaving before summer.
examples.zh: 我夏天前就要走，所以体育通行证我选了「按月付款」。

examples.en: Does it cost extra to pay monthly for the same software after the student trial ends?
examples.zh: 学生试用结束后，同一个软件「按月付款」会更贵吗？

words.enDefinition: the amount someone is paid per unit of time or per unit of work

examples.en: The contract stated a different pay rate for the evening desk shift.
examples.zh: 合同为晚间值班规定了不同的「工资标准」。

examples.en: I checked the pay rate shown beside my hours on the statement.
examples.zh: 我核对了工资单上工时旁边列的「工资标准」。

collocations: an increase in your pay rate

words.enDefinition: to pay the amount remaining from a purchase with a card

examples.en: I used the gift voucher and asked to pay the balance by card.
examples.zh: 我用了礼品券，并问能不能「用银行卡付清余款」。

examples.en: The cashier said I could pay the balance by card after applying the discount.
examples.zh: 收银员说打完折后，我可以「用银行卡付清余款」。

collocations: allow me to pay the balance by card
ask to pay the balance by card
choose to pay the balance by card

words.enDefinition: the day on which a worker receives their pay

examples.en: The library posts its shift schedule a week before payday each month.
examples.zh: 图书馆每月会在「发薪日」前一周公布排班。

examples.en: My manager said payday falls on Friday for everyone in our department.
examples.zh: 经理说，我们部门所有人的「发薪日」都是周五。

words.zhGloss: 英国随工资预扣税制度
words.enDefinition: short for Pay As You Earn, a system used in the UK to collect income tax through payroll
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国随工资预扣税制度

examples.en: The UK payslip uses PAYE as the label for the income tax deduction.
examples.zh: 那张英国工资单把所得税扣款一栏标成「英国随工资预扣税制度」的缩写 PAYE。

examples.en: I heard about PAYE when the campus jobs team explained the sample payslip.
examples.zh: 校内就业团队讲解工资单样本时，我听到了「英国随工资预扣税制度」。

words.enDefinition: a personal label for a saved recipient in banking software

examples.en: I gave the residence office a payee nickname that I would recognize later.
examples.zh: 我给宿舍办公室设了一个以后认得出来的「收款人自定义名称」。

examples.en: The payee nickname appeared in my app, separate from the registered account name.
examples.zh: 应用里的「收款人自定义名称」与账户登记姓名分开显示。

words.enDefinition: Australian tax withheld by employers or other payers from certain payments

examples.en: The Australian payslip labelled the income tax amount as PAYG withholding under deductions.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的工资单在扣款项下把所得税标为「澳大利亚PAYG预扣税」。

examples.en: Our workshop showed where PAYG withholding appeared on an Australian income statement.
examples.zh: 讲座展示了澳大利亚收入报表上「澳大利亚PAYG预扣税」列在哪里。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of a payment across different balances or charges

examples.en: The statement showed the payment allocation across purchases, interest, and a cash advance.
examples.zh: 账单列出了消费欠款、利息和预借现金之间的「还款分配」。

examples.en: My lender explained the payment allocation with a breakdown of my latest installment.
examples.zh: 贷款机构把我最近一期的还款逐项拆分，解释了「还款分配」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement with the party owed money that sets when and how it will be paid

examples.en: The notice gave a separate phone number for questions about a payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 通知上另列了一个电话，专门解答「付款安排」方面的问题。

examples.en: I found the first instalment date in the tax agency's letter confirming the payment arrangement.
examples.zh: 我在税务机关确认「付款安排」的信里找到了第一期的日期。

words.enDefinition: an email that confirms a payment or records its details

examples.en: I saved the payment confirmation email with the documents for my weekend trip.
examples.zh: 我把「付款确认邮件」和周末旅行的资料放在一起。

examples.en: The payment confirmation email arrived after I had left the campus library.
examples.zh: 我离开学校图书馆之后，才收到了「付款确认邮件」。

words.enDefinition: a page displaying information or confirmation about a payment

examples.en: I checked the total before leaving the payment confirmation screen on my phone.
examples.zh: 离开手机上的「付款确认页面」前，我核对了总金额。

examples.en: The payment confirmation screen showed my order number and the amount I had paid.
examples.zh: 「付款确认页面」显示了订单号和已付金额。

collocations: return to the payment confirmation screen

words.enDefinition: an established route for payments between two countries or regions

examples.en: I asked which payment corridor the provider used for transfers to my home country.
examples.zh: 我问服务商向我家乡所在国家汇款时，会用哪条「跨境汇款线路」。

examples.en: The provider listed its fees separately for each payment corridor on the website.
examples.zh: 服务商网站按每条「跨境汇款线路」分别列了费用。

words.enDefinition: An agreement or arrangement to postpone a scheduled payment

examples.en: The lender's letter confirmed the new due date after the payment deferral.
examples.zh: 贷款机构的信确认了「延期还款」后的新到期日。

examples.en: I asked whether interest would accrue during the agreed payment deferral.
examples.zh: 我问在约定的「延期还款」期间是否还会计息。

words.enDefinition: shown when an attempt to pay could not be completed

examples.en: The website displayed payment failed after the checkout page stopped responding on my phone.
examples.zh: 手机上结账页面不动了，网站显示「付款失败」。

examples.en: The notification said payment failed, so I checked whether an order had been created.
examples.zh: 通知说「付款失败」，我就查了有没有生成订单。

words.enDefinition: an optional note recorded alongside a payment

examples.en: I asked whether the recipient would see the payment memo on her statement.
examples.zh: 我问收款人的账单上能不能看到「付款附言」。

examples.en: The payment memo showed the room number that I had entered earlier.
examples.zh: 「付款附言」显示了我先前填的房间号。

words.enDefinition: The date a payment is entered in an account's records

examples.en: The payment posting date was a day later than the date on my receipt.
examples.zh: 「还款入账日」比收据上的日期晚一天。

examples.en: The agent read back the payment posting date while we were checking the statement.
examples.zh: 我们核对账单时，客服复述了「还款入账日」。

words.enDefinition: A message that tells someone that a payment is coming due

examples.en: The payment reminder arrived on my phone while I was studying at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆学习时，手机收到了「还款提醒」。

examples.en: I checked the date in the payment reminder against the latest statement.
examples.zh: 我拿最新一期账单核对了「还款提醒」里的日期。

words.enDefinition: a device that accepts and processes payments at a checkout

examples.en: The shop put a payment terminal next to the self-service printer on campus.
examples.zh: 商店把一台「刷卡终端」放在校园自助打印机旁。

examples.en: The cashier turned the payment terminal towards me so I could see the amount.
examples.zh: 收银员把「刷卡终端」转向我，好让我看到金额。

collocations: enter a PIN on the payment terminal

words.enDefinition: The total needed to clear a debt on a particular date

examples.en: The payoff amount was different from the principal shown in the app.
examples.zh: 「一次性结清金额」与应用中显示的剩余本金不同。

examples.en: The lender explained which charges were included in the quoted payoff amount.
examples.zh: 贷款机构解释了报价的「一次性结清金额」包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: A dated estimate of the amount needed to clear a debt

examples.en: The payoff quote showed the total I would owe through next Wednesday.
examples.zh: 「结清报价单」列出了我截至下周三全额还清需支付的总额。

examples.en: I kept the payoff quote because it listed the amount and the date together.
examples.zh: 我保留了「结清报价单」，因为上面同时列出了金额和日期。

words.enDefinition: the currency in which the recipient is to receive money

examples.en: I asked whether the quote listed the correct payout currency for the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问报价上是否给收款人列了正确的「兑付币种」。

examples.en: The service displayed the payout currency beside the estimated delivery amount.
examples.zh: 服务商在预计到账金额旁边显示了「兑付币种」。

words.enDefinition: a local organization that delivers funds for a transfer provider

examples.en: The receipt listed the payout partner handling the cash collection at the other end.
examples.zh: 收据上列了在收款地负责现金领取的「付款合作机构」。

examples.en: I asked which payout partner would appear in the message sent to the recipient.
examples.zh: 我问发给收款人的消息会显示哪家「付款合作机构」。

words.enDefinition: a schedule showing when pay is processed and issued

examples.en: I checked the payroll calendar to see whether our next payment moved.
examples.zh: 我查了「发薪日历」，看看下次发薪日期有没有变。

examples.en: The payroll calendar lists a different deadline for student workers this month.
examples.zh: 「发薪日历」上列的本月学生员工截止日期不同。

words.enDefinition: the latest time for changes to be included in a particular pay run

examples.en: My supervisor approved the corrected hours a day after the payroll cutoff.
examples.zh: 「薪资结算截止时间」过了一天，主管才批准我更正后的工时。

examples.en: The office sent a reminder about the payroll cutoff for December's payments.
examples.zh: 办公室发了提醒，说明十二月工资的「薪资结算截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: money taken out of an employee's pay by the employer

examples.en: I asked what the payroll deduction on the second line was for.
examples.zh: 我问第二行的「工资扣款」是因为什么。

examples.en: My payslip showed a new payroll deduction after I joined the pension scheme.
examples.zh: 我加入养老金计划后，工资单上多了一项「工资扣款」。

words.enDefinition: the part of an organization responsible for calculating and paying wages

examples.en: The payroll department asked for the dates covered by my missing payment.
examples.zh: 「薪资部门」问我没收到的那笔工资对应哪些日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the message to the payroll department after speaking to my supervisor.
examples.zh: 和主管谈过后，我把消息转发给了「薪资部门」。

collocations: send a form to the payroll department

words.enDefinition: a reference number used to identify a worker in an employer's pay records

examples.en: I found my payroll number next to my name on the first payslip.
examples.zh: 我在第一张工资单上找到了姓名旁边的「薪资编号」。

examples.en: The payroll number on the form belongs to my previous campus job.
examples.zh: 表上的「薪资编号」属于我上一份校内工作。

words.enDefinition: an online system where staff can see and manage their pay information

examples.en: The payroll portal showed the deposit total before I received the bank notification.
examples.zh: 我收到银行通知之前，「薪资查询平台」就显示了到账金额。

examples.en: I had to use my staff login to open the payroll portal.
examples.zh: 我得用员工账号登录「薪资查询平台」。

collocations: log in to the payroll portal
view payslips in the payroll portal

words.enDefinition: the processing of wages and deductions for a group of workers at one time

examples.en: The corrected hours will be included in the next payroll run, the clerk said.
examples.zh: 办事员说，更正后的工时会纳入下一轮「薪资结算」。

examples.en: Our manager checked the timesheets before the payroll run at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末那一轮「薪资结算」开始前，经理核对了工时表。

words.enDefinition: a record showing what an employee earned, what was deducted and what was paid

examples.en: My first payslip arrived in the staff portal two days after my deposit.
examples.zh: 第一笔工资到账两天后，我在员工平台上收到了第一张「工资单」。

examples.en: I saved my payslip as a PDF before losing access to the old account.
examples.zh: 旧账号停用前，我把「工资单」保存成了 PDF。

words.enDefinition: a difference between the information on a payslip and the expected figures

examples.en: I noticed a payslip discrepancy when I compared my hours with the schedule.
examples.zh: 我拿工时和排班表核对时发现了「工资单上的差错」。

examples.en: My supervisor checked the approved shifts before replying about the payslip discrepancy.
examples.zh: 主管回复「工资单上的差错」之前，先核对了已批准的班次。

words.enDefinition: a transfer of money directly between individuals

examples.en: My roommate sent a peer-to-peer transfer for her share of the grocery bill.
examples.zh: 室友用「个人对个人转账」付了她分摊的那部分买菜钱。

examples.en: I found the peer-to-peer transfer in the app after my friend confirmed the date.
examples.zh: 朋友确认日期后，我在应用里找到了这笔「个人对个人转账」。

words.enDefinition: A higher annualized rate charged when certain account terms are broken

examples.en: The US card agreement explained when a penalty APR might be applied.
examples.zh: 美国这份信用卡协议解释了哪些情况下可能适用「惩罚性年利率」。

examples.en: The letter said my penalty APR would appear on the next statement.
examples.zh: 信里说我的「惩罚性年利率」将在下一期账单上显示。

words.enDefinition: Taking money out without a withdrawal penalty

examples.en: The bank sent a reminder about the last day for a penalty-free withdrawal.
examples.zh: 银行发来提醒，告知可以「免罚款支取」的最后一天。

examples.en: The clerk explained why a penalty-free withdrawal appeared as a separate option in my account.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了为什么我的账户会把「免罚款支取」单独列为一项。

words.enDefinition: a transaction still waiting to be fully processed and recorded

examples.en: The café purchase was showing as a pending transaction when I checked my phone.
examples.zh: 我看手机时，咖啡馆的消费还显示为一笔「待入账交易」。

examples.en: I matched the pending transaction to the receipt from the campus bookshop.
examples.zh: 我把这笔「待入账交易」和校园书店开的收据对上了。

words.enDefinition: a transfer entered in the system that is not yet complete

examples.en: I called the bank about a pending transfer that still appeared in the app.
examples.zh: 应用里还显示一笔「待处理的转账」，我就打电话向银行查询。

examples.en: The bank showed the pending transfer above the payments from the previous week.
examples.zh: 银行把「待处理的转账」显示在上周的付款记录上方。

collocations: follow up on a pending transfer

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted from wages for a pension plan

examples.en: My first pension deduction appeared after I received the confirmation of enrolment.
examples.zh: 收到加入计划的确认后，我第一次在工资单上看到「养老金缴费扣款」。

examples.en: The clerk explained why the pension deduction had changed on the corrected statement.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了为什么更正后的工资单上「养老金缴费扣款」变了。

words.zhGloss: 用于计算养老金的收入
words.enDefinition: the portion of earnings used to determine pension contributions or benefits under a particular plan
acceptedZhAnswers: 用于计算养老金的收入

examples.en: The statement shows pensionable earnings in a separate column beside my gross pay.
examples.zh: 工资单在工资总额旁边另列了一栏「用于计算养老金的收入」。

examples.en: I asked payroll which part of my wages counted as pensionable earnings.
examples.zh: 我问薪资部门，工资中哪一部分算「用于计算养老金的收入」。

words.enDefinition: the amount each person pays for a shared purchase or activity

examples.en: The per-person cost fell once two classmates joined our booking for the weekend trip.
examples.zh: 又有两个同学加入我们周末的出行预订后，「人均费用」降了。

examples.en: I worked out the per-person cost before asking everyone to pay for the shared dinner.
examples.zh: 我先算好「人均费用」，才请大家把聚餐的钱付了。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount allowed in a single payment

examples.en: The payment page displayed a per-transaction limit below the box for the amount.
examples.zh: 付款页面在金额输入框下方显示了「单笔交易限额」。

examples.en: I asked whether the per-transaction limit was different for purchases made outside the country.
examples.zh: 我问境外消费的「单笔交易限额」是不是不同。

words.enDefinition: a charge calculated as a percentage of an amount

examples.en: The quote showed a percentage fee beside the separate fixed charge.
examples.zh: 报价同时列了「按比例收费」和单独的固定费用。

examples.en: I asked which amount the service used to calculate its percentage fee.
examples.zh: 我问服务商用哪个金额来计算「按比例收费」。

collocations: a percentage fee on the amount sent

words.enDefinition: an account intended for personal rather than business use

examples.en: The form asked whether I needed a personal account or an account for a business.
examples.zh: 表格问我需要的是「个人用途账户」，还是企业用的账户。

examples.en: I checked whether the branch could print a statement for my personal account that day.
examples.zh: 我问网点当天能不能打印我「个人用途账户」的对账单。

collocations: a statement for a personal account

words.enDefinition: in the UK, the amount of income someone may receive before paying income tax

examples.en: The UK guide showed the personal allowance in a section about taxable income.
examples.zh: 英国指南在应税收入一节介绍了「英国个人免税额」。

examples.en: I asked why the personal allowance in the sample differed between two people.
examples.zh: 我问为什么样例里两个人的「英国个人免税额」不一样。

collocations: the amount of your personal allowance

words.enDefinition: a bank employee who helps individuals with account services

examples.en: The personal banker asked what I meant by a separate account for my savings.
examples.zh: 「个人银行业务专员」问我所说的另开账户存钱是什么意思。

examples.en: I showed the personal banker the letter that the university had sent me last week.
examples.zh: 我给「个人银行业务专员」看了学校上周寄给我的信。

words.enDefinition: a plan for managing your own income and expenses

examples.en: I made a personal budget before signing up for any paid societies.
examples.zh: 我先做了份「个人预算」，才决定报名哪些收费社团。

examples.en: My personal budget shows how much I can put toward a trip home.
examples.zh: 我的「个人预算」上列出了我能拿多少钱用来回家一趟。

words.enDefinition: A flexible borrowing arrangement allowing repeated draws within a limit

examples.en: The app listed my personal line of credit under borrowing rather than savings.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「个人循环信贷额度」列在借款栏，而非储蓄栏。

examples.en: I asked whether the personal line of credit had a separate statement from my other accounts.
examples.zh: 我问「个人循环信贷额度」的账单是否和其他账户分开。

collocations: open a personal line of credit
draw on a personal line of credit
repay a personal line of credit

words.enDefinition: Money borrowed by an individual for a private purpose

examples.en: The credit union listed the repayment terms for a personal loan online.
examples.zh: 信用合作社把「个人贷款」的还款条款放在了网上。

examples.en: I asked which fees the lender included in its personal loan quote.
examples.zh: 我问贷款机构的「个人贷款」报价包含哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: Money an individual has saved

examples.en: My personal savings grew a little during the months I worked at the library.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆工作的那几个月里，「个人积蓄」增加了一些。

examples.en: I keep my personal savings separate from the money my flatmates send for bills.
examples.zh: 我把「个人积蓄」和室友转给我缴账单的钱分开存放。

words.enDefinition: a tangible card issued for making payments or withdrawals

examples.en: I carried a physical card while my phone was charging in my room.
examples.zh: 手机留在房间里充电时，我带了一张「实体银行卡」出门。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I wanted to use my physical card or a digital wallet.
examples.zh: 收银员问我要用「实体银行卡」还是电子钱包。

words.enDefinition: a way to view or receive a reminder of a card PIN

examples.en: I asked about a PIN reminder when I visited the branch after class.
examples.zh: 下课去银行网点时，我问了「密码提醒」的事。

examples.en: The app offered a PIN reminder, but I waited until I got home.
examples.zh: 应用提供「密码提醒」功能，但我等到回家才打开。

words.enDefinition: a small amount regularly given for personal spending

examples.en: My parents still send me a little pocket money while I study abroad.
examples.zh: 我在国外上学，爸妈还是会给我一点「零花钱」。

examples.en: I saved up my pocket money to buy a used camera before the trip.
examples.zh: 我攒了「零花钱」，打算旅行前买台二手相机。

collocations: a weekly amount of pocket money

words.enDefinition: an amount taken from pay after the relevant tax has been calculated

examples.en: The staff donation appeared as a post-tax deduction on my December payslip.
examples.zh: 我的十二月工资单把员工捐款列为「税后扣款」。

examples.en: The presenter used a post-tax deduction to explain how the last total was calculated.
examples.zh: 讲解人用一项「税后扣款」来说明最后一个合计金额是怎么算出来的。

words.enDefinition: A payment that has been entered in the account records

examples.en: The posted payment reduced the amount owed on my card overnight.
examples.zh: 这笔「已入账还款」使我信用卡的欠款在一夜之间减少了。

examples.en: I printed the screen because it showed the posted payment and its amount.
examples.zh: 我把页面打印了下来，因为上面显示了这笔「已入账还款」及其金额。

words.enDefinition: a completed transaction recorded on an account

examples.en: I found the posted transaction listed beside my other purchases from the same day.
examples.zh: 我在同一天其他消费的旁边找到了这笔「已入账交易」。

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to view a posted transaction in the banking app.
examples.zh: 顾问给我看了在银行应用里怎么查「已入账交易」。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that has been entered on an account ledger

examples.en: I matched the posted transfer with the earlier confirmation in my email.
examples.zh: 我把「已记账的转账」和之前收到的确认邮件对上了。

examples.en: The bank explained which date on my statement belonged to the posted transfer.
examples.zh: 银行说明了账单上的哪个日期对应这笔「已记账的转账」。

collocations: a posted transfer on the statement
the date of a posted transfer

words.enDefinition: a student loan intended to help fund study at postgraduate level

examples.en: The adviser asked which postgraduate loan appeared in my funding application for next year.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的下一年资助申请里填的是哪种「研究生贷款」。

examples.en: My postgraduate loan appeared under a different heading from my previous undergraduate funding.
examples.zh: 我的「研究生贷款」显示在与以前本科资助不同的栏目下。

words.enDefinition: information supplied before payment about terms, rates, charges, and expected delivery

examples.en: The provider showed the pre-payment disclosure before asking me to confirm.
examples.zh: 服务商先展示了「付款前信息披露」，才让我确认。

examples.en: I checked whether the pre-payment disclosure listed the projected delivery date.
examples.zh: 我核对了「付款前信息披露」有没有列出预计到账日期。

collocations: a copy of the pre-payment disclosure

words.enDefinition: an amount taken from pay before the relevant tax is calculated

examples.en: The benefits guide gave an example of a pre-tax deduction for commuting costs.
examples.zh: 福利指南举了一个通勤费「税前扣款」的例子。

examples.en: I asked why this amount appeared under pre-tax deduction on the staff portal.
examples.zh: 我问这笔金额为什么在员工平台上归到「税前扣款」一栏。

words.enDefinition: An indication that a lender has provisionally approved an application

examples.en: The bank's preapproval letter said it still needed to verify my income.
examples.zh: 银行的「预先审批」通知说还需要核实我的收入。

examples.en: I asked how long the preapproval would remain valid while I compared offers.
examples.zh: 我问在比较不同报价期间，「预先审批」的结果能保留多久。

words.enDefinition: a debit card that spends money loaded in advance

examples.en: My host family asked whether my prepaid debit card could be used for groceries.
examples.zh: 寄宿家庭问我的「预付式借记卡」能不能用来买食品杂货。
