examples.en: I checked the balance on my prepaid debit card before paying for the train.
examples.zh: 付火车票钱前，我查了「预付式借记卡」的余额。

collocations: pay with a prepaid debit card

words.enDefinition: A charge for paying all or part of a loan ahead of schedule

examples.en: The US contract said when a prepayment penalty could apply to the loan.
examples.zh: 这份美国合同写明了贷款在什么情况下可能收取「提前还款违约金」。

examples.en: I asked whether the prepayment penalty appeared anywhere in the payoff quote.
examples.zh: 我问结清报价单上有没有列出「提前还款违约金」。

words.enDefinition: An initial estimate of eligibility based on limited information

examples.en: The prequalification form asked for less information than the full application did.
examples.zh: 「初步资格评估」表格要求填写的信息比正式申请少。

examples.en: Her prequalification letter gave a possible rate and listed several conditions.
examples.zh: 她的「初步资格评估」信里写了一个可能适用的利率，还列出了几项条件。

words.enDefinition: a seller's agreement to charge the same lower price as a competitor
acceptedZhAnswers: 商家按竞争对手的低价销售

examples.en: I asked for a price match after finding the same calculator for less elsewhere.
examples.zh: 我查到别处同款计算器更便宜，就问这家能不能「按对方的低价卖」。

examples.en: The campus shop offered a price match, so I bought the printer there after class.
examples.zh: 学校商店愿意「按对手的低价卖」，我就下课后在那里买了打印机。

words.enDefinition: the person listed first or designated as the main holder

examples.en: The bank asked the primary account holder to verify which mailing address it should use.
examples.zh: 银行请「主账户持有人」确认应该使用哪个邮寄地址。

examples.en: I checked who was named as the primary account holder in the letter they sent.
examples.zh: 我查了他们寄来的信，看上面把谁列为「主账户持有人」。

words.enDefinition: The original amount deposited before interest

examples.en: The bank listed the principal amount separately from the interest I had earned.
examples.zh: 银行把「本金金额」和我赚取的利息分开列出。

examples.en: I checked the principal amount on the confirmation against the transfer from my account.
examples.zh: 我核对了确认单上的「本金金额」和我账户的转账金额。

words.enDefinition: The borrowed amount together with the interest charged on it

examples.en: The chart showed how principal and interest made up each of my monthly payments.
examples.zh: 图表展示了我每月还款中的「本金和利息」各占多少。

examples.en: I asked whether the amount for principal and interest included any separate charges.
examples.zh: 我问「本金和利息」的金额是否包含另收的费用。

words.enDefinition: The part of the original borrowed amount still to be repaid

examples.en: The principal balance decreased after the lender recorded my most recent payment.
examples.zh: 贷款机构记下我最近一笔还款后，「剩余本金」减少了。

examples.en: I found the principal balance under a separate heading from the interest due.
examples.zh: 我在有别于应付利息的另一个栏目下找到了「剩余本金」。

words.enDefinition: Money applied toward the amount borrowed rather than associated costs

examples.en: The receipt showed my principal payment on a separate line from the interest.
examples.zh: 收据把「偿还本金的款项」和利息分行列出。

examples.en: I asked why the principal payment was smaller than the amount I sent.
examples.zh: 我问为什么「偿还本金的款项」比我汇出的总额少。

words.enDefinition: a student loan offered by a private lender instead of a public student aid program

examples.en: The guide compared a private student loan with the government loan in the example.
examples.zh: 指南对案例中的「私人机构学生贷款」和政府贷款做了比较。

examples.en: I contacted the lender listed next to the private student loan on my statement.
examples.zh: 我联系了报表上「私人机构学生贷款」旁边列的放贷机构。

collocations: take out a private student loan

words.enDefinition: evidence showing whose name is on an account

examples.en: The university asked for proof of account ownership before adding my details to its payment system.
examples.zh: 学校要求提供「账户归属证明」，然后才把我的资料录入付款系统。

examples.en: I asked whether the online letter would be accepted as proof of account ownership.
examples.zh: 我问那封网上信函能不能用作「账户归属证明」。

collocations: documents showing proof of account ownership

words.enDefinition: documents showing where a person lives or receives mail

examples.en: The teller asked for proof of address after checking the name on my passport.
examples.zh: 柜员核对护照上的姓名后，要求我提供「地址证明」。

examples.en: I checked which documents the branch would accept as proof of address this semester.
examples.zh: 我查了这个学期网点认可哪些材料作「地址证明」。

collocations: documents accepted as proof of address

words.enDefinition: a record confirming money was credited to the receiving account

examples.en: The university asked for proof of credit rather than the notice showing I had sent it.
examples.zh: 学校要的是「入账证明」，不是显示我已汇出的通知。

examples.en: I asked which office could provide proof of credit for the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 我问哪个部门可以为这笔正在核查的转账开具「入账证明」。

collocations: a copy of the proof of credit

words.enDefinition: documents or other evidence showing how much someone has earned from work

examples.en: Payroll sent proof of earnings that listed my wages from both part-time jobs.
examples.zh: 薪资部门发来「工作收入证明」，上面列了我两份兼职的工资。

examples.en: I asked whether the signed letter from my supervisor counted as proof of earnings.
examples.zh: 我问主管签字的信能不能算作「工作收入证明」。

collocations: accept payslips as proof of earnings

words.enDefinition: documents showing that someone has access to a stated amount

examples.en: The university asked for proof of funds before processing my application for the exchange program.
examples.zh: 学校要求先提供「资金证明」，才受理我的交换项目申请。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank could issue a letter to use as proof of funds.
examples.zh: 我问银行能不能开一封信作为「资金证明」。

collocations: a letter showing proof of funds

words.enDefinition: a charge adjusted to cover only part of a billing period

examples.en: I saw a prorated charge after I switched plans halfway through the month.
examples.zh: 月中换套餐后，我看到一笔「按比例计收的费用」。

examples.en: The first receipt showed a prorated charge because my membership started partway through July.
examples.zh: 因为我的会员是七月过了一段时间才开始的，第一张收据上列的是「按比例计收的费用」。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by a province

examples.en: The Canadian example shows provincial income tax in a separate part of the calculation.
examples.zh: 那个加拿大例子在计算式的另一部分列了「省级所得税」。

examples.en: I asked whether the figures listed there included provincial income tax from both jobs.
examples.zh: 我问那里列出的数字是否包含两份工作对应的「省级所得税」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary credit while a disputed charge is being investigated

examples.en: I asked whether the provisional credit could change after the bank finished its review.
examples.zh: 我问银行审查结束后，这笔「临时返还款」是否还可能调整。

examples.en: The account showed a provisional credit beside the date of my disputed purchase.
examples.zh: 账户在有争议的消费日期旁显示了一笔「临时返还款」。

words.enDefinition: The annualized interest rate charged on a card's purchase balance

examples.en: My statement showed a different purchase APR after the promotional period ended.
examples.zh: 优惠期结束后，账单上显示了不同的「刷卡消费年利率」。

examples.en: Can you show me where the purchase APR appears in the agreement?
examples.zh: 你能指给我看协议里哪一处写着「刷卡消费年利率」吗？

words.enDefinition: a record of things you have bought before

examples.en: I checked my purchase history to see when I last bought a printer cartridge.
examples.zh: 我查了「购买记录」，看上次是什么时候买的打印机墨盒。

examples.en: The shop's purchase history showed two orders for the same refill pack last month.
examples.zh: 店里的「购买记录」显示，上个月同样的补充装下了两单。

words.enDefinition: How much a given amount of money can buy

examples.en: The article explained how rising prices affected the purchasing power of my savings.
examples.zh: 文章解释了物价上涨会怎样影响我的储蓄的「购买力」。

examples.en: I noticed that the purchasing power of my travel fund had fallen since last summer.
examples.zh: 我发现，与去年夏天相比，我的旅行基金「购买力」下降了。

words.enDefinition: a code representing the stated reason for a transfer

examples.en: I asked the bank what the purpose code meant on the international payment screen.
examples.zh: 我问银行，国际付款页面上的「汇款用途代码」是什么意思。

examples.en: The clerk showed me the purpose code field separately from the optional note.
examples.zh: 工作人员给我指出了「汇款用途代码」一栏，它和选填附言分开。

words.enDefinition: decide to wait before buying something

examples.en: I put off a purchase when I realised I'd need the money for course materials.
examples.zh: 我意识到那笔钱得留着买课程资料，于是「把另一样东西晚点再买」。

examples.en: It's easy to put off a purchase when you can borrow the same thing.
examples.zh: 同样的东西能借到的话，就很容易「先不买」。

collocations: put off a purchase until payday
decide to put off a purchase

words.enDefinition: To keep small leftover amounts as savings

examples.en: My uncle used to put spare change aside in a jar beside the door.
examples.zh: 我叔叔以前总会「把零钱存进」门边的一个罐子里。

examples.en: I still put spare change aside when I come home from the campus market.
examples.zh: 从校园集市回来时，我还是会「把零钱存起来」。

collocations: put spare change aside in a jar
put spare change aside for later

words.enDefinition: The balance that meets a stated requirement

examples.en: The app listed the qualifying balance used to work out my bonus interest.
examples.zh: 应用列出了计算奖励利息所依据的「符合条件的账户余额」。

examples.en: I asked what counted toward the qualifying balance for the new savings offer.
examples.zh: 我问这项新储蓄优惠里，哪些钱计入「符合条件的账户余额」。

words.enDefinition: A message announcing a change in an interest rate

examples.en: The rate change notice showed when the new rate would apply to my savings.
examples.zh: 「利率变动通知」写明了我的存款何时开始适用新利率。

examples.en: I saved the rate change notice in the same folder as my welcome letter.
examples.zh: 我把「利率变动通知」和欢迎信保存在同一个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: To save the full amount planned

examples.en: I finally managed to reach a savings goal I had set before starting college.
examples.zh: 我终于「实现了一个储蓄目标」，那是我上大学前定下的。

examples.en: It felt good to reach a savings goal before booking the train home.
examples.zh: 在订回家的火车票前就能「实现储蓄目标」，感觉很好。

collocations: help someone reach a savings goal
work to reach a savings goal

words.enDefinition: To come to the end of an agreed deposit term

examples.en: The letter said my deposit would reach maturity on the tenth of next month.
examples.zh: 信上说，我的存款将在下个月十日「到期」。

examples.en: Did your deposit reach maturity before you moved to a different city last year?
examples.zh: 你去年搬去另一个城市之前，那笔存款已经「到期」了吗？

collocations: reach maturity at the end of the term

words.enDefinition: to restore an unused account to active status

examples.en: I went to the branch to ask how to reactivate an account opened years ago.
examples.zh: 我去网点问，多年前开的账户怎样能「重新激活账户」。

examples.en: The banker explained which form to use to reactivate an account that had become dormant.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员说明，账户休眠后要用哪张表「重新激活账户」。

collocations: ask how to reactivate an account

words.enDefinition: To increase savings again after using them

examples.en: How long did it take to rebuild your savings after you moved to Bristol?
examples.zh: 搬到布里斯托尔后，您花了多久「重新攒起储蓄」？

examples.en: When did you begin to rebuild your savings after the repairs were finally paid for?
examples.zh: 终于付清维修费后，你什么时候开始「重新积攒储蓄」的？

collocations: take time to rebuild your savings
rebuild your savings after a move

words.enDefinition: a physical or digital folder for storing receipts

examples.en: I keep a receipt folder on my phone for things I might need to return.
examples.zh: 我在手机上建了个「收据文件夹」，存放可能要退货的购物收据。

examples.en: Our house has a receipt folder by the door for anything we buy together.
examples.zh: 我们在住处门边放了一个「收据文件夹」，大家一起买东西的收据都放进去。

collocations: keep it in your receipt folder

words.enDefinition: the category of account to which a payment is directed

examples.en: The form asked for the recipient account type before showing the delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 表格让我先填「收款账户类型」，然后才显示预计到账时间。

examples.en: I asked the bank which part of the notice specified the recipient account type.
examples.zh: 我问银行，通知哪一部分写了「收款账户类型」。

words.enDefinition: the country where funds are intended to be delivered

examples.en: The quote changed when I corrected the recipient country in the online form.
examples.zh: 我更正网上表格的「收款国家」后，报价变了。

examples.en: I checked that the form listed the right recipient country before saving it.
examples.zh: 保存表格前，我确认了上面列的「收款国家」没有填错。

words.enDefinition: information needed to identify the person receiving a payment

examples.en: The bank asked me to review the recipient details before confirming the transfer.
examples.zh: 银行让我确认转账之前，先检查「收款人资料」。

examples.en: I checked the recipient details against the invoice from the residence office.
examples.zh: 我按宿舍办公室发来的账单核对了「收款人资料」。

words.enDefinition: a payment taken from a card repeatedly at agreed times

examples.en: I checked which recurring card payment covered my student music subscription that month.
examples.zh: 我查了当月的学生音乐订阅对应哪一笔「定期银行卡扣款」。

examples.en: The portal showed a recurring card payment for the language software I had renewed.
examples.zh: 在线系统显示我续订的语言软件有一笔「定期银行卡扣款」。

collocations: set up a recurring card payment

words.enDefinition: expenses that come up repeatedly at regular intervals

examples.en: I put all my recurring expenses in one list so I wouldn't miss annual renewals.
examples.zh: 我把所有「经常性支出」列在一起，免得漏掉每年续订的项目。

examples.en: Even small recurring expenses can take up a large part of a student's budget.
examples.zh: 金额不大的「经常性支出」加起来也可能占学生预算的很大一部分。

words.enDefinition: A repeated transfer of money into savings

examples.en: My recurring savings transfer appears on the statement on the fifth of each month.
examples.zh: 我的「定期储蓄转账」在每月五日出现在账单上。

examples.en: Can I change the date of a recurring savings transfer without cancelling it first?
examples.zh: 我能在不先取消「定期储蓄转账」的情况下更改日期吗？

words.enDefinition: a transfer repeated automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: I checked when the recurring transfer for my shared bills was due to run.
examples.zh: 我查了分摊账单用的「周期性转账」下次什么时候执行。

examples.en: The app listed the recurring transfer separately from payments I had made that morning.
examples.zh: 应用把「周期性转账」和我那天早上手动付的款分开列出。

words.enDefinition: to make the sum to be borrowed smaller before the full amount is issued

examples.en: The website showed me where to request permission to reduce a loan amount.
examples.zh: 网站指明了我可以在哪儿申请「调低贷款金额」。

examples.en: The adviser explained when students can reduce a loan amount before it is disbursed.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了学生何时可以在款项发放前「调低贷款金额」。

collocations: ask to reduce a loan amount
choose to reduce a loan amount
reduce a loan amount before disbursement

words.enDefinition: marked down so remaining stock will sell quickly

examples.en: The bread was reduced to clear just before the shop closed for the night.
examples.zh: 快打烊的时候，店里的面包「降价清仓」了。

examples.en: I found a winter coat reduced to clear at a shop near the station.
examples.zh: 我在车站附近一家店里找到一件「降价清仓」的冬外套。

words.enDefinition: a form field for a payment reference or identifying note

examples.en: I asked where the reference field was on the updated payment form.
examples.zh: 我问更新后的付款表上「附言填写栏」在哪里。

examples.en: The reference field appeared beneath the area for the recipient's account details.
examples.zh: 「附言填写栏」显示在填写收款账户资料的区域下方。

words.enDefinition: a refund has started but the money has not yet arrived

examples.en: The app displayed refund pending beside the returned order from the bookshop.
examples.zh: 应用在书店那笔退货订单旁显示「退款处理中」。

examples.en: The email said refund pending, so I waited to see the updated statement.
examples.zh: 邮件显示「退款处理中」，我就等着看更新后的账单。

words.enDefinition: how long it takes a refund to be completed

examples.en: The website included the refund processing time in its guide to returns.
examples.zh: 网站在退货指南里写了「退款处理时长」。

examples.en: I asked about the refund processing time after the courier collected my order.
examples.zh: 快递员取走退货后，我问了「退款处理时长」。

words.enDefinition: a reference that identifies a refund in payment records

examples.en: The shop shared a refund reference after receiving my parcel on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 商店周二收到我的退件后，发来一个「退款参考编号」。

examples.en: I asked whether the refund reference would help the bank find the payment.
examples.zh: 我问「退款参考编号」是否能帮助银行找到这笔款项。

words.enDefinition: money repaid to the same card used for a purchase

examples.en: I requested a refund to the original card after showing the cashier my receipt.
examples.zh: 我出示收据后，请收银员办理「退回原付款卡的退款」。

examples.en: The receipt showed a refund to the original card even though the bank had replaced it.
examples.zh: 尽管银行已经换发了卡，收据还是显示为「退回原付款卡的退款」。

collocations: request a refund to the original card
process a refund to the original card
receive a refund to the original card

words.enDefinition: a tax credit that can be paid out when it exceeds the tax owed, subject to the applicable rules

examples.en: The workshop showed how a refundable tax credit could result in a refund.
examples.zh: 讲座演示了「可退还的税额抵免」怎样带来退税。

examples.en: I asked the tutor how a refundable tax credit was represented in the example.
examples.zh: 我问导师，例子里是怎么表示「可退还的税额抵免」的。

collocations: qualify for a refundable tax credit
the value of a refundable tax credit

words.enDefinition: to enroll to use a bank's services through the internet

examples.en: I asked whether I could register for online banking before receiving the welcome letter.
examples.zh: 我问收到银行欢迎信之前能不能「注册网上银行」。

examples.en: The bank sent a leaflet explaining how to register for online banking from home.
examples.zh: 银行发来一张折页，介绍怎么在家「注册网上银行」。

collocations: help someone register for online banking
decide to register for online banking
instructions to register for online banking

words.enDefinition: pay for ordinary working hours apart from overtime and other extras

examples.en: The first line shows regular earnings for the hours I worked during term.
examples.zh: 第一行列出了我这学期上班的「正常工时收入」。

examples.en: I asked why the extra shift appeared under regular earnings this month.
examples.zh: 我问新增的班次为什么这月列在「正常工时收入」一栏。

words.enDefinition: an account designed for saving money at regular intervals

examples.en: The brochure described a regular savings account in a section about making monthly deposits.
examples.zh: 宣传册在关于每月存款的章节介绍了一款「定期存入型储蓄账户」。

examples.en: I asked how the regular savings account differed from my other account at the branch.
examples.zh: 我向网点询问「定期存入型储蓄账户」和我另一个账户有什么区别。

collocations: terms of a regular savings account

words.enDefinition: To add interest earned back into the deposit

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted to reinvest interest when the deposit was renewed.
examples.zh: 表格问我续存时是否想「把利息继续存入」。

examples.en: The app offered a choice to reinvest interest or have it paid separately.
examples.zh: 应用提供了两个选项，可以「把利息继续存入」，也可以把它单独划出。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the receiving or sending service refuses to process

examples.en: The provider gave me a reason code for the rejected transfer.
examples.zh: 服务商给了我这笔「被拒绝受理的转账」对应的原因代码。

examples.en: I asked when my bank would update the record for the rejected transfer.
examples.zh: 我问银行什么时候更新那笔「被拒绝受理的转账」的记录。

collocations: a notice about a rejected transfer
check the reason for a rejected transfer

words.enDefinition: to remove a temporary restriction on money or available credit

examples.en: I asked when the shop could release a hold from the cancelled order.
examples.zh: 我询问了商店什么时候能为取消的订单「解除金额冻结」。

examples.en: The bank explained how long it might take to release a hold on my card.
examples.zh: 银行解释了卡上要等多久才可能「解除金额冻结」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of money left in an account

examples.en: I asked what would happen to the remaining balance if I closed the account.
examples.zh: 我问，销户后账户的「账户余款」会怎么处理。

examples.en: The banker pointed out the remaining balance before asking me to check the statement.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员先指给我看了「账户余款」，再请我核对对账单。

words.enDefinition: a notice telling a payee which payment was sent and why

examples.en: I sent the remittance advice so the university could match my payment to the invoice.
examples.zh: 我发了「汇款通知单」，方便学校把我的付款和发票对上。

examples.en: The accounts office asked whether the remittance advice identified the particular term's fees.
examples.zh: 学校财务办公室问「汇款通知单」有没有写明是哪个学期的费用。

words.enDefinition: a company or bank that sends money for customers

examples.en: The remittance provider gave me a reference to use when calling about the payment.
examples.zh: 「汇款服务商」给了我一个编号，打电话查这笔款时可以用。

examples.en: I asked the remittance provider to send me another copy of the fee disclosure.
examples.zh: 我请「汇款服务商」再发给我一份费用披露文件。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization that sends a money transfer

examples.en: The clerk asked what name appeared under remitter on the transfer receipt.
examples.zh: 工作人员问转账收据「汇款人」一栏填的是谁的名字。

examples.en: I asked the university whether it needed the remitter details for its records.
examples.zh: 我问学校是不是要把「汇款人」的信息留档。

words.enDefinition: delete a saved recipient from one's payment list

examples.en: I asked where I could remove a beneficiary after moving to a different residence.
examples.zh: 搬到另一处宿舍以后，我问可以在哪里「删除已存收款人」。

examples.en: The bank said the option to remove a beneficiary was separate from the transfer screen.
examples.zh: 银行说「删除已存收款人」的选项不在转账界面上。

collocations: ask how to remove a beneficiary
an option to remove a beneficiary

words.enDefinition: To continue a term deposit for another agreed period

examples.en: The bank's email explained how to renew a term deposit through the online account.
examples.zh: 银行在邮件中说明了如何用网上账户「续存一笔定期存款」。

examples.en: I called because I couldn't find the option to renew a term deposit online.
examples.zh: 我在线上找不到「续存定期存款」的选项，就打了电话。

collocations: choose to renew a term deposit

words.enDefinition: a scholarship that can continue into another term or year if its conditions are met

examples.en: I kept the letter explaining how to maintain my renewable scholarship next year.
examples.zh: 我保存了那封信，上面说明怎样在下一年续领「可续领奖学金」。

examples.en: The offer describes a renewable scholarship that continues after each successful annual review.
examples.zh: 通知介绍了一项「可续领奖学金」，每年评审通过后就能续领。

words.enDefinition: The interest rate offered for a renewed deposit

examples.en: The letter listed a renewal rate for each new term the bank was offering.
examples.zh: 银行为信中提供的每种新存期都列了一个「续存利率」。

examples.en: I checked whether the renewal rate in the email matched the one on the app.
examples.zh: 我核对了邮件中的「续存利率」和应用里显示的是否一致。

words.enDefinition: support that helps an eligible borrower manage or reduce required loan payments

examples.en: The application for repayment assistance asked for the dates covered by my income records.
examples.zh: 「还款援助」申请表询问了我的收入记录涵盖哪些日期。

examples.en: I received a notice about repayment assistance after the service reviewed my documents.
examples.zh: 服务机构审核我的材料后，我收到了一份「还款援助」通知。

words.enDefinition: How often payments are scheduled under a repayment agreement

examples.en: The form let me choose a repayment frequency before showing the estimated amounts.
examples.zh: 表格让我选定「还款频率」后才显示预计还款金额。

examples.en: The adviser confirmed my repayment frequency and read out the next payment date.
examples.zh: 顾问确认了我的「还款频率」，并念出了下次还款日期。

words.enDefinition: A timetable showing the amounts and dates of planned repayments

examples.en: The repayment schedule listed each expected payment all the way through next June.
examples.zh: 「还款时间表」列出了到明年六月为止的每一笔计划还款。

examples.en: I noticed a different date in the updated repayment schedule the bank sent.
examples.zh: 我发现银行发来的新版「还款时间表」中有个日期变了。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a borrower begins the required repayment period

examples.en: I entered the repayment start date in my calendar after reading the notice.
examples.zh: 我看完通知后，把「还款起始日期」填进了日历。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the repayment start date matched the date in my account.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了「还款起始日期」是否和我账户里显示的日期一致。

words.enDefinition: the current stage or standing of a loan's repayment, as recorded by the provider

examples.en: The loan website updated my repayment status when my last scheduled payment cleared.
examples.zh: 最后一笔计划还款到账后，贷款网站更新了我的「还款状态」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to bring a statement showing the current repayment status.
examples.zh: 顾问让我带一份能显示当前「还款状态」的对账单。

collocations: review the repayment status of a loan

words.enDefinition: the income level above which payments become due under some income-based student loan systems

examples.en: The UK guide showed how the repayment threshold differed between two loan plans.
examples.zh: 英国指南展示了两种贷款计划的「启动还款收入门槛」有何不同。

examples.en: I asked which year's repayment threshold was used on the sample payslip.
examples.zh: 我问工资单样本用的是哪一年的「启动还款收入门槛」。

words.enDefinition: a new card issued in place of an existing card

examples.en: My replacement card arrived just before I left for the summer exchange programme.
examples.zh: 我出发参加暑期交换项目之前，「补发的银行卡」正好到了。

examples.en: I asked whether the replacement card would be sent to the bank branch.
examples.zh: 我问「补发的银行卡」会不会寄到银行网点。

words.enDefinition: To replace money spent from emergency savings

examples.en: It took me several months to replenish an emergency fund after the unexpected trip.
examples.zh: 那次临时出行后，我花了几个月才「补足应急金」。

examples.en: She used part of her tutoring money to replenish an emergency fund she'd drawn on.
examples.zh: 她拿出一部分辅导课收入，「补足了之前动用过的应急金」。

collocations: work to replenish an emergency fund
replenish an emergency fund after a withdrawal

words.enDefinition: to tell the issuer a card cannot be found

examples.en: I used the bank's number to report a lost card after leaving the station.
examples.zh: 离开车站后，我打银行电话「挂失银行卡」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how to report a lost card while I was overseas.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了人在海外怎么「挂失银行卡」。

collocations: call to report a lost card
need to report a lost card

words.enDefinition: to disclose the amount or source of income on a required form

examples.en: The volunteer showed where students who do casual work can report income in the example.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，打零工的学生应在样表的什么位置「申报收入」。

examples.en: The worksheet asked readers to report income from two different kinds of work.
examples.zh: 计算表要求读者「申报收入」，分别填上两种工作赚的钱。

words.enDefinition: money that applicable rules require a person to disclose on a financial or tax form

examples.en: During the workshop, we discussed how the form distinguishes reportable income from gifts.
examples.zh: 讲座上，我们讨论了那张表如何区分「须申报的收入」与赠与。

examples.en: I wrote down the question about reportable income before speaking with the adviser.
examples.zh: 在和顾问交谈前，我先记下了关于「须申报的收入」的问题。

words.enDefinition: in UK credit advertising, an annual percentage rate the advertiser expects at least 51% of resulting credit agreements to receive at that rate or lower

examples.en: The UK advertisement displayed a representative APR directly below the borrowing example.
examples.zh: 英国的广告在借款示例正下方显示了「代表性年化利率」。

examples.en: I asked why my quote differed from the advertised representative APR.
examples.zh: 我问为什么我的报价和广告中的「代表性年化利率」不同。

words.enDefinition: a set payment to support a student or researcher while carrying out research

examples.en: The research stipend arrived at the start of each month during my project.
examples.zh: 做项目期间，我每个月月初都收到「研究津贴」。

examples.en: My funding letter listed the research stipend separately from money for project expenses.
examples.zh: 资助函把「研究津贴」和项目开支经费分开列出。

collocations: the amount of a research stipend

words.enDefinition: funding for a student to undertake a research degree or project, often including fees or a stipend

examples.en: The department advertised a research studentship for a project on coastal ecology.
examples.zh: 院系为一项海岸生态项目发布了「研究生培养资助」招募通知。

examples.en: I asked what living allowance came with the research studentship on the website.
examples.zh: 我问网站上的「研究生培养资助」配有多少生活津贴。

words.enDefinition: The amount someone aims to keep in reserve

examples.en: My reserve target changed after I moved closer to campus and cut my travel costs.
examples.zh: 搬到离学校更近的地方、交通费减少以后，我调了「储备金的目标金额」。

examples.en: The spreadsheet shows how far I am from the reserve target I set in September.
examples.zh: 电子表格显示了我距离九月设定的「储备金目标金额」还差多少。

words.enDefinition: to set a new password for online banking access

examples.en: The guide explains where to reset your online banking password if you forget it.
examples.zh: 指南说明忘记密码后，可以在哪里「重设网银密码」。

examples.en: The adviser said, “You can reset your online banking password through the official app.”
examples.zh: 顾问说：“你可以通过官方应用「重设网银密码」。”

collocations: an option to reset your online banking password
a page to reset your online banking password
ask how to reset your online banking password

words.enDefinition: to create a new personal identification number for a card

examples.en: The bank's help page explains how to reset your PIN after it gets locked.
examples.zh: 银行帮助页说明了密码锁定后怎样「重设银行卡密码」。

examples.en: The banking booklet explains where to reset your PIN if you've forgotten the old one.
examples.zh: 银行手册说明了忘记旧密码时去哪里「重设银行卡密码」。

collocations: reset your PIN in the app

words.enDefinition: a person treated as resident under the tax rules that apply to them

examples.en: The example asked whether the student was a resident for tax purposes that year.
examples.zh: 例子要求判断这名学生当年是不是「税务居民」。

examples.en: I asked where the guide defined the term resident for tax purposes.
examples.zh: 我问指南在哪里定义了「税务居民」这一术语。

collocations: be a resident for tax purposes
treated as a resident for tax purposes
qualify as a resident for tax purposes

words.enDefinition: the place where someone actually lives

examples.en: The bank asked for a residential address and a separate place to send letters.
examples.zh: 银行要求填写「居住地址」，还问了另外收信的地址。

examples.en: I updated my residential address after I moved out of my first student flat.
examples.zh: 我搬出第一套学生公寓后，更新了「居住地址」。

words.enDefinition: To start setting aside money again

examples.en: I hope to resume saving for the course when the new term starts.
examples.zh: 我希望新学期开始时能「重新开始为课程存钱」。

examples.en: After the move, Mia was able to resume saving for a new laptop.
examples.zh: 搬家后，米娅又能「重新开始为买新笔记本电脑存钱」了。

words.enDefinition: shopping done to make yourself feel better

examples.en: I joked that my new notebook was retail therapy after a difficult week.
examples.zh: 我开玩笑说，这本新笔记本是我那周过得不顺时「买来解闷」的。

examples.en: She went for a walk instead of going into town for some retail therapy.
examples.zh: 她出去散了个步，没有进城「购物解闷」。

collocations: go out for some retail therapy

words.enDefinition: additional pay for a past period after a change was made effective from an earlier date

examples.en: The new rate took effect last month, so my statement included retroactive pay.
examples.zh: 新工资标准从上个月生效，所以工资单包含「追溯补发的工资」。

examples.en: I asked which weeks the retroactive pay on my latest statement covered.
examples.zh: 我问最近工资单上的「追溯补发的工资」对应哪几周。

words.enDefinition: in US student aid, the process of returning unearned federal aid when a student withdraws

examples.en: The adviser used a sample calculation to explain the return of Title IV funds.
examples.zh: 顾问用计算示例讲解了「美国联邦助学款退回」流程。

examples.en: My withdrawal notice said that the return of Title IV funds was being calculated.
examples.zh: 退学通知说，学校正在计算「美国联邦助学款退回」的金额。

collocations: calculate the return of Title IV funds
a return of Title IV funds policy
a return of Title IV funds notice

words.enDefinition: A charge when an attempted payment is sent back unpaid

examples.en: I saw a returned payment fee after the bank sent my payment back.
examples.zh: 银行退回我的还款之后，我看到一笔「还款退回手续费」。

examples.en: The card issuer explained the returned payment fee listed beside my reversed payment.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了那笔撤销的还款旁边列出的「还款退回手续费」。

words.enDefinition: a payment that was sent back from the receiving side

examples.en: I asked who could explain the note linked to my returned transfer.
examples.zh: 我问谁能解释「已退回的转账」所附的备注。

examples.en: The bank put the returned transfer beneath the original outgoing transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 银行在账单上把「已退回的转账」列在原来的转出记录下面。

collocations: a notice about a returned transfer

words.enDefinition: a transaction that has been undone or cancelled in account records

examples.en: The adviser showed me how to recognise a reversed transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我怎么识别对账单上「已冲正的交易」。

examples.en: I matched the reversed transaction with the amount on the shop's cancellation notice.
examples.zh: 我把「已冲正的交易」和商店取消通知上的金额对上了。

words.enDefinition: Borrowing that can be used again as balances are repaid

examples.en: The booklet listed credit cards as a familiar example of revolving credit.
examples.zh: 手册把信用卡列为「循环信贷」的常见例子。

examples.en: The agreement explained how revolving credit worked when part of the balance was repaid.
examples.zh: 协议解释了偿还部分欠款后「循环信贷」如何运作。

words.enDefinition: To protect saved money for a specific purpose

examples.en: We decided to ring-fence savings for the trip before we started planning a party.
examples.zh: 开始筹备派对之前，我们决定把旅行那笔钱「专款留用」。

examples.en: The app gives me a way to ring-fence savings for my course without opening another account.
examples.zh: 这个应用让我可以把课程费用「专款留用」，不用再开一个账户。

words.enDefinition: carry unspent money forward into the next period

examples.en: This app lets me roll over unused funds from groceries into next month's food budget.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以把我买食品杂货的「未用资金结转」到下个月的伙食预算。

examples.en: We can roll over unused funds from this week's trip to the next one.
examples.zh: 我们可以把本周出行的「未用资金结转」到下一次出行。

collocations: roll over unused funds to next month
roll over unused funds from last term
let you roll over unused funds

words.enDefinition: money a spending plan can still accommodate

examples.en: Do we have room in the budget for a taxi if it rains tonight?
examples.zh: 如果今晚下雨，我们还有没有打车的「预算空间」？

examples.en: I checked whether there was room in the budget for one more driving lesson.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，看看还有没有再上一节驾校课的「预算空间」。

collocations: find room in the budget for something

words.enDefinition: Saving the difference when a purchase is rounded up

examples.en: The app labels the small amounts from my card purchases as round-up savings.
examples.zh: 应用把我刷卡时每笔金额向上取整产生的差额标为「支付进位储蓄」。

examples.en: I checked whether round-up savings were active before looking for the missing transfer.
examples.zh: 寻找那笔没看到的转账之前，我先查了「支付进位储蓄」是否已开启。

words.enDefinition: have no money left to spend

examples.en: I don't want to run out of money halfway through my trip home.
examples.zh: 我不想回家的路才走一半就「把钱花光」。

examples.en: When did you realise you might run out of money before the next pay date?
examples.zh: 你什么时候意识到可能还没到下次发薪日就会「把钱花光」？

collocations: run out of money before payday
be about to run out of money

words.enDefinition: a transfer expected to reach its destination on the sending day

examples.en: I asked the bank about the deadline for a same-day transfer that Friday.
examples.zh: 我向银行询问了那个星期五办理「当日转账」的截止时间。

examples.en: The page showed a same-day transfer option next to the standard delivery estimate.
examples.zh: 页面上在标准到账时间估计旁边列了一个「当日转账」选项。

words.zhGloss: 美国学业进展资助申诉
words.enDefinition: a request to restore US financial aid eligibility after missing satisfactory academic progress requirements
acceptedZhAnswers: 美国学业进展资助申诉

examples.en: The US university sent a checklist of evidence I could include in my SAP appeal.
examples.zh: 美国大学给了我一份清单，列出「美国学业进展资助申诉」可附的证明材料。

examples.en: I submitted the SAP appeal after my academic adviser signed the updated plan.
examples.zh: 学业顾问签署更新后的计划后，我提交了「美国学业进展资助申诉」。

words.enDefinition: To put bonus pay into savings

examples.en: Were you able to save a bonus from your holiday shifts for the train home?
examples.zh: 你把假期上班拿到的「奖金存下来」买回家的火车票了吗？

examples.en: I was able to save a bonus from work toward my university travel fund.
examples.zh: 我得以把工作发的「一笔奖金存入」大学期间的旅行基金。

words.enDefinition: To set aside the same amount each time

examples.en: I used to save a fixed amount from every paycheck during my summer job.
examples.zh: 暑期打工时，我以前每次发工资都会「存下固定金额」。

examples.en: The app lets me save a fixed amount on the same day each month.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我每个月在同一天「存下固定金额」。

collocations: save a fixed amount each week
save a fixed amount per paycheck
choose to save a fixed amount

words.expression: save a little at a time
words.lemma: save a little at a time
words.enDefinition: To build savings through small amounts
acceptedEnVariants: save a little at a time

examples.en: I had to save a little at a time for my first used bike.
examples.zh: 为了买第一辆二手自行车，我只能「一点一点地存钱」。

examples.en: We could only save a little at a time while we were on placement.
examples.zh: 我们实习期间只能「一点一点地存钱」。

collocations: start to save a little at a time
learn to save a little at a time
manage to save a little at a time

words.enDefinition: To put unexpected money into savings

examples.en: My sister decided to save a windfall she received when a utility company corrected an old bill.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司更正一张旧账单后，姐姐收到一笔退款，决定「把这笔意外所得存起来」。

examples.en: I decided to save a windfall from a writing contest for the trip home.
examples.zh: 我决定「存下写作比赛意外获得的奖金」，用在回家的路上。

words.enDefinition: To save money for future unexpected needs

examples.en: My grandmother used to say she liked to save for a rainy day.
examples.zh: 我奶奶以前常说，她喜欢「存钱以备不时之需」。

examples.en: Since my shifts vary, I try to save for a rainy day when work is steady.
examples.zh: 因为我的班次不固定，所以工作稳定时我会尽量「存钱以备不时之需」。

collocations: try to save for a rainy day
learn to save for a rainy day
start to save for a rainy day

words.enDefinition: pay less for getting an order sent to you

examples.en: We ordered the books together to save on delivery and shared the cost afterwards.
examples.zh: 我们一起订书来「省运费」，之后再分摊花销。

examples.en: I collected the shelf after class to save on delivery and avoid waiting at home.
examples.zh: 下课后我去自取架子，好「省运费」，也不用在家等。

words.zhGloss: 从每笔工资中存下一部分
words.enDefinition: To keep some of every wage payment as savings
acceptedZhAnswers: 从每笔工资中存下一部分

examples.en: I try to save part of each paycheck for the train fare home.
examples.zh: 我尽量「从每笔工资中存下一部分」，用来买回家的火车票。

examples.en: When she worked at the bookshop, Lena chose to save part of each paycheck.
examples.zh: 莉娜在书店工作时，选择「从每笔工资中存下一部分」。

collocations: save part of each paycheck for travel
manage to save part of each paycheck
consistently save part of each paycheck

words.enDefinition: To put money aside on a regular basis

examples.en: I found it easier to save regularly once my work schedule stayed the same.
examples.zh: 工作时间固定下来后，我发现「定期存钱」更容易了。

examples.en: My brother started to save regularly during his first year at the university.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在大学一年级时开始「定期存钱」。

collocations: find it hard to save regularly

words.enDefinition: payment details retained by a website, app or account

examples.en: The app showed one saved payment method when I ordered dinner after class.
examples.zh: 下课后点晚饭时，应用显示一种「已保存的付款方式」。

examples.en: I removed a saved payment method before handing the old phone to my sister.
examples.zh: 把旧手机给姐姐之前，我删除了一种「已保存的付款方式」。

words.enDefinition: an account used to keep money for future use

examples.en: I opened a savings account for money I had set aside over the summer.
examples.zh: 我开了一个「储蓄账户」，存我暑假攒下的钱。

examples.en: My savings account appeared on a separate page of the bank's online dashboard.
examples.zh: 我的「储蓄账户」显示在银行在线界面的另一个页面上。

collocations: put money in a savings account

words.enDefinition: The amount currently held in savings

examples.en: I checked my savings balance before deciding whether to book the train that night.
examples.zh: 那天晚上决定要不要订票之前，我先查了「储蓄余额」。

examples.en: The interest payment increased my savings balance by a few euros in October.
examples.zh: 十月份的利息入账让我的「储蓄余额」增加了几欧元。

words.enDefinition: A planned activity designed to encourage saving money

examples.en: Our residence hall ran a savings challenge during the first month of term.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼在学期第一个月开展了一项「储蓄挑战」。

examples.en: I joined a savings challenge with friends to see how much we could put away.
examples.zh: 我和朋友参加了一项「储蓄挑战」，看看大家能存下多少钱。

words.enDefinition: An amount of money added to savings

examples.en: The bank lists each savings contribution beside the date it reached my account.
examples.zh: 银行在每笔「存入储蓄的钱」旁边都标明了到账日期。

examples.en: My regular savings contribution was smaller in July because I worked fewer shifts.
examples.zh: 我七月的班次少了，所以那个月「定期存入储蓄的钱」也少了。

words.enDefinition: The amount still needed to reach a savings target

examples.en: My spreadsheet shows a savings gap of eighty euros for the spring trip.
examples.zh: 我的电子表格显示，为春游准备的钱还有八十欧元的「储蓄差额」。

examples.en: The savings gap got smaller after I added my wages from the extra shift.
examples.zh: 把加班报酬存进去以后，「储蓄差额」变小了。

words.enDefinition: A planned result for saving money

examples.en: My first savings goal was enough for a train ticket home at Christmas.
examples.zh: 我的第一个「储蓄目标」是存够钱买一张圣诞节回家的火车票。

examples.en: The app lets me give each savings goal a different name and photo.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我给每个「储蓄目标」设置不同的名称和照片。

words.enDefinition: A regular practice of setting money aside

examples.en: My weekend job helped me build a savings habit during my first year abroad.
examples.zh: 周末的兼职让我在出国第一年养成了「储蓄习惯」。

examples.en: It took time to get back into my savings habit after I changed jobs.
examples.zh: 换工作后，我花了一段时间才恢复原来的「储蓄习惯」。

words.enDefinition: A significant amount reached on the way to a target

examples.en: I reached my first savings milestone when the travel fund hit three hundred euros.
examples.zh: 旅行基金存到三百欧元时，我达成了第一个「阶段性储蓄目标」。

examples.en: The app sent a message when I passed a savings milestone on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五达成一个「阶段性储蓄目标」时，应用发来了消息。

words.enDefinition: A separately labeled place in an app for savings

examples.en: I named my savings pot after the city I wanted to visit next summer.
examples.zh: 我用明年夏天想去的城市给我的「专项储蓄分区」命名。

examples.en: The app lets me move money between my savings pot and my main balance.
examples.zh: 这个应用可以让我在「专项储蓄分区」和主余额之间转账。

collocations: add money to a savings pot

words.enDefinition: How far someone has advanced toward saving a target

examples.en: I check my savings progress at the end of each month after payday.
examples.zh: 我每个月月底发薪后都会查看自己的「储蓄进度」。

examples.en: The bar makes my savings progress easier to see without opening each individual transaction.
examples.zh: 有了进度条，我不用打开每一笔交易也能看清「储蓄进度」。

words.enDefinition: An unbroken run of regular savings contributions

examples.en: I kept my savings streak going through the last four weeks of term.
examples.zh: 学期最后四周，我保持了自己的「连续存钱纪录」。

examples.en: The app shows my savings streak beside the date of my last transfer.
examples.zh: 应用把我的「连续存钱纪录」显示在上次转账日期旁边。

words.enDefinition: A tool for tracking money saved over time

examples.en: I made a savings tracker in a spreadsheet for my summer language course.
examples.zh: 我在电子表格里做了一个「储蓄进度记录工具」，用来记录暑期语言课程的存款。

examples.en: The savings tracker shows how much my sister and I have put toward the trip.
examples.zh: 这个「储蓄进度记录工具」显示了我和姐姐为这趟旅行一共存了多少钱。

words.enDefinition: A payment taken out of savings

examples.en: My statement shows a savings withdrawal on the day I paid for the repair.
examples.zh: 我的账单显示，我支付维修费的那天有一笔「提取储蓄款」的记录。

examples.en: I kept the receipt from the savings withdrawal in case the date was disputed.
examples.zh: 我留着那笔「支取储蓄款」的凭据，以防有人对日期有疑问。

words.enDefinition: a transfer arranged to be sent at a future time

examples.en: I reviewed the date on the scheduled transfer in my banking app after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我在银行应用里核对了「预约转账」的日期。

examples.en: The bank asked whether I wanted confirmation once the scheduled transfer had been sent.
examples.zh: 银行问「预约转账」发出后，我是否想收到确认通知。

words.enDefinition: a document used to confirm that a student accepts a scholarship and its conditions

examples.en: I signed the scholarship acceptance form after reading the conditions in the award letter.
examples.zh: 我读完获奖信上的条件后，签了「奖学金接受确认表」。

examples.en: The portal showed that my scholarship acceptance form had been submitted successfully.
examples.zh: 平台显示，我的「奖学金接受确认表」已经提交成功。

words.enDefinition: money received through an award that supports a person's studies

examples.en: My annual statement listed scholarship income separately from pay for shifts at the library.
examples.zh: 我的年度报表把「奖学金收入」与在图书馆值班的工资分开列出。

examples.en: The tax workshop explained that scholarship income can include awards from outside the university.
examples.zh: 税务讲座说明了「奖学金收入」也可能包括校外机构给的奖学金。

words.enDefinition: the process of extending a scholarship into another funding period

examples.en: My scholarship renewal depended on the grades from both terms of the first year.
examples.zh: 我的「奖学金续领」取决于第一年两个学期的成绩。

examples.en: The office sent a reminder about scholarship renewal before final results were posted.
examples.zh: 最终成绩公布前，办公室发来了「奖学金续领」提醒。

words.enDefinition: items such as notebooks and pens used for studying

examples.en: I bought my school supplies at the campus shop after checking what the course required.
examples.zh: 查清课程要求后，我在校内商店买了「学习用品」。

examples.en: We split the cost of some school supplies because we both needed the same markers.
examples.zh: 我们都需要同款记号笔，就分摊了部分「学习用品」的费用。

words.enDefinition: A card backed by a deposit that secures the account

examples.en: The application for a secured credit card explained where the deposit would be held.
examples.zh: 「押金担保信用卡」的申请说明解释了押金会存放在哪里。

examples.en: The issuer explained when it could return the deposit for my secured credit card.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了什么时候可以退还我的「押金担保信用卡」押金。

collocations: apply for a secured credit card

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money backed by an asset pledged to the lender

examples.en: The application for a secured loan asked for information about the car.
examples.zh: 这份「有抵押贷款」申请要求填写汽车的相关信息。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the secured loan terms described the pledged property.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看「有抵押贷款」条款中哪一处描述了抵押财产。

collocations: a secured loan against a vehicle

words.enDefinition: to choose the debit or credit payment option on a terminal

examples.en: The machine asked me to select debit or credit before showing the amount.
examples.zh: 机器显示金额前，提示我「选择借记或信用付款」。

examples.en: I asked what select debit or credit meant on the store's payment terminal.
examples.zh: 我问店里的支付终端上「选择借记或信用付款」是什么意思。

collocations: prompt to select debit or credit
ask customers to select debit or credit
a screen asking you to select debit or credit

words.enDefinition: a machine customers use to scan and pay for purchases themselves

examples.en: I chose a self-checkout terminal because I only needed two items for dinner.
examples.zh: 我只买了两样晚饭食材，所以选了「自助结账机」。

examples.en: The self-checkout terminal asked whether I wanted a paper receipt for my groceries.
examples.zh: 「自助结账机」问我这笔杂货购物要不要纸质收据。

words.enDefinition: money earned by working for oneself through freelance work, a trade or a business

examples.en: The worksheet places self-employment income in a section separate from regular wages.
examples.zh: 计算表把「自雇收入」和普通工资放在不同的栏目。

examples.en: I asked how the service defined self-employment income for freelance design work.
examples.zh: 我问服务部门怎么界定自由接单做设计的「自雇收入」。

words.enDefinition: a spending plan covering one academic semester

examples.en: I put field trips in my semester budget as soon as the dates were announced.
examples.zh: 实地考察的日期一公布，我就把这笔开销加进了「学期预算」。

examples.en: Our student money adviser helped me build a semester budget around three grant payments.
examples.zh: 学校的理财顾问帮我根据分三次发放的助学金做了一份「学期预算」。

words.enDefinition: pay issued twice each month, usually on two set dates

examples.en: Our semimonthly pay usually arrives in the middle and at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 我们一般在月中和月底收到工资，实行「每月发薪两次」。

examples.en: The handbook explained why semimonthly pay produces two scheduled deposits each month.
examples.zh: 手册解释了为什么「每月发薪两次」每月会安排两笔工资入账。

words.enDefinition: transfer funds to a recipient in another country

examples.en: I checked the fee schedule before asking the bank to send money abroad.
examples.zh: 我先查了收费表，再问银行怎样「向国外汇款」。

examples.en: My classmate needed to send money abroad to pay for her exchange accommodation.
examples.zh: 我同学需要「向国外汇款」，支付交换期间的住宿费。

collocations: a way to send money abroad
ask how to send money abroad

words.enDefinition: transfer fees assigned to the person sending the money

examples.en: I asked the bank what sender-paid charges included on this form.
examples.zh: 我问银行，这张表上的「汇款人承担的费用」包括哪些。

examples.en: The app listed sender-paid charges separately from charges paid by the recipient.
examples.zh: 应用把「汇款人承担的费用」和收款人承担的费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: the bank that sends a payment on behalf of the payer

examples.en: The university asked for a copy of the notice from the sending bank.
examples.zh: 学校要了一份「汇出银行」的通知副本。

examples.en: My statement showed a reference that the sending bank could use to locate the payment.
examples.zh: 账单上有一个编号，「汇出银行」可以用它查找这笔款项。

collocations: the name of the sending bank

words.enDefinition: the currency specified for the amount being sent

examples.en: I asked which field on the form showed the sending currency.
examples.zh: 我问表格上的哪个字段显示「汇出币种」。

examples.en: The quote changed when I selected a different sending currency.
examples.zh: 我选了另一种「汇出币种」之后，报价变了。

words.enDefinition: a euro transfer through a Single Euro Payments Area scheme

examples.en: The university's payment page listed a SEPA transfer as one way to pay in euros.
examples.zh: 学校付款页面把「欧元单一支付区转账」列为一种欧元付款方式。

examples.en: I asked which reference would appear on a SEPA transfer in the app.
examples.zh: 我问应用里那笔「欧元单一支付区转账」会显示哪个编号。

words.enDefinition: To reserve money for a later purpose

examples.en: I set money aside whenever I get paid for a weekend shift at the café.
examples.zh: 每次收到咖啡店周末班的工资，我都会「留出一笔钱」。

examples.en: Can we set money aside for the train tickets before we book the hotel?
examples.zh: 我们能在订酒店前先为火车票「留出一笔钱」吗？

collocations: set money aside for a trip

words.enDefinition: An account closed under an agreement resolving the outstanding debt

examples.en: The settled account remained on the report with a note about the agreement.
examples.zh: 这个「已和解结清账户」仍在报告中，并附有说明协议的备注。

examples.en: I kept the letter showing the balance and date of the settled account.
examples.zh: 我保留了那封信，上面写有「已和解结清账户」的余额和结清日期。

collocations: mark an account as a settled account

words.enDefinition: the date funds are exchanged to complete a financial transaction

examples.en: The bank explained which date on the notice was the settlement date.
examples.zh: 银行解释了通知上的哪个日期是「结算日期」。

examples.en: I asked whether the settlement date was separate from the estimated delivery date.
examples.zh: 我问「结算日期」和预计到账日期是不是不同的两个日期。

words.enDefinition: transfer fees divided between the sender and recipient under stated terms

examples.en: I asked what shared charges meant because the fee description was unclear.
examples.zh: 费用说明写得不清楚，我就问「双方分担的费用」是什么意思。

examples.en: The bank explained how shared charges would appear on each statement.
examples.zh: 银行说明了「双方分担的费用」会怎样显示在各自的账单上。

collocations: check how shared charges are allocated

words.enDefinition: costs paid together by people who live in the same home

examples.en: We use a spreadsheet for shared household expenses like washing-up liquid and bin bags.
examples.zh: 我们用电子表格记洗洁精、垃圾袋之类的「合住共同开销」。

examples.en: My flatmates and I keep shared household expenses separate from our own grocery bills.
examples.zh: 我和室友把「合住共同开销」和各自买菜的钱分开算。

words.enDefinition: extra pay for working a particular shift, such as at night

examples.en: The evening shift differential showed up on a separate line this week.
examples.zh: 这周的工资单把晚班的「班次工资加成」单列了一行。

examples.en: My colleague asked whether the shift differential applied to the late library shift.
examples.zh: 同事问图书馆的深夜班有没有「班次工资加成」。

words.enDefinition: look for and buy things that someone has already owned

examples.en: I started to shop secondhand after seeing how much new winter clothes cost here.
examples.zh: 看到这里的新冬装那么贵，我就开始「买二手」了。

examples.en: If you shop secondhand, you can sometimes find a desk near campus for very little.
examples.zh: 如果愿意「买二手」，有时可以在学校附近花很少的钱买到书桌。

words.enDefinition: buy things during periods when shops reduce prices

examples.en: I usually shop the sales for winter clothes because campus gets cold by October.
examples.zh: 我通常「趁打折买」冬装，因为学校到了十月就开始冷。

examples.en: We usually shop the sales for the basics we need when we move.
examples.zh: 搬家需要的日用品，我们通常「趁打折时买」。

words.enDefinition: a list of things you plan to buy

examples.en: I added everything for Friday's dinner to the shopping list before leaving for class.
examples.zh: 出门上课前，我把周五晚餐要买的东西都添进了「购物清单」。

examples.en: I stuck to the shopping list even though the supermarket had a whole aisle of snacks.
examples.zh: 超市虽然有整整一排零食，我还是照着「购物清单」买。

words.enDefinition: a payment for less than the amount due

examples.en: The university contacted me about a short payment after matching the invoice.
examples.zh: 学校核对发票后联系我，说这笔款「付款金额不足」。

examples.en: I asked whether the short payment was related to the fee shown on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问「付款金额不足」是不是和通知上显示的费用有关。

words.enDefinition: Money needed to cover an immediate cost

examples.en: I had a short-term cash need when my repair bill came just before payday.
examples.zh: 发工资前刚好收到维修账单，我有了「短期资金需求」。

examples.en: The bank asked whether I had a short-term cash need or could wait until June.
examples.zh: 银行问我是有「短期资金需求」，还是可以等到六月。

words.enDefinition: a bank form recording an authorized person's signature

examples.en: The teller handed me a signature card and explained where I should sign it.
examples.zh: 柜员递给我一张「签名留样卡」，说明要在哪里签名。

examples.en: I asked whether the signature card listed both holders of our new joint account.
examples.zh: 我问「签名留样卡」上是否列了新联名账户的两位持有人。

words.enDefinition: permission to sign documents or authorize actions for an account

examples.en: I asked what signing authority each holder had under the joint account agreement.
examples.zh: 我问按联名账户协议，每位持有人有怎样的「签字权限」。

examples.en: The bank employee checked the section about signing authority before accepting my form.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员核对了「签字权限」一栏后，才收下我的表格。

words.enDefinition: a digital payment card intended for only one transaction

examples.en: The bank's guide explains what happens to a single-use virtual card after a purchase.
examples.zh: 银行指南解释了买完东西以后，「一次性虚拟卡」会如何处理。

examples.en: I asked whether a refund could still go through on a single-use virtual card.
examples.zh: 我问用「一次性虚拟卡」付款以后，退款还能不能到账。

collocations: pay with a single-use virtual card

words.enDefinition: To omit a planned payment into savings

examples.en: I may have to skip a savings contribution while I wait for my wages.
examples.zh: 在等工资到账的这段时间里，我可能得「跳过一次储蓄存款」。

examples.en: The app asked whether I wanted to skip a savings contribution just this month.
examples.zh: 应用询问我是否只在这个月「跳过一次储蓄存款」。

collocations: choose to skip a savings contribution
need to skip a savings contribution
skip a savings contribution this month

words.enDefinition: coins with low values used for small payments

examples.en: I kept some small change for the washing machine in our residence hall.
examples.zh: 我留了些「小额零钱」，准备在宿舍楼用洗衣机。

examples.en: The cashier asked if I had small change because the coin tray was empty.
examples.zh: 收银员问我有没有「小额零钱」，因为零钱盘是空的。

words.enDefinition: many inexpensive purchases can total a large amount

examples.en: Small purchases add up when I grab a snack after every evening lecture.
examples.zh: 每次上完晚课我都买点零食，「小额消费就这样积少成多」。

examples.en: My receipts showed that small purchases add up much faster than I thought.
examples.zh: 小票让我发现，「小额消费积少成多」的速度比我想得快得多。

collocations: see how small purchases add up
realize that small purchases add up
small purchases add up over time

words.enDefinition: A review of credit information that does not affect scores

examples.en: The eligibility page described the initial check as a soft inquiry.
examples.zh: 资格查询页面称，初步核查属于「软性征信查询」。

examples.en: When I viewed my own report, the bureau listed the check as a soft inquiry.
examples.zh: 我查看自己的报告时，征信机构把这次查询列为「软性征信查询」。

words.enDefinition: a bank account held in one person's name only

examples.en: The form asked whether I wanted a sole account or one shared with another person.
examples.zh: 表格问我想开「单人账户」，还是跟别人共用一个账户。

examples.en: I checked which address the bank had listed for my sole account after moving.
examples.zh: 搬家后，我查了银行在我的「单人账户」上登记的是哪个地址。

collocations: a sole account in your name

words.enDefinition: where the money paid into an account comes from

examples.en: The form asked about the source of funds before I reached the final page.
examples.zh: 填到最后一页之前，表格问了我的「资金来源」。

examples.en: The teller asked whether the source of funds could be documented with my scholarship letter.
examples.zh: 柜员问能不能用我的奖学金通知来证明「资金来源」。

collocations: a document showing the source of funds

words.enDefinition: Money left after paying immediate expenses

examples.en: I put any spare cash from weekend shifts into my travel fund last term.
examples.zh: 上学期我把周末打工赚来的「闲钱」都存进了旅行基金。

examples.en: My parents had a little spare cash after the move and used it for a holiday.
examples.zh: 我爸妈搬完家后还有一点「闲钱」，就拿去度假了。

words.enDefinition: a sample signature kept for comparison and verification

examples.en: The bank employee asked for a specimen signature after reviewing my account opening form.
examples.zh: 银行工作人员看过我的开户表后，要求提供「留存签名样本」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could update my specimen signature after changing my surname last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天换姓后，我问能不能更新「留存签名样本」。

collocations: keep a specimen signature on file

words.enDefinition: a list showing how actual spending is divided among categories

examples.en: My spending breakdown showed that most of my food money went to takeaway lunches.
examples.zh: 「支出明细」显示，我的伙食费大多花在了外卖午饭上。

examples.en: I added a spending breakdown to the spreadsheet so I could compare different months.
examples.zh: 我在表格里加了「支出明细」，方便比较不同月份。

words.enDefinition: a group of expenses of the same type

examples.en: I added a spending category for sports because gym visits were starting to add up.
examples.zh: 去健身房的开销开始多起来，我就新建了一个运动「开支类别」。

examples.en: Food is my biggest spending category after rent, especially when I have evening classes.
examples.zh: 房租之外，伙食是我花钱最多的「开支类别」，特别是有晚课的时候。

words.enDefinition: settings that restrict when, where, or how a card is used

examples.en: I looked at the spending controls before travelling to another country for a conference.
examples.zh: 出国参加会议前，我查看了「消费管控设置」。

examples.en: My bank's spending controls let me choose which types of payments to allow.
examples.zh: 我银行的「消费管控设置」可以选择允许哪些付款类型。

words.enDefinition: an estimate of how much will be spent in the future

examples.en: I revised my spending forecast after our course added an extra trip in May.
examples.zh: 课程增加了一次五月的出行后，我就调整了「支出预测」。

examples.en: The spending forecast accounts for higher grocery prices during my placement in the city.
examples.zh: 「支出预测」把我在城里实习期间较高的食品杂货价格也考虑了进去。

words.enDefinition: a temporary stop on some or all spending

examples.en: I put a spending freeze on clothes until I'd paid for my ticket home.
examples.zh: 在买好回家的票之前，我「暂停了衣物支出」。

examples.en: Our society lifted its spending freeze when the next round of funding came through.
examples.zh: 新一轮经费到账后，我们社团结束了「暂停支出」的安排。

words.enDefinition: the regular ways in which someone spends money

examples.en: My spending habits changed when I stopped passing the bakery on my way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上不再经过那家面包店后，我的「消费习惯」变了。

examples.en: We talked about spending habits at a campus workshop for students in their first year.
examples.zh: 我们在学校给大一学生办的讲座上聊了「消费习惯」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount someone is allowed or plans to spend

examples.en: We set a spending limit of twenty pounds each for the end-of-term gift exchange.
examples.zh: 我们给期末交换礼物定了「支出上限」，每人二十英镑。

examples.en: My spending limit for a used desk is lower now that I need a lamp too.
examples.zh: 现在我还得买台灯，所以买二手书桌的「支出上限」更低了。

words.enDefinition: money available for small personal purchases or activities

examples.en: The field trip includes lunch, but I brought some spending money for postcards.
examples.zh: 实地考察包午饭，但我还是带了些「可以自己花的钱」买明信片。

examples.en: I've got enough spending money left for coffee and a museum ticket this afternoon.
examples.zh: 我剩下的「可随意花的钱」够今天下午买咖啡和一张博物馆门票。

words.enDefinition: a recurring trend in when or where money is spent

examples.en: Looking at my receipts, I spotted a spending pattern: I shopped most often after late classes.
examples.zh: 看了小票，我发现一个「支出规律」：上完晚课后我最常买东西。

examples.en: My spending pattern changes during exams when I commute less and order more food.
examples.zh: 考试期间，我通勤少了、外卖点多了，「支出规律」也跟着变了。

words.enDefinition: a tool that shows how much you have spent

examples.en: My spending tracker shows I spend more on the days I forget my lunch.
examples.zh: 我的「支出记录工具」显示，忘带午饭的那几天我花得更多。

examples.en: I made a spending tracker in a spreadsheet when the app stopped syncing properly.
examples.zh: 应用同步出了问题，我就用电子表格做了个「支出记录工具」。

words.enDefinition: payment for one purchase using more than one method

examples.en: The till allowed a split payment, so I used a gift card and cash.
examples.zh: 收银系统允许「拆分付款」，我就用了礼品卡和现金。

examples.en: I asked whether a split payment would appear as two separate entries on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「拆分付款」在收据上会不会分两项列出来。

words.enDefinition: spend unusually freely on something you want

examples.en: I decided to splurge on a nice dinner after surviving my first exam week.
examples.zh: 熬过第一次考试周后，我决定「大手笔花钱」吃顿好的。

examples.en: We don't usually splurge on hotels, but this one was right next to the station.
examples.zh: 我们平时不在酒店上「花大钱」，不过这家就在车站旁边。

words.enDefinition: a letter confirming that a person or organization will cover specified costs for a student

examples.en: My funding agency sent a sponsor letter stating which fees it would pay.
examples.zh: 资助机构发来「资助方承诺函」，写明会支付哪些费用。

examples.en: The university asked for a sponsor letter covering the dates of the entire term.
examples.zh: 大学要求提供一份涵盖整个学期日期的「资助方承诺函」。

collocations: check the dates on a sponsor letter

words.enDefinition: a written agreement specifying what a sponsor will fund and any terms of that support

examples.en: The sponsorship agreement listed course fees but did not cover my travel costs.
examples.zh: 「资助协议」列了课程费，没有包括我的交通费。

examples.en: I saved the signed sponsorship agreement before forwarding a copy to the university.
examples.zh: 我保存了签好的「资助协议」，再给学校转发了一份副本。

collocations: the terms of a sponsorship agreement

words.enDefinition: a set deduction a US filer may use in place of listing specific deductible expenses

examples.en: The volunteer pointed to the standard deduction line on the sample US return.
examples.zh: 志愿者指给我看，美国税表样本上「美国标准扣除额」对应哪一行。

examples.en: The worksheet compares the standard deduction with the total of the listed expenses.
examples.zh: 计算表比较了「美国标准扣除额」和列出的各项支出总额。

collocations: the amount of the standard deduction

words.enDefinition: a repayment plan using scheduled payments over a set period, typically with amounts that stay the same

examples.en: The standard repayment plan showed the same scheduled payment throughout the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「固定分期还款计划」里，各期的约定还款金额相同。

examples.en: I asked which row compared the standard repayment plan with the extended one.
examples.zh: 我问哪一行对比了「固定分期还款计划」和延长期限的计划。

collocations: payments under a standard repayment plan
compare a standard repayment plan with other options

words.enDefinition: an instruction for a bank to send regular fixed payments

examples.en: My flatmate asked which date the standing order for our shared bills was set for.
examples.zh: 室友问，平摊账单用的「定期付款指令」设的是哪天。

examples.en: The bank's help page explained where to view an existing standing order.
examples.zh: 银行的帮助页面介绍了到哪里查看已有的「定期付款指令」。

words.enDefinition: an income tax charged by a state where the tax applies

examples.en: The US payroll form had a separate line for state income tax withheld.
examples.zh: 那张美国工资表单列了一行预扣的「州所得税」。

examples.en: My tutor used two American payslips to explain differences in state income tax.
examples.zh: 导师用两张美国工资单讲解了「州所得税」的差异。

words.enDefinition: the balance shown on an account statement for a period

examples.en: I compared the statement balance with the amount shown in the app that morning.
examples.zh: 我把「对账单余额」和当天上午应用显示的金额比了一下。

examples.en: The teller pointed to the statement balance on the last page of the document.
examples.zh: 柜员指给我看文件最后一页上的「对账单余额」。

words.enDefinition: The final day of the period covered by a statement

examples.en: My latest purchase appeared one day after the statement closing date listed on the bill.
examples.zh: 账单显示的「账单结算日」过了一天，最新那笔消费才入账。

examples.en: We checked the statement closing date because our payments fell in different billing periods.
examples.zh: 我们的还款分属不同账期，所以核对了「账单结算日」。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a statement is prepared or issued

examples.en: The statement date was one day earlier than the date I downloaded the file.
examples.zh: 「对账单出具日期」比我下载文件的日期早一天。

examples.en: I checked the statement date before deciding whether it was recent enough for the application.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「对账单出具日期」，再判断它是否符合申请对时间的要求。

words.enDefinition: how often an account statement is made available

examples.en: I asked the adviser about statement frequency after receiving two statements in one month.
examples.zh: 一个月收到两份对账单后，我向顾问询问了「对账单发送频率」。

examples.en: The app did not let me change statement frequency, so I asked the branch.
examples.zh: 这个应用里改不了「对账单发送频率」，我就咨询了网点。

words.enDefinition: the span of time covered by an account statement

examples.en: I checked the statement period because the document did not include my last deposit.
examples.zh: 那份文件没列最近一笔存款，我就核对了「对账单涵盖期间」。

examples.en: The statement period was printed directly below my name and mailing address on the first page.
examples.zh: 第一页在我的姓名和邮寄地址正下方印有「对账单涵盖期间」。

collocations: the end of a statement period

words.enDefinition: an amount the law requires an employer to deduct from pay

examples.en: The payroll guide used a sample statutory deduction to explain the layout.
examples.zh: 薪资指南用一项「法定扣款」的例子说明了工资单的版面。

examples.en: I asked whether the line described a statutory deduction or a staff contribution.
examples.zh: 我问这一栏写的是「法定扣款」，还是员工自愿缴纳的款项。

words.enDefinition: To continue saving at the planned pace

examples.en: I used a calendar to stay on track with saving for my summer course.
examples.zh: 我用日历提醒自己「按计划继续为暑期课程存钱」。

examples.en: The extra shift helped me stay on track with saving during a quiet month.
examples.zh: 在工作不多的那个月，额外的一个班次帮我「按计划继续存钱」。

collocations: try to stay on track with saving
help someone stay on track with saving
stay on track with saving for a trip

words.enDefinition: follow a spending plan without going over it

examples.en: I find it easier to stick to a budget when I bring snacks to campus.
examples.zh: 我自己带零食去学校时，更容易「按预算花钱」。

examples.en: It's tough to stick to a budget when most of your classmates eat out.
examples.zh: 同学大多出去吃饭的话，就很难坚持「按预算花钱」。

collocations: try to stick to a budget
learn to stick to a budget
find it hard to stick to a budget

words.enDefinition: make the money available in a budget go further

examples.en: You can stretch your budget by sharing the cost of a tool with your flatmates.
examples.zh: 跟室友分摊工具的钱，就能「让预算更经用」。

examples.en: If you want to stretch your budget this weekend, the city museum is free.
examples.zh: 周末想「让预算更经用」的话，可以去免费的市博物馆。

collocations: find ways to stretch your budget
stretch your budget a little further

words.enDefinition: the net amount outstanding or in credit on an account held by a school for a student

examples.en: The student account balance changed after the university posted my first grant payment.
examples.zh: 学校录入我第一笔助学金后，「学生账户余额」变了。

examples.en: I checked my student account balance before calling about the tuition invoice.
examples.zh: 打电话询问学费账单前，我看了「学生账户余额」。

collocations: pay your outstanding student account balance

words.enDefinition: money applied to a student's institutional account that reduces what is owed

examples.en: The refunded lab fee appeared as a student account credit on my statement.
examples.zh: 退回来的实验费在报表上列为「学生账户抵扣款」。

examples.en: A student account credit reduced the amount I needed to pay that month.
examples.zh: 一笔「学生账户抵扣款」减少了我当月要缴的金额。

words.enDefinition: the school office that handles charges, payments and refunds on student accounts

examples.en: The student accounts office sent an updated invoice after checking my payment record.
examples.zh: 「学生缴费办公室」核对我的付款记录后发来了更新的账单。

examples.en: I asked the student accounts office to confirm that the new charge had been removed.
examples.zh: 我请「学生缴费办公室」确认新加的收费已经取消。

collocations: send an invoice to the student accounts office

words.enDefinition: a figure used to help determine a student's eligibility for US federal financial aid

examples.en: The US application summary showed my Student Aid Index next to the eligibility information.
examples.zh: 美国资助申请摘要把我的「美国学生资助指数」列在资格信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked the adviser how the Student Aid Index was used in the example.
examples.zh: 我问顾问在这个例子里，「美国学生资助指数」是怎么用的。

words.enDefinition: a bank account designed for people enrolled as students

examples.en: The university adviser explained what a student bank account was during the welcome session.
examples.zh: 迎新说明会上，学校顾问解释了什么是「学生银行账户」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank would update my student bank account after my graduation.
examples.zh: 我问银行毕业后会不会调整我的「学生银行账户」。

collocations: apply for a student bank account
the terms of a student bank account

words.enDefinition: money awarded to help a student meet study costs that normally does not need to be repaid

examples.en: The student grant covered most of the equipment I needed for the course.
examples.zh: 「学生助学金」支付了我上这门课所需的大部分设备费用。

examples.en: I found the student grant listed below the loan on my award summary.
examples.zh: 我在资助摘要上看到，贷款下面列的是「学生助学金」。

collocations: the terms of a student grant

words.enDefinition: a credit facility that lets a student borrow as needed up to an approved limit

examples.en: The bank statement showed how much remained available on the student line of credit.
examples.zh: 银行对账单上显示了「学生信用额度」还有多少可用。

examples.en: The adviser compared a student line of credit with a fixed student loan.
examples.zh: 顾问把「学生信用额度」和固定金额的学生贷款做了比较。

collocations: apply for a student line of credit
draw on a student line of credit
a student line of credit limit

words.enDefinition: a document stating the obligations and terms of a loan for study

examples.en: I asked where the student loan agreement described changes to the repayment schedule.
examples.zh: 我问「学生贷款协议」在哪里说明了还款时间表的变更。

examples.en: The office kept my student loan agreement with the other documents for the award.
examples.zh: 办事处把「学生贷款协议」和这项资助的其他材料放在一起。

collocations: the terms of a student loan agreement

words.enDefinition: money lent to a student, or for their education, that must normally be repaid

examples.en: I looked up the remaining balance on my student loan while updating my budget.
examples.zh: 我更新预算时查了「学生贷款」还欠多少。

examples.en: Her student loan covered part of the course fees for the first year.
examples.zh: 她的「学生贷款」付了第一年课程费的一部分。

collocations: the balance of a student loan

words.zhGloss: 免除学生贷款偿还义务
words.enDefinition: release from paying some or all of a student loan under a qualifying program
acceptedZhAnswers: 免除学生贷款偿还义务

examples.en: The webinar explained one program for student loan forgiveness after qualifying public service.
examples.zh: 网络讲座介绍了一项面向符合公共服务条件人员的「免除学生贷款偿还义务」计划。

examples.en: I asked which office verified employment for this student loan forgiveness program.
examples.zh: 我问这个「免除学生贷款偿还义务」计划由哪个办公室核实就业情况。

words.enDefinition: the dates or duration of study for which a school or program assesses funding

examples.en: The Canadian application asked which study period the funding request was for.
examples.zh: 加拿大申请表问这次资助申请对应哪个「就读期」。

examples.en: I used the dates in my enrolment letter to confirm the study period.
examples.zh: 我根据注册证明上的日期确认了「就读期」。

words.enDefinition: a review of subscriptions and what they are costing you

examples.en: A quick subscription audit showed I was paying for two apps that did the same thing.
examples.zh: 做了个简单的「订阅盘点」后，我发现自己给两个功能一样的应用都付了钱。

examples.en: We added a subscription audit to our routine at the end of each term.
examples.zh: 我们把「订阅盘点」加进了每学期末的例行事项。

words.enDefinition: the date on which a subscription starts another term

examples.en: I checked the subscription renewal date before leaving the country for my summer placement.
examples.zh: 出国做暑期实习前，我查了「订阅续期日」。

examples.en: I didn't notice the subscription renewal date until I opened the settings page.
examples.zh: 我打开设置页面才注意到「订阅续期日」。

words.enDefinition: one level of a subscription with its own price and benefits

examples.en: I chose a cheaper subscription tier because I only needed the basic editing tools.
examples.zh: 我只需要基础编辑工具，就选了一个更便宜的「订阅档位」。

examples.en: The subscription tier we picked lets both of us use the account at once.
examples.zh: 我们选的「订阅档位」允许我们两个人同时用这个账号。

words.enDefinition: an additional card linked to someone else's main account

examples.en: The bank said a supplementary card could have a different name from the main account.
examples.zh: 银行说「附属银行卡」上的姓名可以和主账户不同。

examples.en: My family asked what changes appeared on the statement when using a supplementary card.
examples.zh: 家里人问，用「附属银行卡」以后账单会有哪些变化。

words.enDefinition: an identifier used to address financial institutions in international payments

examples.en: I checked the SWIFT code on the university's official payment details sheet.
examples.zh: 我核对了学校官方付款资料单上的「银行国际识别代码」。

examples.en: The bank explained that the SWIFT code identified an institution rather than my account.
examples.zh: 银行解释说，「银行国际识别代码」识别的是机构，并非我的账户。

collocations: check the recipient bank's SWIFT code

words.enDefinition: a bank record confirming that a payment instruction was sent through SWIFT

examples.en: I asked the bank for a SWIFT payment confirmation after the overseas payment was sent.
examples.zh: 海外汇款发出后，我向银行索要了「SWIFT汇款发送确认」。

examples.en: The SWIFT payment confirmation showed the sending bank but did not display the recipient's balance.
examples.zh: 「SWIFT汇款发送确认」列出了汇出银行，但不显示收款人的账户余额。

words.enDefinition: to pass a card's magnetic stripe through a reader

examples.en: The instruction on the old machine said swipe your card to continue.
examples.zh: 旧机器提示，要继续就得「刷银行卡磁条」。

examples.en: The label said "swipe your card," but the cashier pointed me to the chip reader.
examples.zh: 标签写着「刷银行卡磁条」，但收银员指了指芯片读取器。

collocations: swipe your card through the reader

words.enDefinition: to start using a different bank account instead

examples.en: I decided to switch bank accounts after moving to a different part of the city.
examples.zh: 搬到这座城市的另一个区域后，我决定「更换银行账户」。

examples.en: The adviser asked why I wanted to switch bank accounts before explaining the paperwork.
examples.zh: 顾问问我为什么想「更换银行账户」，然后解释要填哪些文件。

words.zhGloss: 加拿大学费与注册证明
words.enDefinition: a Canadian tax certificate showing eligible tuition and enrolment information from an educational institution
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大学费与注册证明

examples.en: I found the T2202 in a separate section of my university's billing portal.
examples.zh: 我在学校缴费平台的另一个栏目找到了「加拿大学费与注册证明」。

examples.en: The finance office explained which enrolment information appeared on the T2202 for that year.
examples.zh: 财务办公室解释了当年的「加拿大学费与注册证明」列了哪些注册信息。

collocations: request a copy of your T2202

words.zhGloss: 加拿大受雇收入税务单
words.enDefinition: a Canadian statement from an employer listing employment income and certain deductions for a calendar year
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大受雇收入税务单

examples.en: The T4 slip from my library job arrived in the employee portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆工作的「加拿大受雇收入税务单」发到了员工平台。

examples.en: I compared the year on the T4 slip with my saved Canadian pay stubs.
examples.zh: 我拿「加拿大受雇收入税务单」上的年份和保存的加拿大工资单对照了一下。

collocations: employment income on a T4 slip

words.enDefinition: to pay by holding a card or device near a reader

examples.en: The sign showed that passengers could tap to pay on the city tram.
examples.zh: 标牌显示，乘客在市区有轨电车上可以「碰一下付款」。

examples.en: The cashier asked whether I wanted to tap to pay or insert the card.
examples.zh: 收银员问我想「碰一下付款」还是插卡。

collocations: tap to pay with your phone

words.enDefinition: to briefly hold your card close to a contactless reader

examples.en: The sign said "tap your card here" near the front door of the bus.
examples.zh: 公交车前门附近的提示牌写着「把卡碰一下读卡器」。

examples.en: The screen says tap your card once the price appears below the logo.
examples.zh: 屏幕提示，价格在标志下方显示后就「把卡碰一下读卡器」。

collocations: tap your card on the reader

words.enDefinition: The total amount someone aims to save

examples.en: I entered a target amount before the app drew a progress bar for my trip.
examples.zh: 我先输入「目标金额」，应用才为这趟旅行生成了进度条。

examples.en: The target amount includes the deposit for the course and the cost of the textbooks.
examples.zh: 这个「目标金额」包括课程订金和课本费用。

words.enDefinition: The planned date for reaching a goal

examples.en: I moved the target date to June when I found out my placement starts later.
examples.zh: 得知实习开始得更晚后，我把「目标日期」改到了六月。

examples.en: The savings tool asks for a target date after you name the goal.
examples.zh: 给目标命名后，储蓄工具会要求输入「目标日期」。

words.enDefinition: a government agency that administers or collects taxes

examples.en: The letter gave the number for the tax authority that reviews these returns.
examples.zh: 信上写了审核这类申报表的「税务机关」的电话号码。

examples.en: We checked which tax authority had issued the notice before returning the form.
examples.zh: 我们先查了通知是哪个「税务机关」发的，然后才寄回表格。

collocations: submit records to a tax authority

words.enDefinition: a statement that tells a person how much tax they owe

examples.en: The tax bill arrived online when I was checking messages from the city.
examples.zh: 我查收市政府发来的消息时，在网上收到了「税款账单」。

examples.en: I asked the office which period the tax bill covered before checking my records.
examples.zh: 在核对记录前，我先问办公室这张「税款账单」涵盖哪个时段。

words.enDefinition: a range of taxable income to which a particular tax rate applies

examples.en: The chart showed where the first tax bracket ended and the next one began.
examples.zh: 图表标出了第一个「所得税税率档」在哪里结束、下一档从哪里开始。

examples.en: We highlighted the first tax bracket before working through the figures on the board.
examples.zh: 我们先标出第一个「所得税税率档」，再算黑板上的数字。

collocations: move into a higher tax bracket

words.enDefinition: a service, often staffed by trained volunteers, that helps people with tax questions or returns

examples.en: The student union posted the opening hours for its free tax clinic.
examples.zh: 学生会公布了免费「报税咨询点」的开放时间。

examples.en: I brought a folder of pay records to my appointment at the tax clinic.
examples.zh: 去「报税咨询点」赴约时，我带了一整册工资记录。

collocations: book an appointment at a tax clinic

words.enDefinition: in the UK payroll context, a code used to determine how much income tax to deduct

examples.en: The tax code had changed by the time I downloaded my next payslip.
examples.zh: 等我下载下一张工资单时，「工资计税代码」已经变了。

examples.en: I found my tax code beside my payroll number near the top.
examples.zh: 我在接近顶部的地方看到，「工资计税代码」就在薪资编号旁边。

collocations: a change in your tax code

words.enDefinition: an amount that reduces the tax owed, subject to the applicable rules

examples.en: The example shows where a tax credit is applied in the calculation.
examples.zh: 例子标出了计算过程中在哪一步应用「税额抵免」。

examples.en: The software asked about a tax credit before it displayed the final estimate.
examples.zh: 软件在显示最终估算金额前，先问了我一项「税额抵免」的情况。

words.enDefinition: income that is excluded from a particular tax under applicable rules

examples.en: The workshop used a sample form to show where tax-exempt income might appear.
examples.zh: 讲座用一张样表展示了「免税收入」可能会出现在哪里。

examples.en: I asked how the guide defined tax-exempt income for that specific form.
examples.zh: 我问指南对那张表格上的「免税收入」是怎么定义的。

words.enDefinition: the last date on which a return can be submitted on time

examples.en: My calendar reminder showed the tax filing deadline beside two assignment dates.
examples.zh: 日历提醒把「报税截止日期」显示在两个作业截止日旁边。

examples.en: The website lists a different tax filing deadline for the example we discussed.
examples.zh: 网站为我们讨论的情况列了一个不同的「报税截止日期」。

words.enDefinition: the amount of tax a person or organization is responsible for paying

examples.en: The worksheet calculates tax liability before subtracting payments already made during the year.
examples.zh: 计算表先算「应纳税额」，再减去这一年已经缴过的款项。
