examples.en: I asked the volunteer where my estimated tax liability appeared on the printout.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，打印件的哪里列了我预计的「应纳税额」。

words.enDefinition: a person who prepares tax returns for others

examples.en: I asked the tax preparer for a written list of documents they needed.
examples.zh: 我请「报税代办人员」列个书面清单，说明需要哪些材料。

examples.en: The appointment email included the tax preparer contact details at the bottom.
examples.zh: 预约邮件底部写着「报税代办人员」的联系方式。

words.enDefinition: the current stage of processing a tax refund

examples.en: The website asked for the filing year before it showed my tax refund status.
examples.zh: 网站让我先填写申报年度，才显示「退税进度」。

examples.en: I checked my tax refund status again after receiving an update from the agency.
examples.zh: 收到税务部门的更新后，我又查了一次「退税进度」。

collocations: an update on tax refund status

words.enDefinition: the status of being treated as a resident of a place under its tax rules

examples.en: Tax residency was discussed separately from visa status at the international student workshop.
examples.zh: 国际学生讲座把「税务居民身份」和签证身份分开介绍。

examples.en: The lecturer used a table to compare tax residency in two example countries.
examples.zh: 讲师用一张表比较了两个示例国家认定的「税务居民身份」。

words.enDefinition: the part of the year when many people prepare and file annual tax returns

examples.en: The campus tax clinic needed extra volunteers when tax season got busy.
examples.zh: 进入繁忙的「集中报税期」后，学校税务咨询点需要增加志愿者。

examples.en: I collected all my wage records a few weeks before tax season began.
examples.zh: 「集中报税期」开始前几周，我就收齐了工资记录。

words.enDefinition: software that helps users prepare a return and may also allow them to submit it

examples.en: The library workshop included a short demonstration of the tax software students could use.
examples.zh: 图书馆讲座简短演示了学生可以使用的「报税软件」。

examples.en: The tax software saved my draft, so I finished it later at home.
examples.zh: 「报税软件」保存了我的草稿，我后来回家把它填完了。

collocations: prepare a return with tax software

words.enDefinition: an official record showing selected information about tax returns or accounts

examples.en: The office asked which type of tax transcript my housing application had requested.
examples.zh: 办事员问，我的住房申请要求的是哪种「税务记录摘录」。

examples.en: I requested a tax transcript after discovering that my saved copy was incomplete.
examples.zh: 发现留存的副本不全之后，我申请了一份「税务记录摘录」。

words.enDefinition: an agreement between jurisdictions about how specified taxes apply across their borders

examples.en: The adviser mentioned a tax treaty while discussing the example involving two countries.
examples.zh: 顾问在讲解涉及两个国家的例子时提到了一份「税收协定」。

examples.en: The handout shows where the tax treaty was cited in the sample letter.
examples.zh: 讲义指出了示例信在哪里引用了「税收协定」。

words.enDefinition: tax taken out of a payment and sent to the tax authority on the recipient's behalf

examples.en: My first payslip listed tax withholding under a subtotal for all deductions.
examples.zh: 我第一张工资单在所有扣款的小计下面列出了「预扣税」。

examples.en: The guide explains how tax withholding may appear on your annual wage statement.
examples.zh: 指南解释了「预扣税」可能会在年度工资报表上怎么显示。

words.enDefinition: the annual period for which income and tax are calculated under a tax system

examples.en: I accidentally downloaded the form for the previous tax year on my first attempt.
examples.zh: 我第一次下载时，不小心下成了上一「纳税年度」的表格。

examples.en: The records are divided by tax year in the agency's online account.
examples.zh: 税务机关的在线账号按「纳税年度」整理记录。

collocations: the end of the tax year

words.enDefinition: a non-wage benefit treated as income for tax purposes under applicable rules

examples.en: The guide described the parking subsidy as a taxable benefit in this example.
examples.zh: 指南在这个例子里把停车补助列为「应纳税福利」。

examples.en: I asked why the taxable benefit appeared on the statement beside my wages.
examples.zh: 我问为什么这项「应纳税福利」会和工资一起列在报表上。

collocations: the value of a taxable benefit

words.enDefinition: the part of a payment or amount that is subject to a particular tax

examples.en: The statement displayed the taxable portion separately from the full payment amount.
examples.zh: 报表把「应税部分」和这笔款项的总额分开显示。

examples.en: I asked the volunteer where the taxable portion came from in the example.
examples.zh: 我问志愿者，示例里的「应税部分」是怎么得出来的。

collocations: the taxable portion of a payment

words.enDefinition: an identifying number used by a tax authority to keep records for a taxpayer

examples.en: The guide explains which field is for the taxpayer identification number on this form.
examples.zh: 指南说明了表格中哪一栏填写「纳税人识别号码」。

examples.en: The volunteer said the taxpayer identification number could appear under different labels in different countries.
examples.zh: 志愿者说，各国表格上「纳税人识别号码」的栏名可能不同。

words.enDefinition: a payment card provided for use for a limited period

examples.en: The branch offered a temporary card while my replacement was in the mail.
examples.zh: 补发卡还在邮寄中时，网点给了我一张「临时银行卡」。

examples.en: I asked what the temporary card could be used for during my visit.
examples.zh: 到网点时，我问了「临时银行卡」能用在哪些地方。

words.enDefinition: I cannot afford that within my planned spending

examples.en: I'd love to come, but that's outside my budget until I get paid next week.
examples.zh: 我也很想去，但下周发薪之前，「那超出我的预算了」。

examples.en: That hotel looks great, but that's outside my budget for this weekend's trip.
examples.zh: 那家酒店看起来不错，但「它超出了我这周末出游的预算」。

collocations: that's outside my budget right now

words.enDefinition: only the things that are absolutely needed

examples.en: I bought only the bare essentials because my first weekend shift got cancelled.
examples.zh: 第一个周末的班被取消了，所以我只买了「最基本的必需品」。

examples.en: We picked up the bare essentials before unpacking the boxes in our new flat.
examples.zh: 拆新公寓里的箱子前，我们先买了「最基本的必需品」。

words.enDefinition: A borrowing record containing relatively few accounts or repayment details

examples.en: I had a thin credit file because I only had one local credit card.
examples.zh: 因为我在当地只有一张信用卡，所以「信用档案资料较少」。

examples.en: The adviser explained what a thin credit file meant for this particular application.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了「信用档案资料较少」对这次申请意味着什么。

collocations: borrowers with a thin credit file

words.enDefinition: a process in which a school sends eligible charges directly to a student's sponsor or other payer

examples.en: The college used third-party billing because my employer was paying the tuition fee.
examples.zh: 因为我的雇主要付学费，学院采用了「向第三方开具账单」。

examples.en: The office listed the sponsor's invoice under third-party billing in the student portal.
examples.zh: 财务办公室把资助方发票列在学生平台的「向第三方开具账单」栏目。

words.enDefinition: a document allowing another person to act for the holder

examples.en: I asked the bank what a third-party mandate meant before completing the application.
examples.zh: 我填申请之前，先问银行什么是「第三方账户授权书」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed me to the third-party mandate section of the account handbook.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看了账户手册里关于「第三方账户授权书」的那部分。

words.enDefinition: reduce your spending because money is limited

examples.en: You may have to tighten your belt while the café cuts back your shifts.
examples.zh: 咖啡馆减少你班次的这段时间，你可能得「勒紧裤腰带」过日子。

examples.en: It's hard to tighten your belt when every friend wants to meet over dinner.
examples.zh: 朋友们都想约饭的时候，想「勒紧裤腰带」可真难。

collocations: tighten your belt for a few months

words.enDefinition: the printed record produced by a store's checkout

examples.en: I put the till receipt in my bag with the second-hand textbooks.
examples.zh: 我把「收银小票」和二手教材一起放进了包里。

examples.en: The shop asked whether the till receipt showed the price before the discount.
examples.zh: 商店问「收银小票」上有没有显示打折前的价格。

words.enDefinition: a change that fixes an error in the logged dates or hours of work

examples.en: My supervisor approved a time entry correction after I mentioned the missing hour.
examples.zh: 我提到漏记的一个小时后，主管批准了「工时记录更正」。

examples.en: The payroll office asked me to attach the schedule to my time entry correction.
examples.zh: 薪资部门请我在「工时记录更正」里附上排班表。

words.enDefinition: a checkout screen that allows a customer to choose a tip

examples.en: The tip screen appeared before the café payment went through on my phone.
examples.zh: 手机上的咖啡馆付款完成前，出现了「小费选项页面」。

examples.en: I asked the cashier what the options on the tip screen meant.
examples.zh: 我问收银员，「小费选项页面」上的几个选项是什么意思。

collocations: choose an option on the tip screen

words.enDefinition: products for washing, grooming, or looking after your body

examples.en: I made a list of toiletries before going to the supermarket with my flatmate.
examples.zh: 和室友去超市前，我列了张「个人洗护用品」清单。

examples.en: We bought toiletries in our first week and put the home supplies under a separate heading.
examples.zh: 我们第一周就买了「个人洗护用品」，把家居用品另列了一类。

words.enDefinition: All money payable over a loan, including principal and borrowing costs

examples.en: The UK agreement showed the total amount repayable below the monthly figure.
examples.zh: 这份英国协议把「还款总额」列在每月还款额下方。

examples.en: I checked whether the total amount repayable included the fee on the first page.
examples.zh: 我核对了「还款总额」是否包括第一页上的那项费用。

words.enDefinition: the full amount shown when you are ready to pay

examples.en: The total at checkout was higher than I'd expected once delivery was added.
examples.zh: 加上运费后，「结账时的总额」比我想的要高。

examples.en: I compared the total at checkout on both sites before ordering the same headphones.
examples.zh: 下单买同款耳机前，我比较了两个网站「结账时的总额」。

words.enDefinition: The interest and fees payable for borrowing, excluding the amount borrowed

examples.en: The guide put the total cost of credit in a separate box from the borrowed amount.
examples.zh: 指南把「信贷成本总额」和借款金额放在不同的框里。

examples.en: I asked which charges were counted toward the total cost of credit in the quote.
examples.zh: 我问报价单中哪些费用计入了「信贷成本总额」。

collocations: calculate the total cost of credit
disclose the total cost of credit
compare the total cost of credit

words.enDefinition: All interest already paid over the stated period or loan term

examples.en: The year-end statement showed the total interest paid under a separate heading.
examples.zh: 年末账单把「已付利息总额」列在单独的栏目下。

examples.en: I compared my total interest paid with the figure on last year's statement.
examples.zh: 我把自己的「已付利息总额」与去年账单上的数字做了比较。

words.enDefinition: the overall amount paid for a transfer including applicable charges

examples.en: The quote showed the total transfer cost on a separate line at the bottom.
examples.zh: 报价底部单独列了一行「汇款总支出」。

examples.en: I asked which charges were included in the stated total transfer cost.
examples.zh: 我问列出的「汇款总支出」里包括哪些费用。

words.enDefinition: a request for a bank to locate or track a payment

examples.en: My bank submitted a trace request after I reported the missing payment.
examples.zh: 我报告款项没找到以后，银行提交了「资金去向查询申请」。

examples.en: The provider gave me a copy of the trace request for my records.
examples.zh: 服务商给了我一份「资金去向查询申请」副本留档。

collocations: follow up on a trace request

words.enDefinition: check the progress of money sent to a recipient

examples.en: The support page said where I could track a transfer using my reference number.
examples.zh: 帮助页写了在哪里用我的编号「追踪转账进度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the recipient could also track a transfer from her own account.
examples.zh: 我问收款人能不能也从她的账户「追踪转账进度」。

collocations: ask how to track a transfer
an option to track a transfer
track a transfer by its reference

words.enDefinition: switch to a less expensive product or service

examples.en: I decided to trade down to a cheaper phone after seeing what repairs would cost.
examples.zh: 看到维修要多少钱后，我决定「改买低价款」手机。

examples.en: We had to trade down when the tickets we wanted went over our spending limit.
examples.zh: 看中的票超出了支出上限，我们只好「改买低价款」。

collocations: trade down to a cheaper model

words.enDefinition: Interest accumulated before repayment that appears on a later statement

examples.en: The last bill showed trailing interest even though I had paid the previous balance.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经还清上期余额，最后一张账单还是显示了「残余利息」。

examples.en: The card issuer explained which dates the trailing interest on my statement covered.
examples.zh: 发卡机构解释了账单上的「残余利息」对应哪些日期。

collocations: trailing interest on the final bill

words.enDefinition: a recorded date and time attached to a transaction

examples.en: I checked the transaction timestamp to see which bus journey the charge covered.
examples.zh: 我查看了「交易时间戳」，想知道这笔费用是哪一趟公交的。

examples.en: The adviser asked for the transaction timestamp before looking in the payment system.
examples.zh: 顾问先问了「交易时间戳」，再到支付系统里查。

words.enDefinition: a charge for changing information in an existing transfer instruction

examples.en: The clerk explained when the bank would charge a transfer amendment fee.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了银行什么情况下会收「转账更改费」。

examples.en: I asked if a transfer amendment fee would appear separately on the receipt.
examples.zh: 我问「转账更改费」会不会在收据上单独显示。

collocations: ask about a transfer amendment fee

words.enDefinition: the sum specified to be moved in a transfer

examples.en: I checked the transfer amount against my tuition notice before confirming the request.
examples.zh: 确认申请前，我把「转账金额」和学费通知上的金额核对了一遍。

examples.en: The receipt separated the transfer amount from the service fee on two lines.
examples.zh: 收据分两行列出了「转账金额」和服务费。

words.zhGloss: 转账当日受理截止时间
words.enDefinition: the latest time for a transfer to enter that day's processing
acceptedZhAnswers: 转账当日受理截止时间

examples.en: I checked the transfer cut-off time because my lecture would finish late that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午课会结束得比较晚，所以我查了「转账当日受理截止时间」。

examples.en: The bank listed a separate transfer cut-off time for payments sent internationally that day.
examples.zh: 银行单独列明了当天国际汇款的「转账当日受理截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: the date recorded or planned for sending a transfer

examples.en: I asked which date on the receipt counted as the transfer date.
examples.zh: 我问收据上的哪个日期是「转账日期」。

examples.en: The bursar asked for the transfer date when I emailed about my payment.
examples.zh: 我发邮件询问付款时，学校财务人员让我提供「转账日期」。

words.enDefinition: a request telling a provider how to send funds

examples.en: The bank asked me to review my transfer instruction before sending the money.
examples.zh: 银行让我在汇出前再核对一遍「转账指令」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the transfer instruction with the recipient's confirmation email.
examples.zh: 我把「转账指令」的副本和收款人的确认邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: an inquiry into what happened to a particular transfer

examples.en: The bank assigned a case number to the transfer investigation I asked about.
examples.zh: 银行给我询问的这次「转账调查」分配了案件编号。

examples.en: I asked when the provider would contact me about the transfer investigation.
examples.zh: 我问服务商什么时候会就「转账调查」联系我。

collocations: a reference for a transfer investigation
an update on the transfer investigation

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the provider has paused and will not process until the hold is lifted

examples.en: I asked what the words transfer on hold meant in the provider's message.
examples.zh: 我问服务商消息里的「暂停处理的转账」是什么意思。

examples.en: The support team asked which transfer on hold I was calling about that afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午接我电话的客服问，我要查的是哪一笔「暂停处理的转账」。

collocations: ask about a transfer on hold
an update on a transfer on hold

words.enDefinition: the reason recorded for sending a particular transfer

examples.en: The app asked me to confirm the transfer purpose before reviewing the payment.
examples.zh: 应用让我先确认「汇款用途」，再核对付款。

examples.en: I asked how the transfer purpose would appear on my copy of the form.
examples.zh: 我问我的表格副本上会怎样显示「汇款用途」。

words.enDefinition: a request to bring back funds already sent through a transfer

examples.en: The bank explained what a transfer recall meant after I asked about a wrong payment.
examples.zh: 我问错转的钱怎么办时，银行给我解释了什么是「转账追回」。

examples.en: I asked who would update me about the transfer recall on my payment record.
examples.zh: 我问谁会通知我付款记录上那笔「转账追回」的进展。

collocations: check the status of a transfer recall

words.enDefinition: a document acknowledging that a transfer was submitted or paid

examples.en: I downloaded the transfer receipt after the transfer provider confirmed my request.
examples.zh: 服务商确认申请后，我下载了「转账收据」。

examples.en: The bursar asked whether the transfer receipt showed the amount and payment date.
examples.zh: 财务人员问「转账收据」上有没有写金额和付款日期。

words.enDefinition: an identifier associated with a particular transfer record

examples.en: I kept the transfer reference in case the university asked about my payment.
examples.zh: 我留了「转账查询编号」，以防学校问起我的付款。

examples.en: The bank asked for the transfer reference in order to find the transaction.
examples.zh: 银行让我提供「转账查询编号」，好调出这笔交易。

words.enDefinition: money paid back to the sender after a transfer is cancelled or returned

examples.en: I found a transfer refund on the statement for the previous month.
examples.zh: 我在上个月的账单上找到了一笔「转账退款」。

examples.en: The provider told me how the transfer refund would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 服务商告诉我，「转账退款」会在账户里怎样显示。

collocations: an update on a transfer refund

words.enDefinition: a transaction that undoes the accounting effect of an earlier transfer

examples.en: The statement showed a transfer reversal next to the original payment line.
examples.zh: 账单在原付款记录旁边显示了一笔「转账冲正」。

examples.en: I asked the bank why a transfer reversal had appeared in my account.
examples.zh: 我问银行，为什么我的账户上出现了一笔「转账冲正」。

words.enDefinition: the processing stage or outcome recorded for a transfer

examples.en: I checked the transfer status before replying to the university's accounts office.
examples.zh: 我先查了「转账状态」，才回复学校财务办公室。

examples.en: The provider sent me a message when the transfer status had changed.
examples.zh: 「转账状态」发生变化后，服务商给我发了一条消息。

words.enDefinition: a transfer that the provider is checking, for example to confirm its details

examples.en: The support agent asked for the reference of the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 客服人员请我提供这笔「正在审核的转账」的编号。

examples.en: I asked whether the provider would email me about the transfer under review.
examples.zh: 我问服务商会不会发邮件告知这笔「正在审核的转账」的情况。

collocations: a notification about a transfer under review
the reference for a transfer under review

words.enDefinition: a number identifying a bank branch in Canadian payment details

examples.en: The Canadian bank printed the transit number beside the institution number on my form.
examples.zh: 加拿大的银行把「加拿大银行分行编号」印在我的表格上的机构编号旁边。

examples.en: I asked why this transfer form had a field labeled transit number.
examples.zh: 我问这张转账表上为什么有一栏标着「加拿大银行分行编号」。

words.enDefinition: financial support that helps a student cover eligible travel connected with study or research

examples.en: The travel bursary paid for my return train ticket to the research conference.
examples.zh: 「差旅补助金」支付了我参加学术会议的往返火车票。

examples.en: I kept the receipts the department needed to process my travel bursary application.
examples.zh: 我留着院系处理「差旅补助金」申请所需的收据。

words.enDefinition: money spent on transport and other costs during a trip

examples.en: The conference covered some travel expenses, but I still had to pay for local buses.
examples.zh: 会议报销了一部分「出行费用」，但当地的公交车费还是要自己付。

examples.en: My travel expenses were higher this term because the placement was in another city.
examples.zh: 实习在另一座城市，我这学期的「出行费用」比以前高。

words.enDefinition: buy or do something enjoyable as a reward for yourself

examples.en: You could treat yourself to brunch after you hand in the last assignment.
examples.zh: 交完最后一份作业，你可以吃顿早午餐「犒劳一下自己」。

examples.en: It's nice to treat yourself to a coffee after a long morning in the lab.
examples.zh: 在实验室忙了一上午，买杯咖啡「犒劳一下自己」挺不错。

collocations: treat yourself to a good meal

words.enDefinition: to attempt payment with a different card

examples.en: The cashier asked if I wanted to try another card for the purchase.
examples.zh: 收银员问我这笔消费想不想「换张卡试试」。

examples.en: The checkout screen said try another card after rejecting my first payment attempt.
examples.zh: 第一次付款被拒后，结账屏幕提示「换张卡试试」。

words.enDefinition: an initial payment toward tuition, often collected before enrolment

examples.en: My tuition deposit appeared as a credit on the first full university bill.
examples.zh: 我的「学费预付款」在学校第一张完整账单上显示为一笔抵扣款。

examples.en: I kept the receipt confirming that the university had received my tuition deposit.
examples.zh: 我留着收据，证明学校已经收到了「学费预付款」。

collocations: credit a tuition deposit to an account

words.enDefinition: a loan designed specifically to cover some or all of a student's tuition charges

examples.en: The UK funding notice listed a tuition fee loan beside my maintenance loan.
examples.zh: 英国资助通知把「学费贷款」列在生活费贷款旁边。

examples.en: I checked whether the tuition fee loan amount matched the bill from my university.
examples.zh: 我核对了「学费贷款」的金额是否与学校的账单一致。

collocations: apply for a tuition fee loan

words.enDefinition: an arrangement that divides tuition into scheduled payments instead of one payment

examples.en: The tuition installment plan split my bill into four payments across the term.
examples.zh: 「学费分期缴纳计划」把我的账单分成学期内四次缴清。

examples.en: I checked the dates on the tuition installment plan before signing the agreement.
examples.zh: 签协议前，我核对了「学费分期缴纳计划」上的日期。

collocations: enrol in a tuition installment plan
set up a tuition installment plan

words.enDefinition: the last date for paying a particular tuition charge on time

examples.en: I received a reminder about the tuition payment deadline from the accounts office.
examples.zh: 我收到了财务办公室发来的「学费缴纳截止日」提醒。

examples.en: The tuition payment deadline on my corrected bill was a week later.
examples.zh: 我更正后的账单把「学费缴纳截止日」推迟了一周。

words.enDefinition: repayment to a student or employee of eligible tuition they have already paid

examples.en: My employer asked for the tuition receipt before processing tuition reimbursement for the course.
examples.zh: 雇主在办理这门课的「学费报销」前，要求我提交学费收据。

examples.en: I checked when the tuition reimbursement would appear in my employee payment record.
examples.zh: 我查了「学费报销」什么时候会出现在员工付款记录里。

words.enDefinition: part or all of a tuition charge that a university agrees not to collect, often as an employment or study benefit

examples.en: My assistantship letter explained how much tuition remission came with the position.
examples.zh: 助教岗位的聘书注明了这个岗位提供多少「学费减免」。

examples.en: The student account showed tuition remission under credits for the autumn term.
examples.zh: 学生账户把「学费减免」列在秋季学期的抵扣项下。

words.enDefinition: a unique identifier used to track a SWIFT payment across banks

examples.en: The bank asked for the UETR before checking where the payment had reached.
examples.zh: 银行先让我提供「端到端唯一交易编号」，再查款项到了哪里。

examples.en: I found the UETR in a separate field on the payment record.
examples.zh: 我在付款记录的一个独立字段里找到了「端到端唯一交易编号」。

collocations: look up a payment by UETR

words.enDefinition: card use not authorised by the person entitled to approve it

examples.en: The bank asked when I first noticed the unauthorized card transaction in the app.
examples.zh: 银行问我什么时候第一次在应用里发现「未经授权的刷卡交易」。

examples.en: My adviser explained the difference between a late refund and an unauthorized card transaction.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了退款晚到和「未经授权的刷卡交易」有什么区别。

words.enDefinition: A transaction that has not appeared on a completed bill

examples.en: The grocery purchase showed up as an unbilled transaction on my card account.
examples.zh: 那笔超市消费在我的信用卡账户上显示为「未出账交易」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unbilled transaction would appear on this week's statement.
examples.zh: 我问这笔「未出账交易」是否会出现在本周的账单上。

words.enDefinition: Savings the owner or beneficiary has not claimed

examples.en: The site listed the contact details for people asking about unclaimed savings from former accounts.
examples.zh: 网站列出了供人们查询旧账户中「无人认领的储蓄款」的联系方式。

examples.en: My father found an old statement while looking into unclaimed savings from his student days.
examples.zh: 爸爸在查询学生时代的「无人认领的储蓄款」时找到了一份旧账单。

words.enDefinition: a transfer waiting for the intended recipient to collect it

examples.en: The provider contacted me about an unclaimed transfer left at the collection point.
examples.zh: 服务商来联系我，说领取点有一笔「未领取的汇款」。

examples.en: I asked why the receipt showed an unclaimed transfer after the weekend.
examples.zh: 我问为什么过了周末，收据上还显示有一笔「未领取的汇款」。

collocations: follow up on an unclaimed transfer

words.enDefinition: a payment lower than the amount that should have been paid

examples.en: Payroll confirmed the underpayment after comparing the payslip with my approved hours.
examples.zh: 薪资部门把工资单与核准的工时作了对比，确认有一笔「少付的款项」。

examples.en: The letter gave the amount of the underpayment and a separate correction date.
examples.zh: 信里写明了「少付的款项」金额和另行补发的日期。

words.enDefinition: to restore use of a frozen bank account

examples.en: I asked which team could unfreeze an account after reviewing the documents already submitted.
examples.zh: 我问，哪个团队审核已提交的材料后可以「解除账户冻结」。

examples.en: The letter explained whom to contact to unfreeze an account after the review was complete.
examples.zh: 信里说明了审核结束后，可以找谁「解除账户冻结」。

collocations: ask how to unfreeze an account
review a request to unfreeze an account

words.enDefinition: to restore use of a payment card after a temporary freeze

examples.en: The official help page says where to unfreeze your card once you find it.
examples.zh: 官方帮助页说明了找到卡后在哪里「解除银行卡临时冻结」。

examples.en: My friend asked what unfreeze your card meant on her bank's app.
examples.zh: 朋友问她银行应用里的「解除银行卡临时冻结」是什么意思。

collocations: ask how to unfreeze your card
use the app to unfreeze your card

words.enDefinition: to remove an existing connection to an account

examples.en: I asked how to unlink an account from the dashboard after changing my banking profile.
examples.zh: 我改了银行资料后，问怎样在页面上「解除账户关联」。

examples.en: The support page explains where to unlink an account that you no longer use.
examples.zh: 帮助页面说明，可以在哪里为不再使用的账户「解除账户关联」。

collocations: ask how to unlink an account
an option to unlink an account

words.enDefinition: the part of assessed financial need that remains after available aid has been counted

examples.en: The worksheet showed unmet financial need after all of the offered awards were counted.
examples.zh: 计算表先计入所有获批补助，再显示「未获填补的资助需求」。

examples.en: I asked whether the small grant would reduce my unmet financial need for next term.
examples.zh: 我问这笔小额助学金能否减少下学期「未获填补的资助需求」。

words.enDefinition: hours that do not count toward paid time in a work or payroll record

examples.en: The statement showed three unpaid hours for the afternoon I took off.
examples.zh: 工资单上写着，我那天下午请了三个小时，计入「无薪时数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the unpaid hours listed there were for my scheduled breaks.
examples.zh: 我问那里列的「无薪时数」是不是指排班里的休息时间。

words.enDefinition: a cost that was not included in your plans

examples.en: The bike repair was an unplanned expense the week before my trip home.
examples.zh: 回家前一周，修自行车成了一笔「计划外支出」。

examples.en: An unplanned expense threw off my budget after I cracked my laptop screen.
examples.zh: 电脑屏幕裂了，换屏这笔「计划外支出」打乱了我的预算。

words.enDefinition: an account entry a customer cannot identify from the details shown

examples.en: I checked an unrecognized transaction after the bank showed a different shop name.
examples.zh: 银行显示了不同的商户名，我就查了一笔「不明交易」。

examples.en: The adviser asked for the date of the unrecognized transaction on my statement.
examples.zh: 顾问问对账单上「不明交易」是哪一天。

words.enDefinition: A loan that does not require property pledged as security

examples.en: The booklet included examples of an unsecured loan and a loan backed by property.
examples.zh: 手册介绍了「无抵押贷款」和以财产作担保的贷款的例子。

examples.en: This offer for an unsecured loan listed the total repayment amount separately.
examples.zh: 这份「无抵押贷款」报价单独列出了还款总额。

words.enDefinition: a currency that a service cannot handle for a particular transaction

examples.en: The app showed an unsupported currency message when I checked the delivery options.
examples.zh: 我查看到账方式时，应用显示了「暂不支持的币种」提示。

examples.en: I asked whether the receipt would still show the unsupported currency I had entered.
examples.zh: 我问收据会不会还显示我填的那个「暂不支持的币种」。

collocations: a transfer in an unsupported currency

words.enDefinition: a subscription you keep paying for but do not use

examples.en: I found an unused subscription when I went through my expenses after the summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假结束后，我翻开支记录，发现有一项「闲置订阅」。

examples.en: I'd been paying for an unused subscription to an app from my first term.
examples.zh: 第一学期装的那个应用我一直没用，却一直在为这项「闲置订阅」付费。

words.enDefinition: to change information that a bank keeps about an account

examples.en: I logged in to update account details after changing flats at the start of summer.
examples.zh: 初夏换了公寓后，我登录去「更新账户资料」。

examples.en: The bank explained where I could update account details if the mobile app was unavailable.
examples.zh: 银行说明，如果手机应用用不了，我可以去哪里「更新账户资料」。

words.enDefinition: to change how future payments will be made

examples.en: The service emailed me a reminder that said update your payment method before renewal.
examples.zh: 服务发邮件提醒我，续订前要「更新付款方式」。

examples.en: The website shows how to update your payment method in the account settings.
examples.zh: 网站说明了在账户设置里如何「更新付款方式」。

collocations: need to update your payment method
ask how to update your payment method

words.enDefinition: To spend all the money that was saved

examples.en: I didn't want to use up savings before my summer job started in June.
examples.zh: 我不想在六月暑期工作开始之前就「用光储蓄」。

examples.en: The family worried they might use up savings if the repairs took another month.
examples.zh: 家里担心维修要是再拖一个月，可能会「用光储蓄」。

collocations: avoid having to use up savings
use up savings on living costs

words.enDefinition: the date a transaction takes financial effect under bank terms

examples.en: I asked what the value date meant on the statement from my bank.
examples.zh: 我问银行账单上的「资金生效日」是什么意思。

examples.en: The receipt showed the transfer date and value date in two separate fields.
examples.zh: 收据分别用两个字段显示转账日期和「资金生效日」。

words.enDefinition: a pack of items sold together at an attractive price

examples.en: I bought a value pack of pens and divided them with my study group.
examples.zh: 我买了一份「优惠装」的笔，给学习小组的同学分了分。

examples.en: The value pack looked cheaper until I checked the weight on both labels.
examples.zh: 我对比了两个标签上的重量才发现，「优惠装」也没显得那么便宜。

words.enDefinition: An annualized borrowing rate that can change over time

examples.en: The agreement said the variable APR could change along with a benchmark rate.
examples.zh: 协议说「浮动年利率」可能随某个基准利率变化。

examples.en: I asked why the variable APR on my latest statement was different.
examples.zh: 我问为什么最近一期账单上的「浮动年利率」变了。

collocations: purchase balance with a variable APR

words.enDefinition: expenses whose amounts change from one period to another

examples.en: My variable expenses rise during exams because I buy coffee on campus more often.
examples.zh: 考试期间我更常在学校买咖啡，所以「浮动支出」会上升。

examples.en: I underestimated my variable expenses because May included several trips to visit friends.
examples.zh: 我低估了「浮动支出」，没想到五月要跑好几趟去看朋友。

words.enDefinition: Borrowed money on which the contracted rate may change over time

examples.en: The statement explained why the interest on my variable-rate loan changed last month.
examples.zh: 账单解释了我的「浮动利率贷款」上个月为什么调整了利息。

examples.en: The example for a variable-rate loan showed two possible monthly payment amounts.
examples.zh: 「浮动利率贷款」的示例列出了两个可能的每月还款额。

words.enDefinition: A savings interest rate that can change

examples.en: The welcome pack says the account has a variable savings rate that may change.
examples.zh: 开户资料写明，该账户采用可能调整的「浮动储蓄利率」。

examples.en: I checked the date when the new variable savings rate would start to apply.
examples.zh: 我查了新的「浮动储蓄利率」从哪天起适用。

collocations: a change to a variable savings rate

words.enDefinition: a card whose payment details are provided in digital form

examples.en: My bank showed a virtual card in the app while the physical one was being sent.
examples.zh: 实体卡邮寄期间，银行在应用里显示了一张「虚拟银行卡」。

examples.en: I compared the name on the virtual card with the name on my bank account.
examples.zh: 我把「虚拟银行卡」上的姓名和银行账户上的姓名核对了一下。

words.enDefinition: money an employee agrees to have taken out of their pay

examples.en: A voluntary deduction for the staff fund appeared on my first payslip.
examples.zh: 我的第一张工资单上列了一项给员工基金的「自愿扣款」。

examples.en: I asked where the voluntary deduction was listed in the summary of my pay.
examples.zh: 我问工资摘要中哪一栏列的是那笔「自愿扣款」。

words.enDefinition: to decide not to collect a monthly account charge

examples.en: I asked whether the bank would waive the monthly fee for my student account.
examples.zh: 我问银行会不会给我的学生账户「免收月费」。

examples.en: The letter explained when the bank might waive the monthly fee for this account.
examples.zh: 信里说明了这类账户在什么情况下可能「免收月费」。

collocations: agree to waive the monthly fee
ask the bank to waive the monthly fee
offer to waive the monthly fee

words.enDefinition: a code used to unlock a digital payment wallet

examples.en: My phone asked for the wallet passcode before showing the payment screen.
examples.zh: 手机要我输入「数字钱包解锁密码」才显示支付界面。

examples.en: I read the help page about a forgotten wallet passcode on my device.
examples.zh: 我在自己的设备上读了忘记「数字钱包解锁密码」的帮助页。

words.enDefinition: information and materials provided to a new customer

examples.en: My bank's welcome pack included a leaflet about how to contact the local branch.
examples.zh: 银行的「新客户资料包」里有一份折页，介绍怎样联系附近的网点。

examples.en: The teller gave me a welcome pack before I left the branch that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午离开网点前，柜员给了我一份「新客户资料包」。

words.enDefinition: a small amount of flexibility in a plan

examples.en: I kept a little wiggle room in case the bus fare went up again.
examples.zh: 我留了点「腾挪余地」，以防公交车票再涨价。

examples.en: Skipping the takeaway gave me a little wiggle room to buy a birthday card.
examples.zh: 少吃一顿外卖，就能留出一点「腾挪余地」买张生日卡。

words.enDefinition: payment details a sender uses to direct a wire transfer

examples.en: I asked the bursar which department could provide the official wire instructions.
examples.zh: 我问学校财务人员，哪个部门可以提供官方「电汇收款资料」。

examples.en: The wire instructions listed the institution's registered name above the account information.
examples.zh: 「电汇收款资料」把机构的登记名称列在账户信息上方。

words.enDefinition: a routing identifier listed for processing domestic wire payments

examples.en: I asked whether the wire routing number on this form applied to the payment type.
examples.zh: 我问这张表上的「美国电汇路由号码」是不是适用这种付款方式。

examples.en: The bank labeled the wire routing number separately from its standard account details.
examples.zh: 银行把「美国电汇路由号码」和常规账户资料分开标注。

collocations: confirm a U.S. wire routing number

words.enDefinition: a form for requesting a bank to send a wire payment

examples.en: The bank sent a copy of the wire transfer request form to my inbox.
examples.zh: 银行把「电汇申请表」的副本发到了我的邮箱。

examples.en: I asked which section of the wire transfer request form showed the recipient's bank.
examples.zh: 我问「电汇申请表」的哪个部分填写收款银行。

collocations: complete a wire transfer request form
submit a wire transfer request form
a blank wire transfer request form

words.enDefinition: To take out money when the deposit term ends

examples.en: The confirmation says I chose to withdraw at maturity when I opened the deposit.
examples.zh: 确认单显示，我办理这笔存款时选择了「到期支取」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could withdraw at maturity using the bank's app while travelling.
examples.zh: 我问旅行途中能不能用银行的应用「到期支取」。

collocations: be able to withdraw at maturity
withdraw at maturity without a charge

words.enDefinition: To take out interest earned while leaving the deposit

examples.en: The bank confirmed I could withdraw interest separately under the terms of this product.
examples.zh: 银行确认，按这款产品的条款，我可以单独「提取利息」。

examples.en: I asked when I could withdraw interest without closing my savings account entirely.
examples.zh: 我问什么时候可以「提取利息」，同时保留储蓄账户。

words.enDefinition: The sum taken out of an account

examples.en: The withdrawal amount on the receipt matched the number I entered on the form.
examples.zh: 凭据上的「支取金额」和我在表格里填的数字一致。

examples.en: I changed the withdrawal amount after checking how much the replacement ticket would cost.
examples.zh: 确认了补买车票的费用后，我改了「支取金额」。

words.enDefinition: Rules specifying when and how money may be withdrawn

examples.en: I read the withdrawal conditions when I opened the updated document from the bank.
examples.zh: 我打开银行更新后的文件，读了里面的「提款条件」。

examples.en: The representative explained the withdrawal conditions using the date printed on my confirmation letter.
examples.zh: 客服参照确认信上印的日期，向我解释了「提款条件」。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming a withdrawal has been completed

examples.en: I filed the withdrawal confirmation with the statement I downloaded from the bank.
examples.zh: 我把「提款确认通知」和从银行下载的账单存放在一起。

examples.en: The withdrawal confirmation showed the exact amount that had been sent on Friday.
examples.zh: 「提款确认通知」显示了周五汇出的确切金额。

words.enDefinition: Advance notice of an intended withdrawal

examples.en: The bank recorded my withdrawal notice on the same day I submitted it online.
examples.zh: 银行在我在线提交的当天登记了我的「提款提前通知」。

examples.en: The email showed the date my withdrawal notice would take effect later that month.
examples.zh: 邮件列出了我的「提款提前通知」当月晚些时候将生效的日期。

words.enDefinition: A formal instruction asking to take money out

examples.en: The bank sent me an email after it received the withdrawal request on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 银行周二收到「提款申请」后给我发了邮件。

examples.en: I checked the amount on my withdrawal request before sending the form to the bank.
examples.zh: 把表格发给银行之前，我核对了「提款申请」上的金额。

words.enDefinition: A rule limiting when or how funds can be withdrawn

examples.en: The bank's leaflet explained the withdrawal restriction that applied during the first month.
examples.zh: 银行的传单说明了第一个月适用的「提款限制」。

examples.en: I checked whether the withdrawal restriction applied to the full balance or only part of it.
examples.zh: 我查了这项「提款限制」适用于全部余额还是只适用于其中一部分。

words.enDefinition: A limited period during which withdrawals can be made

examples.en: The letter gave the dates of the withdrawal window for my maturing deposit.
examples.zh: 信里列明了我这笔即将到期的存款的「可提款时间段」。

examples.en: I called because the withdrawal window on the app didn't match the letter.
examples.zh: 应用里显示的「可提款时间段」和信上不一致，所以我打了电话。

words.enDefinition: to retain part of a payment for transfer to a tax authority

examples.en: The guide explains which line employers use when they withhold tax from wages.
examples.zh: 指南说明，雇主从工资里「预扣税款」时用哪一栏。

examples.en: My supervisor directed my question about whether they withhold tax to the payroll office.
examples.zh: 我问会不会「预扣税款」，主管让我去咨询薪资部门。

words.enDefinition: the sum taken out of a payment before the balance is paid to the recipient

examples.en: The withholding amount on this week's statement was different from the previous one.
examples.zh: 这周工资单上的「预扣金额」和上一张不一样。

examples.en: The office said the withholding amount appeared just above the total deductions.
examples.zh: 办公室说，「预扣金额」就在扣款合计的上方。

words.enDefinition: a form used to supply or document information for withholding tax

examples.en: The orientation guide showed a withholding certificate alongside other forms for new hires.
examples.zh: 迎新指南把「预扣税申报凭证」和其他入职表格放在一起展示。

examples.en: The payroll clerk asked which year appeared on the withholding certificate I had received.
examples.zh: 薪资部门的办事员问，我收到的「预扣税申报凭证」上写的是哪一年。

words.enDefinition: an approved amount a student may earn through eligible work under a financial aid program

examples.en: The work-study award appeared in my aid package before I found an eligible job.
examples.zh: 在我找到符合条件的工作之前，资助方案就列出了「勤工助学获批额度」。

examples.en: I asked whether the work-study award showed my earning limit for the current year.
examples.zh: 我问「勤工助学获批额度」是不是显示了我今年可以挣多少。

collocations: the amount of a work-study award

words.enDefinition: the pay recorded from the start of the current reporting year up to a given date

examples.en: The year-to-date pay figure includes my earnings from the first semester.
examples.zh: 「本年累计工资」的数字包含我第一学期的收入。

examples.en: I saw year-to-date pay beside the figures for the current pay period.
examples.zh: 我在本期工资金额旁边看到了「本年累计工资」。

words.enDefinition: the amount spent since the start of the current year

examples.en: My year-to-date spending includes the conference ticket I paid for back in January.
examples.zh: 我的「本年累计支出」包括一月份就付过的会议门票。

examples.en: I checked my year-to-date spending before deciding whether to renew the sports club membership.
examples.zh: 决定要不要续体育社团会籍前，我查了「本年累计支出」。

words.enDefinition: an account amount showing neither funds nor money owed

examples.en: The app showed a zero balance after the account had been opened for me.
examples.zh: 银行给我开好账户后，应用显示「余额为零」。

examples.en: I asked why my older statement showed a zero balance on the last day.
examples.zh: 我问较早的一份对账单为什么显示最后一天「余额为零」。

words.enDefinition: a budget that assigns a purpose to every unit of income

examples.en: My zero-based budget gives every dollar a job, including the money for next month's trip.
examples.zh: 我的「零基预算」给每一块钱都安排了用途，包括下个月旅行的钱。

examples.en: We used a zero-based budget to decide where this month's part-time wages should go.
examples.zh: 我们用「零基预算」安排了这个月兼职工资的各项用途。
